epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 副警長James奉命看守一具曾舉行神秘儀式的女屍。豈料,他因一時好奇誤觸未完成的邪惡儀式,讓禁忌之門大開,釋放出三個黑暗惡魔。在精神廢墟、幻覺與真實邪祟的瘋狂夾擊下,他的理智逐步瓦解,最終墜入無法逃離..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Deputy Sheriff James is assigned to guard the body of a woman used in a mysterious ritual. After accidentally completing the unfinished ceremony, he unleashes three dark demons. As psychological torment, terrifying hallucinations and real demonic forces close in, his sanity slowly unravels, plunging him into an inescapable abyss of darkness.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 跟朋友在酒吧喝酒的女孩邂逅恐怖小說家,兩人一見鍾情感情迅速升溫。原來女孩已悄然落入驚天迷局,全因小說家的前女友是個毀容的女鬼,她借用人面還魂復仇,與前男友聯手開啟奪命驚嚇。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A young girl encounters a novelist in a bar and quickly falls in love with him. However, it turns out she has fallen into a trap set up by the novelist and his ex-girlfriend who is a ghost with a disfigured face. The journey of revenge and ultimate terror has just begun!

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 建築師May與男友Gun搬入新居後,驟聞繼母離奇身亡。May收留孤苦的繼妹Noon,怎料她入宅後竟行為詭異,頻遭惡靈附身,而May也陷入恐怖幻象與嚴重失眠的折磨。隨著宅內黑暗秘密逐步揭開,通靈法師終於..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: After moving into a house with her boyfriend, Gun, architect May learns of her stepmother’s mysterious death. When May takes in her stepsister Noon, the girl begins showing signs of possession, while May suffers disturbing visions and insomnia. As dark secrets emerge, spiritual masters uncover an ancient black-magic curse hidden within the house.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在一次車禍後失憶的王人傑找到夜間警衛的工作。午夜,他準時抵達廢棄的大廈上班,卻發現三隻冤魂如約而至,並揭發了一場復仇計畫。究竟這是命運的安排還是邪靈的詛咒?
epg.episode_synopsis_en: After a car accident erases his memory, Wang Ren Jie takes a job as a night guard. When the clock strikes midnight, he reports for duty at an abandoned building — only to find three lost souls awaiting him, and unravels a revenge plot at the same time. Is this fate or a curse cast by vengeful spirits?

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 全球暖化解凍遠古冰層,釋出一股邪惡孢子,為人類帶來毀滅浩劫。逃難中的Meadow躲進一間廢棄小屋,卻發現自己並非孤身一人。她必須與其他倖存者並肩求生,因為感染者正蛻變為饑渴的獵人,對活人展開殘酷獵殺。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Global warming has awakened a malevolent spore from beneath an ancient ice field, unleashing a horrific plague that ravages humanity. Fleeing the chaos, Meadow takes refuge in an abandoned cabin. Together with other strangers, she fights to survive as some succumb to the plague, transforming into ravenous hunters who now stalk the living.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 副警長James奉命看守一具曾舉行神秘儀式的女屍。豈料,他因一時好奇誤觸未完成的邪惡儀式,讓禁忌之門大開,釋放出三個黑暗惡魔。在精神廢墟、幻覺與真實邪祟的瘋狂夾擊下,他的理智逐步瓦解,最終墜入無法逃離..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Deputy Sheriff James is assigned to guard the body of a woman used in a mysterious ritual. After accidentally completing the unfinished ceremony, he unleashes three dark demons. As psychological torment, terrifying hallucinations and real demonic forces close in, his sanity slowly unravels, plunging him into an inescapable abyss of darkness.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 警方在調查一宗團夥殺人案時,突然又發生了離奇的紙人殺人事件,嫌疑人一個接一個被殺。隨著不斷挖出的線索,警方最終發現這背後隱藏著橫跨兩代人的秘密與悲劇。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: As the police investigate a gang murder case, another mysterious paper man murder occurs, and the suspects are killed one by one. Continuing to track the clues of the case, the police finally unveil a hidden secret and tragedy spanning two generations.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 菲律賓警方調查一宗極其殘忍、涉及邪教祭祀的離奇連環屠殺案時,在薄荷島救出唯一的倖存者,而她竟是一名隱姓埋名的前美國FBI探員。隨著調查不斷深入,她供述的遠古預言、惡魔附身與血腥祭祀,逐漸將所有人捲入一..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: While investigating a series of cult ritual massacres, Philippine police rescue the sole survivor on Bohol Island, who is a former FBI agent living under a false identity. As the investigation deepens, her accounts of ancient prophecies, demonic possession and bloody rituals draw everyone into a terrifying mystery where reality blurs.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 一個寧靜的晚上,一名患精神病的連環殺手擾亂了年輕夫婦的平淡生活。當這對夫婦為生存而戰時,他們隱藏多年的秘密亦隨之揭開,期間更意外地被牽連到黑社會的地下世界中。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A young couples tranquility is shattered by a psychotic serial killer one quiet evening. Their battle for survival reveals hidden truths, entangling them unwittingly with the criminal underworld.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 一場車禍後,林月家裡怪事連連。全身冰冷的姐姐在鏡子裡看不見家人的身影,黑夜裡爸爸窺探的雙眼,和每天淩晨閣樓傳來的彈珠聲。林月循聲而上去尋找真相,卻在打開閣樓的門後,發現裡面緊鎖的是自己的遺像…
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Strange incidents keep happening in Lin Yues house after a car accident: her sister cannot see the images of her family members in the mirror; her father is peeping at night; and there is the sound of marbles from the attic every day at dawn. Following the sound to the attic, Lin Yue finds her own death portrait as she opens the door...

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 一群漠視勸誡的年青人貿然闖進詭異森林露營作樂,入夜之後,他們內心的邪念驅使他們落入性與愛的關係陷阱,引來了森林裡一連串的靈異事件。黎明將至,他們當中有誰能逃生?
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A group of friends goes on a camping trip inside a supposedly haunted forest despite warning not to do so. As night falls and camps are set, the complicated relationships of lust and love between them are exposed, triggering a series of paranormal events that punishes them.  When dawn breaks, who will get out of the forest alive?

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 藝人尹青透過一個靈異電視節目闖入地獄之門,並與已故好友美琪重逢。在美琪的墓園,尹青遇見了美琪的丈夫東升,隨後一系列詭異的靈異事件接連發生。尹青將東升帶回節目,讓美琪揭露了丈夫的婚外情和導致她死亡的陰謀..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Artiste Yin Qing enters Hells Gate through a supernatural TV show and reunites with her late friend Mei Qi. At Mei Qis gravesite, Yin Qing encounters Mei Qis husband, Dong Sheng, and a series of mysterious incidents unfold. She then brings Dong Sheng onto the show, where Mei Qi exposes his infidelity and reveals the conspiracy behind her death.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 警方在調查一宗團夥殺人案時,突然又發生了離奇的紙人殺人事件,嫌疑人一個接一個被殺。隨著不斷挖出的線索,警方最終發現這背後隱藏著橫跨兩代人的秘密與悲劇。

epg.episode_synopsis_en: As a young mother grapples with her daughters mysterious disappearance, a series of eerie events unfold. These events could be linked to the vengeful ghosts of a tragic accident that happened 20 years ago...

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 電影由三個恐怖短故事組成:一個男人收到死神通報後,設法避過死亡;男人因心愛的妻子去世後傷心欲絕,他的妻子變成鬼魂與他通靈;三兄弟在一次晚餐聚會上為照顧年邁母親的問題而爭吵,最後竟變成一宗可怕的謀殺案。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The film consists of three short horror stories: a man tries to survive after he received a haunted mail predicting his death; while a man mourns the death of his beloved wife, she becomes a ghost and tries to communicate with him; three brothers clash over the care options of their elderly mother during dinner, leading to a terrifying murder.

However, her dream transforms into a chilling nightmare on Christmas Eve when Lukes vampire companions track him down...

Miss Qiao’s spirit is revived to take revenge when the doll’s eyes are drawn, and a series of horrible events begins to happen...

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 雙胞胎兄妹在偏遠旅館渡過恐怖的一夜,為調查其父親在兩人出生前失蹤的真相。當他們深入調查後,旅館的暗黑秘密把他們困於地獄迷宮中,兄妹二人定要在黎明前逃離險境。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A pair of fraternal twins spend a terrifying night in a remote inn to investigate the last known whereabouts of their father who mysteriously disappeared the night they were born. As they dive deeper, the propertys dark secrets ensnare them in a hellish labyrinth which they must escape before dawn.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 若為和兩位閨蜜回到她兒時居住的房子,重遇一直住在那兒的表哥。他們本打算一起散散心,卻頻頻遭遇靈異事件的侵襲,最後更變成一場驚心動魄之旅,有讓人意想不到的結局。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Ruo Wei returns to her childhood home with two best friends, and reunites with her cousin who has always lived there. While they plan to enjoy their trip, they are constantly haunted by paranormal events, ending up in a terrifying experience with unexpected outcome.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 思南和丈夫前往吉隆玻度假,希望能緩解懷孕帶來的壓力。然而,她意外發現丈夫有個陰險的計畫,要將他們的孩子變成「碌葛」以謀取利潤,使她陷入危險之中。思南幸得酒店鬼魂的幫助,成功逃脫並報警將丈夫拘捕,最終安..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Si Nan and her husband travel to Kuala Lumpur for a vacation to relieve her pregnancy stress. However, she soon uncovers his evil plan to turn their child into a Luk Krok for profit, which puts her in grave danger. With the help of the hotel ghosts, she manages to flee and alert the police to arrest him, finally giving birth to her child.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 民國初年,富甲一方的康氏慘遭滅門,唯一的目擊證人—家中的幼女—在親眼目睹全家被殺後離奇失蹤。幾十年間,位於青木巷的廢棄康宅充斥著靈異驚悚的氣氛。隨著真相逐漸揭露,這個恐怖的疑團交織著復仇與死亡的動機。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Set in the early years of the Republic of China, the wealthy Kang family is brutally murdered, and their young daughter —the sole witness— mysteriously disappears. For decades, the haunting of the Kang house on Green Wood Lane lingers. As the truth behind the tragedy unfolds, motives of revenge and death intertwine in this chilling mystery.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 兩個立志成為網紅的男生連同一位漂亮女同學,合力在學校後面的舊大樓拍一部靈異實錄片,希望能吸引更多關注。三人遇上校內霸淩同學的富二代男女。原來女同學早已有計劃接近這幾個學校霸淩,籍此展開一場不惜犧牲無辜..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A school girl joins two internet content creators in a horror video project filmed in an old building behind their school. Trapped inside, he is forced by a mysterious mastermind to play ten disturbing videos on a flash drive. As deadly curses unfold, he is plagued by terrifying visions while his body, memory and life slowly unravel. With the countdown to death underway, can he survive?

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 雙胞胎兄妹在偏遠旅館渡過恐怖的一夜,為調查其父親在兩人出生前失蹤的真相。當他們深入調查後,旅館的暗黑秘密把他們困於地獄迷宮中,兄妹二人定要在黎明前逃離險境。

As they dive deeper, the propertys dark secrets ensnare them in a hellish labyrinth which they must escape before dawn.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: Si Nan and her husband travel to Kuala Lumpur for a vacation to relieve her pregnancy stress. However, she soon uncovers his evil plan to turn their child into a Luk Krok for profit, which puts her in grave danger. With the help of the hotel ghosts, she manages to flee and alert the police to arrest him, finally giving birth to her child.

For decades, the haunting of the Kang house on Green Wood Lane lingers. As the truth behind the tragedy unfolds, motives of revenge and death intertwine in this chilling mystery.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 一名女警搬進小鎮後不久,便被一宗少女疑似遭邪靈附身的案件所牽引。隨著調查層層深入,詭譎真相逐漸浮現,現實與靈異的界線愈發模糊,她亦一步步墜入危機之中。最終,她發現這不僅是一場驅魔之戰,更是一段揭開小鎮..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A female police officer relocates to a quiet small town and is drawn into a chilling case involving a girl seemingly possessed by an evil spirit. As her investigation deepens, unsettling truths emerge. She soon realises this is not just an exorcism, but a psychological battle that uncovers the town’s dark secrets.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 資深主播艾米遭遇詭異蝙蝠襲擊後,帶著傷口返回電台,準備主持當晚的深夜節目。豈料竟遭無良老闆設局解僱,並被新人強行取代。適逢暴風雨封鎖整座電台,隨著傷口引發的異變愈演愈烈,艾米逐漸失控,在直播間掀起一場..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Radio host Amy is bitten by a mysterious bat, but she returns to the station to host that night’s late-night show. Instead, she is set up and fired by her ruthless boss, then replaced by a newcomer. As a violent storm traps everyone in the station and her mysterious wound worsens, Amy gradually loses control and unleashes a bloody massacre.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc:
民國年間,江南村落接連發生離奇命案,逐漸淪為遠近聞名的鬼村「封門村」。記者李穆與員警萬楓為追查一宗滅門慘案,深入陰森村莊抽絲剝繭,
誓要揭開連環命案背後的真相,破除流傳已久的封建迷信。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: During the Republican era, a Jiangnan village plagued by mysterious deaths becomes the infamous ghost village of Fengmen. Journalist Li Mu and police officer Wan Feng venture into the eerie village to uncover the truth behind the killings and shatter the grip of superstition.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: When four best friends reunite for a funeral at an ancient estate, a reckless act with a cursed Manohra dancers headdress awakens a vengeful spirit that begins to haunt and follow them relentlessly. As paranormal phenomena escalate, they are forced to confront the estates dark secrets in a desperate struggle for survival.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: Mina is in awe after reading Yidoro The Wises biography. For her, there is nothing more important than wisdom.Thats why she will avoid asking questions that would reveal her ignorance. To her surprise there are things that everyone else knows, exce

epg.episode_synopsis_en: Zari discovers two water monitors hugging each other and thinks theyre in love. But shes mistaken!

epg.episode_synopsis_en: Todays show is all about animals with lots of legs!

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 牠們很大!牠們很壯!他們很堅強!牠們是熊啤啤!
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Todays show is all about bears!

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 有些孩子喜歡在雪地裡玩耍!有些動物也一樣!這就是為何今集的內容全都關於對寒冷著迷的動物!
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Todays show is all about animals who are crazy about cold!

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 有人愛在河裡玩耍!但這些膽大妄為的人對今集內容中神奇的淡水動物一無所知!
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Todays show is all about the fantastic freshwater animals!

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 其他蟲子發現史角可以模仿牠們所有蟲子,牠模仿得過火直至夢見自己失去了聲音。牠必須去迴音仙子那兒重獲聲線。/ 霉菌侵入蛛華士整個巢穴,牠舉家都要依靠陽光派鄰居的慷慨,牠也學到了寬容的真正意義。

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在立春前夕,史角是一隻興奮的小蜘蛛。春天來了,是時候喚醒牠最好的朋友青蛙菲利斯。菲利斯一直在享受漫長的冬眠。但冬未去,春未來,牠也未準備好春甦,史角充滿樂趣的計劃泡湯了。/ 小龍厭倦了絲網,抓住機會當一天蜜蜂。但牠很快就發現當一隻蜜蜂雖然令人興奮,但也需要付出很多努力。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: On the eve of the first day of Spring, Squirt is one excited little spider. Spring is here and its time to wake up Felix the frog, his best buddy. / Dragon, bored of web-testing, jumps at the opportunity to be a Bee for a day. But he quickly finds o

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 比路發現他最好的朋友有音樂天賦。從那一刻起,他將嘗試與其他朋友分享發現。儘管姑毛很害羞,比路還是會嘗試揭露和分享這個秘密。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Bello discovers his best friend has an innate talent for music. From that moment on, he will try to share his discovery with the rest of his friends. Despite how shy Goomo is, Bello will try to reveal and share the secret.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 姑毛弄丟了他用來和比路玩啫堡俠和頭盔仔的眼鏡。他們都發現一隻戴著姑毛眼鏡的瞎子渡渡鳥。戴上它後,渡渡鳥可以重見光明,並與其他渡渡鳥玩耍。姑毛會放棄他的眼鏡,還是取回它去當超級英雄?
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Goomo has lost the glasses he uses to play Jammboman and Helmetkid with Bello. Both friends discover a blind Dodo wearing Goomo’s glasses. With them on, the Dodo can actually see and play with the rest of the Dodos. Will Goomo give up his glasses or

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 莉塔和公主正在舉行一場可愛的粉紅色野餐:粉紅色的菜餚、粉紅色的食物、粉紅色的一切!莉塔向公主傾訴她希望啫堡上的所有東西都是她最喜歡的顏色。她衝到音樂工廠,將五顏六色的音樂泡泡變成粉紅色,這可能會讓一切變得一樣!當其他孩子意識到莉塔的行動時,他們必須在啫堡變成一片大而無聊、貧瘠的粉紅色荒地前,努力恢復
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Rita and Princess are having a lovely pink picnic: pink dishes, pink food, pink everything! Rita confides in Princess how she would like everything on Jammbo to be her favorite color. She rushes to the Music Factory and switches the multi-colored mus

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 姑毛和莉塔正在戶外度過愉快的一天,突然發現一顆渡渡鳥蛋。孩子們和小雞蛋將進行動作連場的冒險。經過這麼多的喧囂,鳥蛋能存活下來嗎?
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Goomo and Rita enjoy their day in the outdoors when they suddenly discover a Dodo egg. The children and the small egg will go on an action-packed adventure. Will the egg survive after so much hustle and bustle?

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 音盤已經瘋了,啫堡中的所有聲音都被改變,造成了巨大的混亂。比路和莉塔將負責將每一個聲音歸還到它所屬的地方。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The Disk of Sounds has gone crazy and all the sounds in Jammbo have been changed, causing a huge chaos. Bello and Rita willbe in charge of returning each sound to the place where it belongs.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 比路必須戴眼罩。他因外表而感到不舒服和沮喪。幸運的是,他的朋友們用一首歌的智慧提醒他,任何問題都可以變成有趣的事情。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Bello has to wear an eye patch. He feels uncomfortable and discouraged because of how he looks. Luckily, his friends use the wisdom of a song to remind him that any problem can turn into something fun.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 姑毛決定穿上一雙神奇的運動鞋走10萬步,這將帶他找到一個神奇的寶藏。至少他堅信如此,而他的朋友們則認為他瘋了。最後,誰會贏?
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Goomo has decided to take 100.000 steps with a pair of magic sneakers that will lead him to an amazing treasure. At least that’s what he believes because his friends think he’s gone crazy. In the end, who wins?

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 特工需要甚麼?我們可以用日常物品創造出哪些驚人的發明?米娜有答案。她很快就會向她的朋友們證明科學不一定無聊。事實上,那可能是秘密特工的最佳資源。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: What does a special agent need? What amazing inventions can we create with our everyday objects? Mina has the answer. She´ll soon prove to her friends that science doesnt need to be boring. In fact it can be a secret agents´ best resource.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 孩子們參加捉伊人比賽,看誰是宇宙中最強隊伍。那麼,這有甚麼問題呢?即使他們不在比賽時,也開始將其他隊員視為敵人。必須有人教他們競爭和敵對的分別。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The children get wound up in a tag-playing competition to see who the best team in the universe is. So, what´s wrong with that? They begin to see the other team members as enemies even when they´re not playing. Someone will have to teach them the dif

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 國王迫不及待地想試用他的新品:一個會隨著音樂飛舞的浴缸。當國王暫時離開時,比路和米娜最終成為第一個嘗試的人。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The King is impatient to try out his new acquisition: a bathtub that flies to music. When the King steps away momentarily, Bello and Mina end up being the first to try it.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 比路突然擁有了強大的力量,這要歸功於一枚滿足他所有願望的警長星章。他的新責任賦予了他如此多的力量,令比路最終希望得到很快就會後悔的東西。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Bello suddenly has great powers thanks to a sheriff star badge that grants his every wish. His new responsibility empowers him so much that Bello ends up wishing for something he´ll soon regret.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 國王傷了背部。每個人都想出一個計劃,把他安然無恙地送回城堡裡舒適的床上。他們必須學會傾聽對方的意見,甚至考慮最荒謬的選擇,因為你永遠不知道答案在哪裡。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The King has hurt his back. Everyone thinks of a plan to transport him –safe and sound – to his comfortable bed back in the castle. They must learn to listen to each other and consider even the most absurd options because you never know where the ans

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 姑毛必須擔任舞蹈比賽的評委。起初,這個決定似乎很容易,但當他發現選擇贏家就意味著選擇輸家時……事情變得複雜!他會失去他淘汰的朋友嗎?那樣重的責任會令他感覺怎樣?
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Goomo has to judge a dance contest. At first, the decision seems easy but when he discovers that choosing a winner means choosing a loser... It gets complicated! Will he lose the friend he signals out as the loser? How does so much responsibility mak

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 今天是孩子們相聚並畫畫的好日子,他們都興奮地開始。比路知道他的畫是女王的最愛,他迫不及待地想給她看他最新的作品。不幸的是,女王正忙著教莉塔一些東西。比路認為這不公平。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Its a wonderful day to draw and the children gather round, exited to get started. Bello knows his drawings are the Queens favorite and he cant wait to show her his latest one. Unfortunately, the Queen is too busy trying to teach Rita something. Be

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 白色渡渡鳥突然造訪孩子們。他們所有人,尤其是安高,都與這種不可思議的動物交上了朋友。不幸的是,白色渡渡鳥有一個任務在身,分別似乎無可避免。儘管悲傷地告別,但總有音樂讓他們振作起來。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The children get a surprise visit from a White Dodo. All of them, especially Ongo, make friends with this incredible animal. Unfortunately, the White Dodo has a mission to accomplish and a separation seems inevitable. Despite the sad goodbye, there i

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 米娜讀完智者伊朵羅的傳記後,驚訝萬分。對她來說,沒有甚麼比智慧更重要。這就是為何她會避免發問,以免暴露她的無知。令她吃驚的是,有些事情其他人都知道,除了她自己。很快她就會明白不恥下問的重要性。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Mina is in awe after reading Yidoro The Wises biography. For her, there is nothing more important than wisdom.Thats why she will avoid asking questions that would reveal her ignorance. To her surprise there are things that everyone else knows, exce

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 本集講述的是動物王國中令人毛骨悚然的生物。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: This episode is all about creepy creatures from the animal kingdom.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 本集講述了七大洋中最狡猾、最貪婪、最狡猾的動物。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: This episode about the sneakiest greediest cunningest animals that ever sailed the seven seas.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 準備把口張大—因為今集主題是嘴巴!對於一些動物來說—越大越好!這就是為何今天的測驗都關於大嘴巴!
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Todays show is all about animals with big mouth!

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 我們的舌頭幫我們品嚐食物,但你不會相信動物們會用舌頭做出如此驚人的事。今天的測驗是關於靈巧的舌頭!
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Todays quiz is all about animals with Tricky Tongues!

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 歡迎來到沙漠!它很乾燥!很熱!而且很致命!這就是為何今集叫-危險的沙漠!
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Todays show is about Dangerous Deserts!

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 你喜歡和可愛的貓狗一起玩嗎?好吧,在野外有更大的混種貓狗……牠們是今天測驗的明星!全都關於大型貓科動物和野狗的!
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Todays show is all about big cats and wild dogs!

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 比路和姑毛夢想成為真正的超級英雄,所以他們請米娜訓練他們。她恰如其分,只是比路還沒有準備好忍受漫長而艱苦的訓練。他放棄並選擇了一項更容易的活動。那是他以後會後悔的事。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Bello and Goomo dream of becoming real super heroes so they ask Mina to train them.She sets out to do a great jobbut Bello isnt ready to endure the long and hard training. He gives up and choses an easier activity. Something he will later regret.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 當其他人都得到讚揚和掌聲時,要站著面對並不總是那麼容易。比路嘗試在他朋友的表演中搶盡風頭,讓他們非常沮喪,比路需要分享他的一些才能來解決問題。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: It´s not always easy to stand still when everyone else gets praise and applause. Bello will try to steal the show during his friends performances. They get so upset that Bello will need to share some of his talent to fix things.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 比路和姑毛發現城堡裡的所有玩具都放在一個盒子裡,他們面對著一項幾乎不可能完成的任務。雖然誘惑很大,但他們接到嚴格的命令,不能碰盒子,因為他們肯定會弄得一團糟。他們能服從命令,讓城堡一塵不染嗎?
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Bello andy Goomo are faced with an almost impossible task when they discover that all the toys in the castle have been placed in a single box. The temptation is great but they have strict orders not to touch the box for they would surely make a huge

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 還有比在音樂誕生的星球更適合跳舞的地方嗎?啫堡上的每個人都會向您展示一段舞蹈,這樣我們就可以隨著啫堡的節奏一起跳舞。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Is there a better place to dance than the planet where music is born? Every person on Jammbo has a dance to show you so we can all dance together to the rhythm of Jammbo.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 成為啫堡之王並非易事。嗯……是容易的。但國王認為應該更容易,所以他創造了自己的複製人,他能指揮他們在四處做所有艱苦的工作。不出所料,這些複製人就像國王一樣非常懶惰,不但沒有提供幫助,反而成為了啫堡一個日益嚴重的新問題。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Being the King of Jammbo isnt an easy task. Well...yes it is. But the King believes it should even more easy, so he creates clones of himself that he can order around, having them do all the hard work. As expected, these clones, much like the King,a

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 啫堡舉行了另一場有趣的比賽,每個孩子必須在渡渡鳥的幫助下,力所能及找到最大的音樂三葉草。比路遇到要協助他的渡渡鳥時感到吃虧。因牠是比路見過最老、最愛發牢騷的渡渡鳥。不過,比路很快就意識到,這隻特殊的渡渡鳥和他們之間的特殊關係,會帶來比他想像中多的驚喜。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Another fun contest in Jammbo is celebrated, in which each child, with the help of a Dodo, must search for the largest musical clover he can find.Bello feels at a disadvantage when he meets the Dodo who will assist him. This Dodo is the oldest and th

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 國王剛剛調整了他的汽車,所以想讓所有人都見到。這就是為何他組織了一場賽車比賽,啫堡上的所有車輛都將參加!甚至連莉塔和她的三輪車也參賽!比賽開始,國王不再自負,這說服孩子們需要聯合起來,全力以赴贏得勝利!
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The King has just tuned his car and hes not willing for it to go unnoticed.Thats why hes organized a race in which all vehicles on Jammbo will compete! Even Rita with her tricycle! The race begins and the King sets his cockiness free, thus convinc

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 姑毛的舊運動鞋終於破了,女王送給他一雙閃亮的新鞋。姑毛對新運動鞋那令人著迷的潔白感到非常驚訝,令他做不到任何事。問題是……如果你不能穿著波鞋跑過泥濘或用它們踢球,還要它來幹嘛?姑毛是這麼想的。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: When Goomos old sneakers finally break, the Queen gives him a new, shiny pair. Goomo is so taken back with the hypnotic whiteness of his new sneakers, that he is incapable of anything else. The question is...is it worth having sneakers if you cant

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 莉塔和王后在神秘的「幻變森林」中散步時,發現了一隻離家出走的小渡渡鳥,在這個陌生地方迷了路。在救援行動中,莉塔也迷路了。她需要運用自己的聰敏才能找到小渡渡鳥,並回到朋友身邊。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Rita and the Queen take a walk thru the mysterious “changing forest” when they discovera baby Dodo who has strayed away from its parents and is lost in this strange place. During the rescue operation, Rita gets lost as well. She will need to apply he

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 米娜的一項實驗刺激到一隻渡渡蝶,使其長得非常巨大。一開始,牠嚇跑了啫堡上所有人,但渡渡蝶和孩子們很快就會經歷一段美好而意想不到的友誼。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: One of Minas experiments provokes a Dodo-Butterfly to grow at mammoth proportions. At the beginning, the animal scares away the people on Jammbo but the Dodo-Butterfly and the children, will soon experience a beautiful and unexpected friendship.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 莉塔有很多優點,但卻沒有耐性。這就是為何她無法等到床邊故事時間閱讀女王守衛著的書的下一章。她將與比路合作,瘋狂地搶書,並儘快知道故事的結局。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Rita has a lot of good qualities but patience is not one of them. Thats why shes incappable of waiting until bedtime to read the next chapter of a book the Queen is guarding. The kid will join forces with Bello in a crazy attempt to get the book, a

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 米娜因為莉塔失去了她的房子,所以米娜邀請她的朋友來她家一起住。這種新體驗一開始看起來很有趣,最終卻將成為一個真正的挑戰。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Mina losses her house because of Rita, so the little one invites her friend to her house to live with her. This new experience, that seemed so fun at the beginning, will end up being a real challenge.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 對女王來說,國王已經變得太依賴渡渡鳥。國王被逼證明他確實是有能力統治的人。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Its become obvious to Queen that the King has become too dependent on the Dodos.A King should be more self-sufficient! So when the Queen expresses her doubts, King is forced to prove that he is, indeed, someone capable of reigning.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 這是啫堡一個昏暗落雨的下午!孩子們因為不能出去而很難過,所以國王提議一個有趣的活動:輪流講故事。他們將共同創作一個令他們驚喜的故事,甚至將牠們變成……怪物!
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Its a dark and rainy afternoon in Jammbo. The kids are sad because they cant go out, so the King proposes a fun activity: Telling a story taking turns. All toghether, theyll create a story that will surprise them and even transform them into ... m

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 比路驚訝地聽到國王說施比受更為有福。這怎麼可能?比路竭盡全力證明這一理論。不幸的是,他的嘗試不適用於姑毛。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Bello is very surprised when he hears the King saying that its better to give gifts than to receive them. How can that be possible? Bello will do his best to prove that theory. Unfortunately his attempts will not turn out right for Goomo.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 誰說你不能一心二用?比路會嘗試證明這是可能的,並會在慶祝生日的同時嘗試照顧國王。他會成功嗎?
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Who says you cant do two things at the same time? Bello will try to prove that such a thing is possible and will try to take care of the King while celebrating a birthday. Will he succeed?

epg.programme_title_tc: 史汀奇與積克的動物秀 #1
epg.programme_title_en: Animal Show With Stinky And Jake #1
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 史汀奇和積克歡迎獵豹和湯氏瞪羚來到節目。節目重點是獵食者的習性和動物的速度。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Stinky and Jake welcome a Cheetah and a Thomsons Gazelle to the show. Show elements focus on predatory habits and animal speed.

epg.programme_title_tc: 史汀奇與積克的動物秀 #2
epg.programme_title_en: Animal Show With Stinky And Jake #2
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 史汀奇和積克歡迎海豚和果蝠來到節目。即使牠們的棲息地南轅北轍,但同樣使用迴聲定位來導航。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Stinky and Jake welcome a Dolphin and Fruit Bat to the show. Both animals use echo-location for navigation despite their very different habitats.

epg.programme_title_tc: 史汀奇與積克的動物秀 #3
epg.programme_title_en: Animal Show With Stinky And Jake #3
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 史汀奇和積克歡迎澳洲本土的樹熊和鴕鳥來到節目。樹熊揀飲擇食,而鴕鳥則飢不擇食!
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Stinky and Jake welcome a Koala and an Ostrich, both natives of Australia, to the show. While the Koala is a fussy eater, Ostriches will eat anything!

epg.programme_title_tc: 史汀奇與積克的動物秀 #4
epg.programme_title_en: Animal Show With Stinky And Jake #4
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 史汀奇和積克歡迎鱷魚和穿山甲來到節目。牠們都有堅韌的皮膚,可作一身堅固裝甲防禦獵食者。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Stinky and Jake welcome a Crocodile and an Armadillo to the show. Both of these animals have tough skin that works as a strong armor for defense from predators.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 花園侏儒先生把噴嚏打到鑿奇身上,並把自己一部分魔力轉移給他,到底之後會發生甚麼事?
epg.episode_synopsis_en: What happens when Mr. Garden Gnome sneezes onto Chalky and transfers some of his magical powers to him?

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 斯芬克斯叔叔、商人先生和阿米爾之間因溝通不當而鬧出不快。孩子們必須弄清楚發生甚麼事,並幫每個人解決問題。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: There’s a miscommunication between Uncle Sphinx, Mr. Merchant and Aamil that causes some unhappiness. The children have to figure out what happened and help straighten things out with each person.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 數隻遷徙的螃蟹霸了沉船作為新家園,令紅鬍子十分沮喪。 小孩們必須幫紅鬍子和莫里斯趕走牠們。他們會怎樣做?
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Several migrating crabs claim the Shipwreck as their new home, much to Redbeards dismay. The children have to help Redbeard and Maurice chase them away. How will they do it?

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 遊戲室的燈熄滅了。伸手不見五指很是可怕,但小孩們知道一根有著永恆之光的蠟燭!要取得它的話,他們必須面對恐懼,並進入前所未見最黑暗的洞穴!
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The lights in the playroom go out. Being in the dark is scary, but the children learn about a candle with an everlasting light! To retrieve it, they have to face their fears and enter the darkest cave ever!

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 拔迪先生似乎總是很暴躁。小孩們想出一個讓拔迪先生眉開眼笑的計劃,但卻事與願違。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Mr. Buddy always seems to be very cranky. The children come up with a plan.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 莫里斯不小心把紅鬍子的鐵鈎弄彎了。小孩們幫紅鬍子找到一些相當獨特的代鈎,但紅鬍子懷疑它們有多實用。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Maurice accidentally bends Redbeards hook out of shape.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 探險家先生找到一張地圖,上面有通往獎勵密室的線索,但他毫無頭緒。小孩們渴望幫探險家先生破解線索,並找出密室裡有甚麼獎勵等待著他們。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Mr. Explorer finds a map with clues leading to a secret chamber of rewards.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 小孩們在金銀島尋找黃金茉莉花。不過紅鬍子船長打算先下手為強!他會成功嗎?
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The children go in search of the Golden Jasmine Flower on Treasure Island.

epg.programme_title_tc: 野生遊俠里奧新加坡外傳 #9
epg.programme_title_en: Leo The Wildlife Ranger: Singapore Edition #9
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 一輛魯莽的汽車導致樹頂橋倒塌,一隻稀有的小猴子與家人失散。小遊俠必須盡快找到一家團聚的方法。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: When a reckless car causes a treetop bridge to collapse, a young rare monkey is separated from its family.

epg.programme_title_tc: 野生遊俠里奧新加坡外傳 #10
epg.programme_title_en: Leo The Wildlife Ranger: Singapore Edition #10
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 薩莉認為她發現了一條可以瞬移的蛇,但原來這條蛇還有另一種有趣的能力。小遊俠使用它的特殊技能將其轉移到安全地方。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Zari thinks that she has spotted a snake that can teleport.

epg.programme_title_tc: 野生遊俠里奧新加坡外傳 #11
epg.programme_title_en: Leo The Wildlife Ranger: Singapore Edition #11
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 薩莉在一個廢棄的魚缸裡發現了一條彈塗魚,誤將它放生到海裡!小遊俠必須爭分奪秒,拯救彈塗魚,並將其帶回紅樹林。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Zari finds a mudskipper in an abandoned fish tank and releases it into the sea by mistake!

epg.programme_title_tc: 野生遊俠里奧新加坡外傳 #12
epg.programme_title_en: Leo The Wildlife Ranger: Singapore Edition #12
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 阿佳需要遊俠的幫助,因為他的大綠葉鵯朋友完全拒絕唱歌。小遊俠開始尋找完美的鳴禽來完成葉鵯的二重唱願望。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Kai needs the rangers help when his Greater Green Leafbird friend absolutely refuses to sing.

epg.programme_title_tc: 野生遊俠里奧新加坡外傳 #13
epg.programme_title_en: Leo The Wildlife Ranger: Singapore Edition #13
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 一隻巨大的蜘蛛決定在薩莉的窗戶裡閒逛,但當小遊俠準備抓蜘蛛,牠就消失了!小遊俠現在必須齊心協力找到難以捉摸的巨人,並將牠安全送回森林的家中。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A huge spider has decided to hang out in Zaris window.

epg.programme_title_tc: 野生遊俠里奧新加坡外傳 #14
epg.programme_title_en: Leo The Wildlife Ranger: Singapore Edition #14
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 薩莉在從樹上掉下來的鳥巢中發現一隻幼鳥,她不小心把牠留在一輛開走的汽車車頂,令小遊俠開展一場高速汽車追逐戰,嘗試將這隻幼鳥找回來。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Zari finds a baby bird in a nest that has fallen out of a tree.

epg.programme_title_tc: 野生遊俠里奧新加坡外傳 第2季 #1
epg.programme_title_en: Leo The Wildlife Ranger: Singapore Edition S2 #1
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 一隻小鳥經過疲憊的長途飛行後,不慎撞進了高樓大廈的玻璃窗。少年遊俠必須在牠下次長途飛行前進行營救,並讓牠與鳥群團聚。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: After a long and tiring flight, a bird accidentally flies into the windowpane of a high-rise building.

epg.programme_title_tc: 野生遊俠里奧新加坡外傳 第2季 #2
epg.programme_title_en: Leo The Wildlife Ranger: Singapore Edition S2 #2
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 少年遊俠要盡快助受傷的皇蛾找到朋友。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The Junior Rangers help an injured Atlas Moth find his friend before time runs out.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在《小毛孩動腦筋》考驗你的動物知識- 一個獨一無二的遊戲節目!
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Test your animal knowledge on ZooMoos Got Brains -- A game show like no other!

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 這一集講述的是動物發出的令人驚嘆的聲音。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: This episode is all about the amazing noises that animals make.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 本集講述的是動物王國中令人毛骨悚然的生物。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: This episode is all about creepy creatures from the animal kingdom.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 本集講述了七大洋中最狡猾、最貪婪、最狡猾的動物。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: This episode about the sneakiest greediest cunningest animals that ever sailed the seven seas.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 準備把口張大—因為今集主題是嘴巴!對於一些動物來說—越大越好!這就是為何今天的測驗都關於大嘴巴!
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Todays show is all about animals with big mouth!

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 我們的舌頭幫我們品嚐食物,但你不會相信動物們會用舌頭做出如此驚人的事。今天的測驗是關於靈巧的舌頭!
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Todays quiz is all about animals with Tricky Tongues!

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 歡迎來到沙漠!它很乾燥!很熱!而且很致命!這就是為何今集叫-危險的沙漠!
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Todays show is about Dangerous Deserts!

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 你喜歡和可愛的貓狗一起玩嗎?好吧,在野外有更大的混種貓狗……牠們是今天測驗的明星!全都關於大型貓科動物和野狗的!
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Todays show is all about big cats and wild dogs!

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 日食的陰影降臨陽光派,蟲子們享受這場天文現象- 除了蹦士,牠擔心如果缺乏自己的幫助,太陽就不會從藏身處出來。/史角和蹦士猶豫是否要讓雪莉和史汀奇參加牠們的捉迷藏。與一隻行動緩慢的蝸牛和一隻超臭的臭屁蟲捉迷藏太容易了。但事與願違,蟲子們採用史汀奇的推論技巧,遊戲正式開始!
epg.episode_synopsis_en: When Sunny Patch finds itself in the shadow of a solar eclipse, the bugs enjoy the celestial show – all except Bounce, who is afraid that the Sun won’t come out from hiding unless he helps./ Squirt and Bounce hesitate to include Shelley and Stinky in

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在一次參觀捕蠅草維納斯的實地考察中,螳螂先生講述「螳螂大師」的傳奇故事,幫蟲子們瞭解如何在食蟲植物附近保持安全。/螳螂先生建議學生大肆慶祝「擁抱蟲子日」,韋高和蹦士決定不了想在這特別日子扮演甚麼蟲子。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: During a field trip to view the Venus Flytrap, Mister Mantis tells the legendary story of “Master Mantis” to help the bugs understand how to stay safe around a bug eating plant./ Wiggle and Bounce can’t decide what bug they want to be for the “Hug-A-

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 比路和姑毛夢想成為真正的超級英雄,所以他們請米娜訓練他們。她恰如其分,只是比路還沒有準備好忍受漫長而艱苦的訓練。他放棄並選擇了一項更容易的活動。那是他以後會後悔的事。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Bello and Goomo dream of becoming real super heroes so they ask Mina to train them.She sets out to do a great jobbut Bello isnt ready to endure the long and hard training. He gives up and choses an easier activity. Something he will later regret.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 當其他人都得到讚揚和掌聲時,要站著面對並不總是那麼容易。比路嘗試在他朋友的表演中搶盡風頭,讓他們非常沮喪,比路需要分享他的一些才能來解決問題。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: It´s not always easy to stand still when everyone else gets praise and applause. Bello will try to steal the show during his friends performances. They get so upset that Bello will need to share some of his talent to fix things.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 比路和姑毛發現城堡裡的所有玩具都放在一個盒子裡,他們面對著一項幾乎不可能完成的任務。雖然誘惑很大,但他們接到嚴格的命令,不能碰盒子,因為他們肯定會弄得一團糟。他們能服從命令,讓城堡一塵不染嗎?
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Bello andy Goomo are faced with an almost impossible task when they discover that all the toys in the castle have been placed in a single box. The temptation is great but they have strict orders not to touch the box for they would surely make a huge

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 還有比在音樂誕生的星球更適合跳舞的地方嗎?啫堡上的每個人都會向您展示一段舞蹈,這樣我們就可以隨著啫堡的節奏一起跳舞。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Is there a better place to dance than the planet where music is born? Every person on Jammbo has a dance to show you so we can all dance together to the rhythm of Jammbo.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 成為啫堡之王並非易事。嗯……是容易的。但國王認為應該更容易,所以他創造了自己的複製人,他能指揮他們在四處做所有艱苦的工作。不出所料,這些複製人就像國王一樣非常懶惰,不但沒有提供幫助,反而成為了啫堡一個日益嚴重的新問題。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Being the King of Jammbo isnt an easy task. Well...yes it is. But the King believes it should even more easy, so he creates clones of himself that he can order around, having them do all the hard work. As expected, these clones, much like the King,a

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 啫堡舉行了另一場有趣的比賽,每個孩子必須在渡渡鳥的幫助下,力所能及找到最大的音樂三葉草。比路遇到要協助他的渡渡鳥時感到吃虧。因牠是比路見過最老、最愛發牢騷的渡渡鳥。不過,比路很快就意識到,這隻特殊的渡渡鳥和他們之間的特殊關係,會帶來比他想像中多的驚喜。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Another fun contest in Jammbo is celebrated, in which each child, with the help of a Dodo, must search for the largest musical clover he can find.Bello feels at a disadvantage when he meets the Dodo who will assist him. This Dodo is the oldest and th

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 國王剛剛調整了他的汽車,所以想讓所有人都見到。這就是為何他組織了一場賽車比賽,啫堡上的所有車輛都將參加!甚至連莉塔和她的三輪車也參賽!比賽開始,國王不再自負,這說服孩子們需要聯合起來,全力以赴贏得勝利!
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The King has just tuned his car and hes not willing for it to go unnoticed.Thats why hes organized a race in which all vehicles on Jammbo will compete! Even Rita with her tricycle! The race begins and the King sets his cockiness free, thus convinc

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 姑毛的舊運動鞋終於破了,女王送給他一雙閃亮的新鞋。姑毛對新運動鞋那令人著迷的潔白感到非常驚訝,令他做不到任何事。問題是……如果你不能穿著波鞋跑過泥濘或用它們踢球,還要它來幹嘛?姑毛是這麼想的。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: When Goomos old sneakers finally break, the Queen gives him a new, shiny pair. Goomo is so taken back with the hypnotic whiteness of his new sneakers, that he is incapable of anything else. The question is...is it worth having sneakers if you cant

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 莉塔和王后在神秘的「幻變森林」中散步時,發現了一隻離家出走的小渡渡鳥,在這個陌生地方迷了路。在救援行動中,莉塔也迷路了。她需要運用自己的聰敏才能找到小渡渡鳥,並回到朋友身邊。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Rita and the Queen take a walk thru the mysterious “changing forest” when they discovera baby Dodo who has strayed away from its parents and is lost in this strange place. During the rescue operation, Rita gets lost as well. She will need to apply he

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 米娜的一項實驗刺激到一隻渡渡蝶,使其長得非常巨大。一開始,牠嚇跑了啫堡上所有人,但渡渡蝶和孩子們很快就會經歷一段美好而意想不到的友誼。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: One of Minas experiments provokes a Dodo-Butterfly to grow at mammoth proportions. At the beginning, the animal scares away the people on Jammbo but the Dodo-Butterfly and the children, will soon experience a beautiful and unexpected friendship.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 莉塔有很多優點,但卻沒有耐性。這就是為何她無法等到床邊故事時間閱讀女王守衛著的書的下一章。她將與比路合作,瘋狂地搶書,並儘快知道故事的結局。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Rita has a lot of good qualities but patience is not one of them. Thats why shes incappable of waiting until bedtime to read the next chapter of a book the Queen is guarding. The kid will join forces with Bello in a crazy attempt to get the book, a

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 米娜因為莉塔失去了她的房子,所以米娜邀請她的朋友來她家一起住。這種新體驗一開始看起來很有趣,最終卻將成為一個真正的挑戰。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Mina losses her house because of Rita, so the little one invites her friend to her house to live with her. This new experience, that seemed so fun at the beginning, will end up being a real challenge.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 對女王來說,國王已經變得太依賴渡渡鳥。國王被逼證明他確實是有能力統治的人。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Its become obvious to Queen that the King has become too dependent on the Dodos.A King should be more self-sufficient! So when the Queen expresses her doubts, King is forced to prove that he is, indeed, someone capable of reigning.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 這是啫堡一個昏暗落雨的下午!孩子們因為不能出去而很難過,所以國王提議一個有趣的活動:輪流講故事。他們將共同創作一個令他們驚喜的故事,甚至將牠們變成……怪物!
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Its a dark and rainy afternoon in Jammbo. The kids are sad because they cant go out, so the King proposes a fun activity: Telling a story taking turns. All toghether, theyll create a story that will surprise them and even transform them into ... m

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 比路驚訝地聽到國王說施比受更為有福。這怎麼可能?比路竭盡全力證明這一理論。不幸的是,他的嘗試不適用於姑毛。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Bello is very surprised when he hears the King saying that its better to give gifts than to receive them. How can that be possible? Bello will do his best to prove that theory. Unfortunately his attempts will not turn out right for Goomo.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 誰說你不能一心二用?比路會嘗試證明這是可能的,並會在慶祝生日的同時嘗試照顧國王。他會成功嗎?
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Who says you cant do two things at the same time? Bello will try to prove that such a thing is possible and will try to take care of the King while celebrating a birthday. Will he succeed?

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 日食的陰影降臨陽光派,蟲子們享受這場天文現象- 除了蹦士,牠擔心如果缺乏自己的幫助,太陽就不會從藏身處出來。/史角和蹦士猶豫是否要讓雪莉和史汀奇參加牠們的捉迷藏。與一隻行動緩慢的蝸牛和一隻超臭的臭屁蟲捉迷藏太容易了。但事與願違,蟲子們採用史汀奇的推論技巧,遊戲正式開始!
epg.episode_synopsis_en: When Sunny Patch finds itself in the shadow of a solar eclipse, the bugs enjoy the celestial show – all except Bounce, who is afraid that the Sun won’t come out from hiding unless he helps./ Squirt and Bounce hesitate to include Shelley and Stinky in

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在一次參觀捕蠅草維納斯的實地考察中,螳螂先生講述「螳螂大師」的傳奇故事,幫蟲子們瞭解如何在食蟲植物附近保持安全。/螳螂先生建議學生大肆慶祝「擁抱蟲子日」,韋高和蹦士決定不了想在這特別日子扮演甚麼蟲子。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: During a field trip to view the Venus Flytrap, Mister Mantis tells the legendary story of “Master Mantis” to help the bugs understand how to stay safe around a bug eating plant./ Wiggle and Bounce can’t decide what bug they want to be for the “Hug-A-

epg.programme_title_tc: 野生遊俠里奧新加坡外傳 #9
epg.programme_title_en: Leo The Wildlife Ranger: Singapore Edition #9
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 一輛魯莽的汽車導致樹頂橋倒塌,一隻稀有的小猴子與家人失散。小遊俠必須盡快找到一家團聚的方法。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: When a reckless car causes a treetop bridge to collapse, a young rare monkey is separated from its family.

epg.programme_title_tc: 野生遊俠里奧新加坡外傳 #10
epg.programme_title_en: Leo The Wildlife Ranger: Singapore Edition #10
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 薩莉認為她發現了一條可以瞬移的蛇,但原來這條蛇還有另一種有趣的能力。小遊俠使用它的特殊技能將其轉移到安全地方。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Zari thinks that she has spotted a snake that can teleport.

epg.programme_title_tc: 野生遊俠里奧新加坡外傳 #11
epg.programme_title_en: Leo The Wildlife Ranger: Singapore Edition #11
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 薩莉在一個廢棄的魚缸裡發現了一條彈塗魚,誤將它放生到海裡!小遊俠必須爭分奪秒,拯救彈塗魚,並將其帶回紅樹林。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Zari finds a mudskipper in an abandoned fish tank and releases it into the sea by mistake!

epg.programme_title_tc: 野生遊俠里奧新加坡外傳 #12
epg.programme_title_en: Leo The Wildlife Ranger: Singapore Edition #12
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 阿佳需要遊俠的幫助,因為他的大綠葉鵯朋友完全拒絕唱歌。小遊俠開始尋找完美的鳴禽來完成葉鵯的二重唱願望。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Kai needs the rangers help when his Greater Green Leafbird friend absolutely refuses to sing.

epg.programme_title_tc: 野生遊俠里奧新加坡外傳 #13
epg.programme_title_en: Leo The Wildlife Ranger: Singapore Edition #13
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 一隻巨大的蜘蛛決定在薩莉的窗戶裡閒逛,但當小遊俠準備抓蜘蛛,牠就消失了!小遊俠現在必須齊心協力找到難以捉摸的巨人,並將牠安全送回森林的家中。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A huge spider has decided to hang out in Zaris window.

epg.programme_title_tc: 野生遊俠里奧新加坡外傳 #14
epg.programme_title_en: Leo The Wildlife Ranger: Singapore Edition #14
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 薩莉在從樹上掉下來的鳥巢中發現一隻幼鳥,她不小心把牠留在一輛開走的汽車車頂,令小遊俠開展一場高速汽車追逐戰,嘗試將這隻幼鳥找回來。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Zari finds a baby bird in a nest that has fallen out of a tree.

epg.programme_title_tc: 野生遊俠里奧新加坡外傳 第2季 #1
epg.programme_title_en: Leo The Wildlife Ranger: Singapore Edition S2 #1
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 一隻小鳥經過疲憊的長途飛行後,不慎撞進了高樓大廈的玻璃窗。少年遊俠必須在牠下次長途飛行前進行營救,並讓牠與鳥群團聚。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: After a long and tiring flight, a bird accidentally flies into the windowpane of a high-rise building.

epg.programme_title_tc: 野生遊俠里奧新加坡外傳 第2季 #2
epg.programme_title_en: Leo The Wildlife Ranger: Singapore Edition S2 #2
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 少年遊俠要盡快助受傷的皇蛾找到朋友。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The Junior Rangers help an injured Atlas Moth find his friend before time runs out.

epg.programme_title_tc: 史汀奇與積克的動物秀 #1
epg.programme_title_en: Animal Show With Stinky And Jake #1
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 史汀奇和積克歡迎獵豹和湯氏瞪羚來到節目。節目重點是獵食者的習性和動物的速度。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Stinky and Jake welcome a Cheetah and a Thomsons Gazelle to the show. Show elements focus on predatory habits and animal speed.

epg.programme_title_tc: 史汀奇與積克的動物秀 #2
epg.programme_title_en: Animal Show With Stinky And Jake #2
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 史汀奇和積克歡迎海豚和果蝠來到節目。即使牠們的棲息地南轅北轍,但同樣使用迴聲定位來導航。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Stinky and Jake welcome a Dolphin and Fruit Bat to the show. Both animals use echo-location for navigation despite their very different habitats.

epg.programme_title_tc: 史汀奇與積克的動物秀 #3
epg.programme_title_en: Animal Show With Stinky And Jake #3
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 史汀奇和積克歡迎澳洲本土的樹熊和鴕鳥來到節目。樹熊揀飲擇食,而鴕鳥則飢不擇食!
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Stinky and Jake welcome a Koala and an Ostrich, both natives of Australia, to the show. While the Koala is a fussy eater, Ostriches will eat anything!

epg.programme_title_tc: 史汀奇與積克的動物秀 #4
epg.programme_title_en: Animal Show With Stinky And Jake #4
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 史汀奇和積克歡迎鱷魚和穿山甲來到節目。牠們都有堅韌的皮膚,可作一身堅固裝甲防禦獵食者。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Stinky and Jake welcome a Crocodile and an Armadillo to the show. Both of these animals have tough skin that works as a strong armor for defense from predators.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 女王去度假,留給國王很多職務。他立即採取行動,找其他人來做。莉塔肯幫助國王……如果她能成為啫堡的女王!起初,所有孩子都很高興自己有份負責。不過,很快樂趣和遊戲就被只有莉塔開心的遊戲所取代。小女王必須意識到這種權力是如何沖昏她的頭腦。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The Queen goes on vacation, leaving King with lots of responsibilities. He leaps into action, finding someone else to do it. Rita will help the King...if she’s made Queen of Jammbo! At first, all the kids are happy one of their own is in charge. But,

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 孩子們圍坐在篝火旁講恐怖故事。姑毛講述了最可怕的怪物故事,然後去吃點心。不過,他走得太遠!其他人必須在黑暗的樹林裡尋找他!神秘的影子和聲音很快讓他們都以為有怪物在跟蹤他們!
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The kids are sitting around a campfire telling scary stories. Goomo tells the scariest monster story and then goes off to get a snack. But, he’s gone too long! The others must look for him in the dark woods! Before long mysterious shadow and sounds h

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 啫喱星頌揚音樂、樂趣和友誼。加入貝洛和他的朋友們的喜劇冒險之旅,學習在神奇的詹博星球(宇宙音樂的起源)上和諧相處。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Bello makes a mistake and decides to make up a story, which is hard to believe. Mina gets angry and will put him to the test: the Candy of Truth. A sweet that makes you float every time you lie. Bello accepts the challenge and a spiral of lies and da

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 米娜嘗試打造啫堡史上最驚人的韆鞦來取悅國王。不幸的是,這位年輕的科學家很快就發現,無論多麼先進的技術,都無法取締團隊合作和友誼。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Mina tries to please the King by building the most amazing swing in the history of Jammbo. Unfortunately, the young scientist will soon discover that no matter how advanced technology is, it will never substitute teamwork and friendship.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 小遊俠嘗試解決怪奇鷸鴕的案件,這正正考驗他們的偵探技能。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The Junior Rangers put their detective skills to the test as they attempt to solve the case of the kooky Kiwi.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 嘉豪的全地形車被針鼴侵襲!小遊俠能幫他拿回珍貴的車嗎?
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Kyles ATV is invaded by Echidnas! Can the Junior Rangers help him get his precious vehicle back?

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 小遊俠嘗試幫膨腹海馬安排約會,空氣中瀰漫著愛意。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Love is in the air as the Junior Rangers try to set up a date for the Big-Belly Seahorse.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 小遊俠著手從一隻真正的紅大袋鼠手中救出嘉豪心愛的玩具袋鼠-斯黛娜。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The Junior Rangers set out to rescue Kyles beloved toy kangaroo, Stella, from an actual Red Kangaroo.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 誰在那裡?閃電剛發現了另一隻很棒的生物,他可以把牠收錄到自己的動物字母表中!
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Flash has just spotted another cool creature he can add to his Animal Alphabet!

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 誰在那裡?閃電剛發現了另一隻很棒的生物,他可以把牠收錄到自己的動物字母表中!
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Flash has just spotted another cool creature he can add to his Animal Alphabet!

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 誰在那裡?閃電剛發現了另一隻很棒的生物,他可以把牠收錄到自己的動物字母表中!
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Flash has just spotted another cool creature he can add to his Animal Alphabet!

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 奧寶寶擁有世上最嘈雜的睡房。在裡面睡覺的時候,神奇的動物卻在外面發出一些非常奇怪的聲音。你能幫助奧寶寶找出是誰發出如此可怕的噪音嗎?

epg.episode_synopsis_en: ZooMoo teams compete in a quiz show about astounding animals.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: ZooMoo teams compete in a quiz show about animals with beautiful teeth.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 查克和狐猴為大家盤點五位最瘋狂的食客。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Chuck and Lemur count down the top five crazy eaters.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: Chuck and Lemur count down the top five deep sea divers.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 還有比在音樂誕生的星球更適合跳舞的地方嗎?啫堡上的每個人都會向您展示一段舞蹈,這樣我們就可以隨著啫堡的節奏一起跳舞。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Is there a better place to dance than the planet where music is born? Every person on Jammbo has a dance to show you so we can all dance together to the rhythm of Jammbo.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 《小毛孩大百科》能解答小孩們一直喜愛的動物的疑問。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: ZooMooPedia answers the questions kids have always wanted to know about their favourite animals

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 盧賓浩了解到保持海灘清潔的重要性。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Lubinho learns the importance of keeping the beach clean.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 像猩猩一樣站起來盪鞦韆!
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Get up and swing just like an orangutan!

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 小孩們和外星人一起在太空舞蹈大賽中比「舞」!誰能獲得全宇宙最佳舞者的殊榮?
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The children compete in a space dance competition with aliens!

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 炎熱的天氣把大花園裡的水都曬乾了。小孩們必須幫助他們的朋友找到水源,並拯救大花園免於消亡。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The hot weather has dried up all the water in the Big Garden.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 阿添想玩迷你籃球,但其他小孩都不想玩那遊戲。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Tim wants to play mini basketball, but none of the other children want to play that game.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 比利不熱衷參加其他小孩想玩的一些嘉年華遊戲。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Billy is not keen on taking part in some of the carnival games the other children want to play.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 紅鬍子船長偷走了寶拉和她的朋友們製作的紙扇。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Captain Redbeard steals the paper fans that Paula and her friends made.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 小孩們很難準時參加圖騰頭先生的生日驚喜派對。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The children struggle to be on time for Mr. Totemheads surprise birthday party.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 小孩們興奮地去看龍先生的噴火表演。他們能及時趕到嗎?
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The children are excited to watch Mr. Dragons fire-breathing show. Can they get there in time?

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 紅鬍子船長病了,但他不想承認。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Captain Redbeard is sick, but he doesnt want to admit it.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 一些球員開始發脾氣,一場椰子沙灘足球比賽變得緊張起來。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A game of coconut beach soccer becomes stressful when some of the players start throwing tantrums.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 比利希望他有寶拉和阿添那樣的表兄弟姊妹。小孩們幫尋找他的表兄弟姊妹。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Billy wishes he had cousins like Paula and Tim has. The children help to find his cousins.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 比利設法說服寶拉和其他人將探險家先生從尷尬的困境中解救出來。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Billy manages to convince Paula and the others to save Mr Explorer from a sticky situation.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: Captain Redbeard destroys the childrens sandcastles. How to deal with a bully like Redbeard?

epg.episode_synopsis_en: A misunderstanding angers Captain Redbeard and he does something mean to get back at the children.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 紅鬍子船長不斷對莫里斯頤指氣使。他甚至命令莫里斯要快樂。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Captain Redbeard is constantly ordering Maurice around. He even orders Maurice to be happy.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: The Queen goes on vacation, leaving King with lots of responsibilities. He leaps into action, finding someone else to do it. Rita will help the King...if she’s made Queen of Jammbo! At first, all the kids are happy one of their own is in charge. But,

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 孩子們圍坐在篝火旁講恐怖故事。姑毛講述了最可怕的怪物故事,然後去吃點心。不過,他走得太遠!其他人必須在黑暗的樹林裡尋找他!神秘的影子和聲音很快讓他們都以為有怪物在跟蹤他們!
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The kids are sitting around a campfire telling scary stories. Goomo tells the scariest monster story and then goes off to get a snack. But, he’s gone too long! The others must look for him in the dark woods! Before long mysterious shadow and sounds h

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 啫喱星頌揚音樂、樂趣和友誼。加入貝洛和他的朋友們的喜劇冒險之旅,學習在神奇的詹博星球(宇宙音樂的起源)上和諧相處。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Bello makes a mistake and decides to make up a story, which is hard to believe. Mina gets angry and will put him to the test: the Candy of Truth. A sweet that makes you float every time you lie. Bello accepts the challenge and a spiral of lies and da

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 米娜嘗試打造啫堡史上最驚人的韆鞦來取悅國王。不幸的是,這位年輕的科學家很快就發現,無論多麼先進的技術,都無法取締團隊合作和友誼。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Mina tries to please the King by building the most amazing swing in the history of Jammbo. Unfortunately, the young scientist will soon discover that no matter how advanced technology is, it will never substitute teamwork and friendship.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 小遊俠嘗試解決怪奇鷸鴕的案件,這正正考驗他們的偵探技能。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The Junior Rangers put their detective skills to the test as they attempt to solve the case of the kooky Kiwi.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: Kyles ATV is invaded by Echidnas! Can the Junior Rangers help him get his precious vehicle back?

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 小遊俠嘗試幫膨腹海馬安排約會,空氣中瀰漫著愛意。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Love is in the air as the Junior Rangers try to set up a date for the Big-Belly Seahorse.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 小遊俠著手從一隻真正的紅大袋鼠手中救出嘉豪心愛的玩具袋鼠-斯黛娜。

epg.episode_synopsis_en: The Queen goes on vacation, leaving King with lots of responsibilities. He leaps into action, finding someone else to do it. Rita will help the King...if she’s made Queen of Jammbo! At first, all the kids are happy one of their own is in charge. But,

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 孩子們圍坐在篝火旁講恐怖故事。姑毛講述了最可怕的怪物故事,然後去吃點心。不過,他走得太遠!其他人必須在黑暗的樹林裡尋找他!神秘的影子和聲音很快讓他們都以為有怪物在跟蹤他們!
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The kids are sitting around a campfire telling scary stories. Goomo tells the scariest monster story and then goes off to get a snack. But, he’s gone too long! The others must look for him in the dark woods! Before long mysterious shadow and sounds h

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 啫喱星頌揚音樂、樂趣和友誼。加入貝洛和他的朋友們的喜劇冒險之旅,學習在神奇的詹博星球(宇宙音樂的起源)上和諧相處。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Bello makes a mistake and decides to make up a story, which is hard to believe. Mina gets angry and will put him to the test: the Candy of Truth. A sweet that makes you float every time you lie. Bello accepts the challenge and a spiral of lies and da

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 米娜嘗試打造啫堡史上最驚人的韆鞦來取悅國王。不幸的是,這位年輕的科學家很快就發現,無論多麼先進的技術,都無法取締團隊合作和友誼。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Mina tries to please the King by building the most amazing swing in the history of Jammbo. Unfortunately, the young scientist will soon discover that no matter how advanced technology is, it will never substitute teamwork and friendship.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 小遊俠嘗試解決怪奇鷸鴕的案件,這正正考驗他們的偵探技能。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The Junior Rangers put their detective skills to the test as they attempt to solve the case of the kooky Kiwi.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 嘉豪的全地形車被針鼴侵襲!小遊俠能幫他拿回珍貴的車嗎?
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Kyles ATV is invaded by Echidnas! Can the Junior Rangers help him get his precious vehicle back?

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 小遊俠嘗試幫膨腹海馬安排約會,空氣中瀰漫著愛意。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Love is in the air as the Junior Rangers try to set up a date for the Big-Belly Seahorse.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 小遊俠著手從一隻真正的紅大袋鼠手中救出嘉豪心愛的玩具袋鼠-斯黛娜。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The Junior Rangers set out to rescue Kyles beloved toy kangaroo, Stella, from an actual Red Kangaroo.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: Bello is given a very important job---he’s put in charge of running the Music Factory! Though the Queen leaves the instruction manual, Bello ignores it. As soon as she goes off for a much needed rest, the whole operation goes way crazy. The poor dodo

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 莉塔厭倦了她玩的每場比賽都輸掉,所以她用一些小氣的手鐲來助她必勝。儘管一開始她很開心,但卻發現自己掉進一個危險的陷阱,並將使她成為一個失敗者。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Rita is tired of losing at every game she plays so she allies herself with some stingy bracelets that will help her win at absolutely everything. Even though she is happy at first, Rita discovers that she’s fallen into a dangerous trap, which will ma

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 啫堡有麻煩了!它那奇妙的音樂泡泡充滿了垃圾和黏糊糊的東西。經過調查整個星球,國王、王后和孩子們意識到泡泡裡的垃圾正是他們的垃圾!他們齊心協力改變邋遢的習慣,讓啫堡恢復啫喱般的健康。他們在過程中將垃圾回收成大家都能享用的東西。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Jammbo’s in trouble! Its amazing music bubbles are full of trash and gunky goo. After a planet wide investigation, the King, Queen and kids realize that the junk in the bubbles is their own garbage! They work together to change their sloppy habits an

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 多得一些突破性的科學,米娜能夠讓物體和她自己隱形!她看到隱形對她信任的朋友的影響!經過一天的瘋狂事件後,孩子們發現了所有看不見的怪事的罪魁禍首。他們想出一個自己的實驗,看看科學家有多喜歡接受測試!
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Thanks to some breakthrough science, Mina is able to make objects, and herself, invisible! She can’t help but see the effects of invisibility on her unsuspecting friends! After a day of wild happenings the kids discover the culprit of all the invisib

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 這是聖誕島紅蟹大遷徙!小遊俠幫助牠們的旅程盡量安全和舒適。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Its the Christmas Island Red Crabs migration!

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 小遊俠教只能模仿可怕的人造聲音的城市琴鳥,讓牠學會優美的大自然之歌,幫助牠更好地融入野生琴鳥群。不過與眾不同就很糟糕嗎?
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The Junior Rangers teach a city Lyrebird - who can only mimic dreadful man-made sounds - the beautiful song of nature to help him blend in with wild Lyrebirds better. But is it so bad to be different?

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 小遊俠必須為嘉豪找到一個合適的地方來放生他心愛的劇毒寵物紅背蜘蛛-帕克。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The Junior Rangers have to find a suitable place for Kyle to release his beloved venomous pet Redback Spider, Parker.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 阿佳需要小遊俠的幫助,以便將小熊貓的氣味添加到他的氣味炸彈收藏中。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Kai needs the Junior Rangers help to add the smell of a Red Panda to his smell bomb collection.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 啫堡從未經歷過最驚人的事件之一即將發生。姑毛不想錯過它。這就是為何他嘗試向他的朋友隱瞞他的啫喱疹。不幸的是,啫喱疹有無法掩飾的症狀。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: One of the most amazing events that Jammbo has ever experienced is about to occur. And Goomo doesn’t want tomiss it. That’s why he tries to hide his Jelly-Measles from his friends. Unfortunately, the measles have symptoms that are impossible to disgu

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 受到閃電和雷聲的驚嚇,比路和姑毛在音樂工廠尋求庇護。不過進去以後,他們才意識到將迎接更可怕的事;城堡裡有個幽靈嚇壞了渡渡鳥,阻止牠們製造音樂泡泡!如果渡渡鳥停下來,啫堡就沒有音樂。而如果沒有音樂,啫喱星就會凍結!哎呀!男孩們需要找到幽靈,擊潰它並拯救永遠充滿音樂氣息的啫堡!
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Spooked by lighting and thunder, Bello and Goomo seek refuge in the Music Factory. But once inside, they realize there’s much scarier stuff afoot; there’s a ghost in the castle that’s frightening the dodos and keeping them from making music bubbles!

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 國王不想與人分享他的新火箭驅動滑板,所以把它藏在一個魔法盒子裡。姑毛和比路決定取得它,挑戰國王的意願,最終進入一個更大的新世界。一個充滿樂趣和……危險的世界。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The King doesn’t want to share his new rocket powered skateboard so he hides it in a magic box. Goomo and Bello decide to claim it, challenging the King’s wishes, and end up in a new and larger world. A world of fun and….danger.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 皇后心情不好。國王和孩子們同意舉辦有史以來最好的生日派對。不幸的是,每個參與者對於如何組織女王的驚喜派對都有個別非常特別的想法。它的成功將取決於他們「易地而處」的能力。尤其是女王。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The Queen feels gloomy. The King and the children agree to organize the best birthday party ever. Unfortunately each of the participants has a very particular idea as to how to organize the Queen’s surprise party. Its success will depend on their cap

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 與少年遊俠利奧、他的妹妹凱蒂和他們忠誠的狗狗英雄一起,在世界各地進行激動人心的冒險,探索異國風情並了解有關動物和自然的有趣事實。每一集,利奧、凱蒂和英雄在他們知識淵博的朋友遊騎兵洛基的幫助下,幫助不同的動物回到自然棲息地。他們將陪伴一隻無尾熊回澳大利亞,一隻小熊貓回中國,或是一隻電鰻回南美。在 Zo
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Kai hopes to capture the impossible - the exact moment a Tanuki shapeshifts.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 小遊俠能否幫助一條紋腹叉鼻魨完成牠的海底傑作?尤其是途中闖入一條頑皮的鯨魚。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Can the Junior Rangers help a White-spotted Pufferfish complete its underwater masterpiece?

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 一隻西伯利亞花栗鼠偷走了阿佳的氣味囊,裡面裝著一種非常非常稀有動物的氣味。那是甚麼呢?
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A Siberian Chipmunk has stolen Kais smell capsule which holds the smell of a very, very rare animal.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 阿佳做到了!他終於發明了一種動物翻譯器,可以破譯座頭鯨的歌聲!或者是他一廂情願……
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Kai has finally invented an animal translator that can decipher the song of the Humpback Whales!

epg.episode_synopsis_en: The Disk of Sounds has gone crazy and all the sounds in Jammbo have been changed, causing a huge chaos. Bello and Rita willbe in charge of returning each sound to the place where it belongs.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 《小毛孩大百科》能解答小孩們一直喜愛的動物的疑問。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: ZooMooPedia answers the questions kids have always wanted to know about their favourite animals

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 盧賓浩奧學會了不要走太遠,獨自一人時他差點迷路。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Lubinho learns not to go far away and alone, he almost gets lost.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 誰想到綿羊都可以這樣瘋克風?今天我們學習綿羊瘋克舞- 從沙發上起來,穿上舞鞋,搖呀搖,晃呀晃!
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Who knew sheep could be so funky? Today we learn The Funky Sheep Dance.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 曲奇用畫筆、海綿和她的手指畫出了一幅很棒的畫,還畫了一隻可愛的八爪魚!
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Kooki uses a paintbrush, sponges and her fingers to make an awesome painting and creates a cuddly octopus!

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 曲奇製作了一個漂亮的秋天雪球,然後用豆袋製的蘿蔔餵一隻巨大的兔子。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Kooki makes a beautiful autumn snow globe, then feeds a giant bunny with bean bag carrots.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 史汀奇和積克歡迎貓頭鷹和八爪魚來到節目。牠們有相似的視力,並且都有喙!
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Stinky and Jake welcome an Owl and an Octopus to the show. These animals have similar eyesight and both animals also have beaks!

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 魔法面具向祖利安講述一切有關偽裝的事。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Magic Mask tells Junior all about camouflage.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 祖利安和魔術面具遇到了一隻雄性章魚,它施展了驚人的伎倆——用黑墨水雲消失!
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Junior and Magic Mask meet a male octopus with an amazing trick he uses clouds of black ink to disappear!

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 小豬收到一封來信,他的動物朋友有些疑難。小豬能處理好嗎?
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Piglet has received a letter from an animal friend with a problem. Can Piglet fix it?

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 小豬收到一封來信,他的動物朋友有些疑難。小豬能處理好嗎?

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 忽達作為一條年幼毛毛蟲,對作為年幼動物有著獨特的見解。透過她迷人而開朗的方式,我們從她那裡學習到其他小動物的生活。新鄰居在本月搬進樹上的巢,牠們忘記興建浴室,令事情變得一團糟!駝鹿媽媽為了保護她的孩子不受餓狼傷害而放手一搏,忽達學會如何勇敢地保護她自己的孩子—她的朱古力魚!對我們的好友忽達來說,這將
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Flutter loves to watch babies growing up.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 這是擬態章魚和遊俠之間一場捉迷藏惡鬥。牠畢竟是偽裝大師……

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 史汀奇和積克歡迎貓頭鷹和八爪魚來到節目。牠們有相似的視力,並且都有喙!
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Stinky and Jake welcome an Owl and an Octopus to the show. These animals have similar eyesight and both animals also have beaks!

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 魔法面具向祖利安講述一切有關偽裝的事。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Magic Mask tells Junior all about camouflage.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 祖利安和魔術面具遇到了一隻雄性章魚,它施展了驚人的伎倆——用黑墨水雲消失!
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Junior and Magic Mask meet a male octopus with an amazing trick he uses clouds of black ink to disappear!

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 小豬收到一封來信,他的動物朋友有些疑難。小豬能處理好嗎?
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Piglet has received a letter from an animal friend with a problem. Can Piglet fix it?

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 小豬收到一封來信,他的動物朋友有些疑難。小豬能處理好嗎?

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 忽達作為一條年幼毛毛蟲,對作為年幼動物有著獨特的見解。透過她迷人而開朗的方式,我們從她那裡學習到其他小動物的生活。新鄰居在本月搬進樹上的巢,牠們忘記興建浴室,令事情變得一團糟!駝鹿媽媽為了保護她的孩子不受餓狼傷害而放手一搏,忽達學會如何勇敢地保護她自己的孩子—她的朱古力魚!對我們的好友忽達來說,這將
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Flutter loves to watch babies growing up.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 這是擬態章魚和遊俠之間一場捉迷藏惡鬥。牠畢竟是偽裝大師……

epg.episode_synopsis_en: Flutter loves to watch babies growing up.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: Bello is fed up with the Queen, whom he thinks tries to ruin all his adventures and games. On a starry night, full of shooting stars, Bello makes a wish: may the Queen become a young girl again so she can let him do anything he wants. When Bello’s wi

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 今天是姑毛的生日,他有很高期望。不幸的是,他醒來發現珍愛的頭盔不見了!最重要的是,他的朋友們表現得很奇怪,他們似乎都忘記了他的生日。姑毛很樂意讓一切恢復正常。幸運的是,他收到一個驚喜,可以讓這天成為一個非常特別的日子。

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 安高在與比路和姑毛玩耍時弄傷了自己,因此必須在家休息幾天。比路感到內疚,決定搬進安高的房子,直到他的朋友好轉為止。他們對生活的不同看法相交,然後一起發現如果睜大眼睛看一切,即使是最小的細節,也可以很享受。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Ongo hurt himself while playing with Bello and Goomo so he must stay at home to rest for several days. Bello feels guilty and decides to move into Ongo’s house until his friend feels better. Their different views on life will meet and together they’l

epg.episode_synopsis_en: Its Jungle Boys birthday! The children and their jungle friends plan a surprise party, but they have trouble keeping it a secret from Jungle Boy. Will the surprise birthday party be a success?

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 跟比利兔合唱,他在晚餐前學到很多新歌!
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Sing along with Billy Bunny as he learns lots of new songs before dinnertime!

epg.programme_title_en: Leo The Wildlife Ranger: Singapore Edition S2 #11
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 少年遊俠遇到一隻正經歷低谷的灣鱷。對這隻可憐的爬蟲類來說,似乎諸事不宜。當牠在一天中遇到各種問題,少年遊俠就會伸出援手。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The Junior Rangers come across a crocodile that is having the worst of days.

epg.programme_title_tc: 野生遊俠里奧新加坡外傳 第2季 #12
epg.programme_title_en: Leo The Wildlife Ranger: Singapore Edition S2 #12
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 臭鼩一家要逃離一隻飢餓的掠食者,少年遊俠沿途幫助牠們克服障礙。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The Junior Rangers help a family of Asian House Shrews overcome obstacles in their path to escape predator.

epg.programme_title_tc: 野生遊俠里奧新加坡外傳 第2季 #13
epg.programme_title_en: Leo The Wildlife Ranger: Singapore Edition S2 #13
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 薩利的植物上有一隻看似外星人的昆蟲。少年遊俠必須把牠帶到安全的地方,免牠在脫殼後受傷。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: There is an insect on Zari’s plant that looks like an alien.

epg.programme_title_tc: 野生遊俠里奧新加坡外傳 第2季 #14
epg.programme_title_en: Leo The Wildlife Ranger: Singapore Edition S2 #14
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 少年遊俠在森林裡發現了一隻沒有鹿角的小鹿。出於安全考量,遊俠嘗試保護牠不受傷害。不過,他們很快就發現牠還有其他手段自保。留意觀看它們到底是甚麼!
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The Junior Rangers spot a small dear in the forest without any antlers.

epg.programme_title_tc: 野生遊俠里奧新加坡外傳 第2季 #15
epg.programme_title_en: Leo The Wildlife Ranger: Singapore Edition S2 #15
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 薩利發現一隻小鳥被困樹上,而牠的同伴卻不見蹤影。少年遊俠兵分兩路執行任務:一組留下來從掠食者手中保護樹上的小鳥,另一組則去搜救失蹤同伴。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Zari discovers a bird trapped in a tree and its partner is nowhere to be found.

epg.programme_title_tc: 野生遊俠里奧新加坡外傳 第2季 #16
epg.programme_title_en: Leo The Wildlife Ranger: Singapore Edition S2 #16
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 少年遊俠遇到一種可以在逃避掠食者時將尾巴與身體分離的動物。但他們必須從肥皂災難中把牠拯救出來免牠受傷。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The Junior Rangers come across an animal that can separate its tail from its body to escape predators.

epg.programme_title_tc: 野生遊俠里奧新加坡外傳 第2季 #17
epg.programme_title_en: Leo The Wildlife Ranger: Singapore Edition S2 #17
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 少年遊俠發現一隻可愛的海洋動物嬰兒在海中游蕩。要讓牠與母親團聚實在很有挑戰性,尤其嬰兒不斷因其他動物和隨機物件而分心。他們能成功嗎?
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The Junior Rangers find a cute baby sea animal wandering the ocean.

epg.programme_title_tc: 野生遊俠里奧新加坡外傳 第2季 #18
epg.programme_title_en: Leo The Wildlife Ranger: Singapore Edition S2 #18

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 女王去度假,留給國王很多職務。他立即採取行動,找其他人來做。莉塔肯幫助國王……如果她能成為啫堡的女王!起初,所有孩子都很高興自己有份負責。不過,很快樂趣和遊戲就被只有莉塔開心的遊戲所取代。小女王必須意識到這種權力是如何沖昏她的頭腦。

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 孩子們圍坐在篝火旁講恐怖故事。姑毛講述了最可怕的怪物故事,然後去吃點心。不過,他走得太遠!其他人必須在黑暗的樹林裡尋找他!神秘的影子和聲音很快讓他們都以為有怪物在跟蹤他們!
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The kids are sitting around a campfire telling scary stories. Goomo tells the scariest monster story and then goes off to get a snack. But, he’s gone too long! The others must look for him in the dark woods! Before long mysterious shadow and sounds h

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 米娜嘗試打造啫堡史上最驚人的韆鞦來取悅國王。不幸的是,這位年輕的科學家很快就發現,無論多麼先進的技術,都無法取締團隊合作和友誼。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Mina tries to please the King by building the most amazing swing in the history of Jammbo. Unfortunately, the young scientist will soon discover that no matter how advanced technology is, it will never substitute teamwork and friendship.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 比路被委派一項非常重要的工作—負責管理音樂工廠!儘管女王留下了說明書,比路卻無視它。她一去休息,整個運作就變得瘋狂。可憐的渡渡鳥努力把事情做好,但欠缺知情的老闆,災難迫在眉睫。比路必須快速學習,準備工作是正確執行任何工作的關鍵!

epg.episode_synopsis_en: Thanks to some breakthrough science, Mina is able to make objects, and herself, invisible! She can’t help but see the effects of invisibility on her unsuspecting friends! After a day of wild happenings the kids discover the culprit of all the invisib

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 啫堡從未經歷過最驚人的事件之一即將發生。姑毛不想錯過它。這就是為何他嘗試向他的朋友隱瞞他的啫喱疹。不幸的是,啫喱疹有無法掩飾的症狀。

epg.episode_synopsis_en: Spooked by lighting and thunder, Bello and Goomo seek refuge in the Music Factory. But once inside, they realize there’s much scarier stuff afoot; there’s a ghost in the castle that’s frightening the dodos and keeping them from making music bubbles!

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 國王不想與人分享他的新火箭驅動滑板,所以把它藏在一個魔法盒子裡。姑毛和比路決定取得它,挑戰國王的意願,最終進入一個更大的新世界。一個充滿樂趣和……危險的世界。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The King doesn’t want to share his new rocket powered skateboard so he hides it in a magic box. Goomo and Bello decide to claim it, challenging the King’s wishes, and end up in a new and larger world. A world of fun and….danger.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: Billy is not keen on taking part in some of the carnival games the other children want to play.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 紅鬍子船長偷走了寶拉和她的朋友們製作的紙扇。

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 小孩們很難準時參加圖騰頭先生的生日驚喜派對。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The children struggle to be on time for Mr. Totemheads surprise birthday party.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 小孩們興奮地去看龍先生的噴火表演。他們能及時趕到嗎?
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The children are excited to watch Mr. Dragons fire-breathing show. Can they get there in time?

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 紅鬍子船長病了,但他不想承認。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Captain Redbeard is sick, but he doesnt want to admit it.

epg.programme_title_en: Leo The Wildlife Ranger: Singapore Edition S2 #11
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 少年遊俠遇到一隻正經歷低谷的灣鱷。對這隻可憐的爬蟲類來說,似乎諸事不宜。當牠在一天中遇到各種問題,少年遊俠就會伸出援手。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The Junior Rangers come across a crocodile that is having the worst of days.

epg.programme_title_en: Leo The Wildlife Ranger: Singapore Edition S2 #12

epg.episode_synopsis_en: The Junior Rangers help a family of Asian House Shrews overcome obstacles in their path to escape predator.

epg.programme_title_tc: 野生遊俠里奧新加坡外傳 第2季 #13

epg.episode_synopsis_en: There is an insect on Zari’s plant that looks like an alien.

epg.programme_title_en: Leo The Wildlife Ranger: Singapore Edition S2 #14
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 少年遊俠在森林裡發現了一隻沒有鹿角的小鹿。出於安全考量,遊俠嘗試保護牠不受傷害。不過,他們很快就發現牠還有其他手段自保。留意觀看它們到底是甚麼!
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The Junior Rangers spot a small dear in the forest without any antlers.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: Zari discovers a bird trapped in a tree and its partner is nowhere to be found.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 少年遊俠遇到一種可以在逃避掠食者時將尾巴與身體分離的動物。但他們必須從肥皂災難中把牠拯救出來免牠受傷。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The Junior Rangers come across an animal that can separate its tail from its body to escape predators.

epg.programme_title_en: Leo The Wildlife Ranger: Singapore Edition S2 #17
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 少年遊俠發現一隻可愛的海洋動物嬰兒在海中游蕩。要讓牠與母親團聚實在很有挑戰性,尤其嬰兒不斷因其他動物和隨機物件而分心。他們能成功嗎?
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The Junior Rangers find a cute baby sea animal wandering the ocean.

epg.programme_title_en: Leo The Wildlife Ranger: Singapore Edition S2 #18
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 少年遊俠的任務是讓黃蜂遠離蜂巢。姬蒂有一個新設備可以提供幫助……前題是她能使它正常運作。他們能成功完成任務嗎?
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The Junior Rangers are on a mission to keep hornets away from a beehive.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 這一集講述的是可愛的小動物寶寶以及他們的媽媽和爸爸如何照顧他們。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: This episode is all about adorable little coochie-coo animal babies.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: Dragon finds out that learning a new language is like a secret password into another world./ When Shimmer’s friend, Cookie, loses her butterfly instincts, Miss Spider and her bug clan must help her regain them before winter arrives in Sunny Patch.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 女王去度假,留給國王很多職務。他立即採取行動,找其他人來做。莉塔肯幫助國王……如果她能成為啫堡的女王!起初,所有孩子都很高興自己有份負責。不過,很快樂趣和遊戲就被只有莉塔開心的遊戲所取代。小女王必須意識到這種權力是如何沖昏她的頭腦。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The Queen goes on vacation, leaving King with lots of responsibilities. He leaps into action, finding someone else to do it. Rita will help the King...if she’s made Queen of Jammbo! At first, all the kids are happy one of their own is in charge. But,

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 孩子們圍坐在篝火旁講恐怖故事。姑毛講述了最可怕的怪物故事,然後去吃點心。不過,他走得太遠!其他人必須在黑暗的樹林裡尋找他!神秘的影子和聲音很快讓他們都以為有怪物在跟蹤他們!
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The kids are sitting around a campfire telling scary stories. Goomo tells the scariest monster story and then goes off to get a snack. But, he’s gone too long! The others must look for him in the dark woods! Before long mysterious shadow and sounds h

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 啫喱星頌揚音樂、樂趣和友誼。加入貝洛和他的朋友們的喜劇冒險之旅,學習在神奇的詹博星球(宇宙音樂的起源)上和諧相處。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Bello makes a mistake and decides to make up a story, which is hard to believe. Mina gets angry and will put him to the test: the Candy of Truth. A sweet that makes you float every time you lie. Bello accepts the challenge and a spiral of lies and da

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 米娜嘗試打造啫堡史上最驚人的韆鞦來取悅國王。不幸的是,這位年輕的科學家很快就發現,無論多麼先進的技術,都無法取締團隊合作和友誼。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Mina tries to please the King by building the most amazing swing in the history of Jammbo. Unfortunately, the young scientist will soon discover that no matter how advanced technology is, it will never substitute teamwork and friendship.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 比路被委派一項非常重要的工作—負責管理音樂工廠!儘管女王留下了說明書,比路卻無視它。她一去休息,整個運作就變得瘋狂。可憐的渡渡鳥努力把事情做好,但欠缺知情的老闆,災難迫在眉睫。比路必須快速學習,準備工作是正確執行任何工作的關鍵!
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Bello is given a very important job---he’s put in charge of running the Music Factory! Though the Queen leaves the instruction manual, Bello ignores it. As soon as she goes off for a much needed rest, the whole operation goes way crazy. The poor dodo

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 莉塔厭倦了她玩的每場比賽都輸掉,所以她用一些小氣的手鐲來助她必勝。儘管一開始她很開心,但卻發現自己掉進一個危險的陷阱,並將使她成為一個失敗者。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Rita is tired of losing at every game she plays so she allies herself with some stingy bracelets that will help her win at absolutely everything. Even though she is happy at first, Rita discovers that she’s fallen into a dangerous trap, which will ma

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 啫堡有麻煩了!它那奇妙的音樂泡泡充滿了垃圾和黏糊糊的東西。經過調查整個星球,國王、王后和孩子們意識到泡泡裡的垃圾正是他們的垃圾!他們齊心協力改變邋遢的習慣,讓啫堡恢復啫喱般的健康。他們在過程中將垃圾回收成大家都能享用的東西。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Jammbo’s in trouble! Its amazing music bubbles are full of trash and gunky goo. After a planet wide investigation, the King, Queen and kids realize that the junk in the bubbles is their own garbage! They work together to change their sloppy habits an

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 多得一些突破性的科學,米娜能夠讓物體和她自己隱形!她看到隱形對她信任的朋友的影響!經過一天的瘋狂事件後,孩子們發現了所有看不見的怪事的罪魁禍首。他們想出一個自己的實驗,看看科學家有多喜歡接受測試!
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Thanks to some breakthrough science, Mina is able to make objects, and herself, invisible! She can’t help but see the effects of invisibility on her unsuspecting friends! After a day of wild happenings the kids discover the culprit of all the invisib

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 啫堡從未經歷過最驚人的事件之一即將發生。姑毛不想錯過它。這就是為何他嘗試向他的朋友隱瞞他的啫喱疹。不幸的是,啫喱疹有無法掩飾的症狀。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: One of the most amazing events that Jammbo has ever experienced is about to occur. And Goomo doesn’t want tomiss it. That’s why he tries to hide his Jelly-Measles from his friends. Unfortunately, the measles have symptoms that are impossible to disgu

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 受到閃電和雷聲的驚嚇,比路和姑毛在音樂工廠尋求庇護。不過進去以後,他們才意識到將迎接更可怕的事;城堡裡有個幽靈嚇壞了渡渡鳥,阻止牠們製造音樂泡泡!如果渡渡鳥停下來,啫堡就沒有音樂。而如果沒有音樂,啫喱星就會凍結!哎呀!男孩們需要找到幽靈,擊潰它並拯救永遠充滿音樂氣息的啫堡!
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Spooked by lighting and thunder, Bello and Goomo seek refuge in the Music Factory. But once inside, they realize there’s much scarier stuff afoot; there’s a ghost in the castle that’s frightening the dodos and keeping them from making music bubbles!

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 國王不想與人分享他的新火箭驅動滑板,所以把它藏在一個魔法盒子裡。姑毛和比路決定取得它,挑戰國王的意願,最終進入一個更大的新世界。一個充滿樂趣和……危險的世界。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The King doesn’t want to share his new rocket powered skateboard so he hides it in a magic box. Goomo and Bello decide to claim it, challenging the King’s wishes, and end up in a new and larger world. A world of fun and….danger.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 皇后心情不好。國王和孩子們同意舉辦有史以來最好的生日派對。不幸的是,每個參與者對於如何組織女王的驚喜派對都有個別非常特別的想法。它的成功將取決於他們「易地而處」的能力。尤其是女王。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The Queen feels gloomy. The King and the children agree to organize the best birthday party ever. Unfortunately each of the participants has a very particular idea as to how to organize the Queen’s surprise party. Its success will depend on their cap

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 比路厭倦了女王,他認為女王試圖毀掉他所有的冒險和遊戲。在滿天流星的星夜,比路許下一個願望:願女王變回少女,讓他為所欲為。當比路的願望成真,他將必須當個瘋狂的小女王哥哥,並意識到這可能是很艱鉅的任務,有時甚至很危險。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Bello is fed up with the Queen, whom he thinks tries to ruin all his adventures and games. On a starry night, full of shooting stars, Bello makes a wish: may the Queen become a young girl again so she can let him do anything he wants. When Bello’s wi

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 今天是姑毛的生日,他有很高期望。不幸的是,他醒來發現珍愛的頭盔不見了!最重要的是,他的朋友們表現得很奇怪,他們似乎都忘記了他的生日。姑毛很樂意讓一切恢復正常。幸運的是,他收到一個驚喜,可以讓這天成為一個非常特別的日子。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Its Goomos birthday and his hopes are high. Unfortunately, he wakes to find his precious helmet missing! On top of that his friends are acting strangely and they all appear to have forgotten all about his birthday. Goomo would be happy to have thin

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 安高在與比路和姑毛玩耍時弄傷了自己,因此必須在家休息幾天。比路感到內疚,決定搬進安高的房子,直到他的朋友好轉為止。他們對生活的不同看法相交,然後一起發現如果睜大眼睛看一切,即使是最小的細節,也可以很享受。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Ongo hurt himself while playing with Bello and Goomo so he must stay at home to rest for several days. Bello feels guilty and decides to move into Ongo’s house until his friend feels better. Their different views on life will meet and together they’l

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 莉塔在米娜的實驗室試做自己的實驗。她很快就發現首先需要學習一些基礎知識來避免災難發生。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Rita tries her own experiments in Mina’s lab. She’ll soon discover she first needs to learn some basics in order to avoid a disaster.
