epg.episode_synopsis_en: Examine fires pivotal role in shaping Australias natural world. Tour the devastation left by 2020s brutal bush-fire season, learn how climate change fuelled this watershed event, and chart the long-term recovery of the continents wildlife.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 與地球上最健談的物種交流.見識一下喋喋不休的卷尾猴;忍受歐亞水獺令人毛骨悚然的尖叫.面對憤怒果蝠的大聲抱怨;以及探索虎鯨的人類級別的語音系統.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Connect with Earths most talkative species. Meet capuchin monkeys, who definitely dont take a vow of silence; endure Eurasian river otters chilling screams; face angry fruit bats loud complaints; and explore orcas human-scale speech systems.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 位於美國西岸的蒙特雷灣國家海洋保護區是美國最大的海洋保護區,那裡擁有525種魚類,還有一個巨大的海藻林.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: On the West Coast of the United States, the Monterey Bay National Marine Sanctuary is the largest marine sanctuary in the country - home to 525 species of fish, and a massive, underwater Kelp forest.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 馬達加斯加大狐猴indris是現存原猴類中體型最大的類群,他們每天在雨林中尋找食物和躲避捕食者.讓我們看看這些瀕臨滅絕的靈長類動物如何在迅速縮小的棲息地中克服一切困難生存下來.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: This is the story of a day in the life of an Indris Family following a mother, father, and their three offspring around their home in the rainforest of Mantadia National Park in Madagascar.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 當家庭分崩離析,一隻幼獅必須活下來; 兩隻青少年豹崽在被遺棄後必須自生自滅,一隻年輕的成年黑羚必須冒上生命和肢體的危險,因牠試圖保證第一次交配.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A young lion cub must survive as his family is torn apart; two adolescent leopard cubs must fend for themselves after they are abandoned, and a young adult blackbuck must risk life and limb as he tries to secure his first mating.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 華贊是一頭強大的雄性領袖,坐擁一個異常龐大的部隊.他在維持這個大集團方面做得很好,但未來的路並不明朗.還有更多的同伴需要糊口,但牠的叢林正在萎縮.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Rajan is the powerful alpha male who sits at the head of an unusually large troop. He has done well to sustain such a big group, but the future doesnt look so bright. There are more mouths to feed, and yet his jungle home is shrinking.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 豪華的廟宇花園坐落在古城焦特布爾的邊緣位置,是一大群長尾葉猴的家,牠們享受著寧靜的生活,卻有嚴格的等級制度.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Nestled on the edge of the ancient city of Jodhpur, the luxurious Temple Gardens are home to a huge troop of Hanuman Langurs, who enjoy a peaceful life of bounty. But the troop has a strict hierarchy.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在印度南部炎熱又潮濕的熱帶森林中,一位雌性眼鏡王蛇正在執行任務:在季候風到來前,她需要找到伴侶,食物並順利下蛋.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In the hot forest of Southern India, a female King Cobra is on a mission: to find a mate, find food, and lay eggs before the monsoon arrives.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在印度南部的森林中,夏季無情的酷熱給亞洲大象帶來了挑戰,他們每天都需要喝水.當水開始在周圍消失時,聰明的女族長安露娜決定帶領她的家人遷移到遙遠的水源.她能否成功為3個月大的孫子找到新水源?
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In southern India, the summer is a challenge for Asian elephants who must drink every day. As things dry up, Anura, the matriarch, leads her herd to a distant watering hole. But will she succeed in getting her 3-month-old grandson there in time?

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 壯觀,刺激和累人的海陸空之旅是許多物種生活中的關鍵.這些王國為尋找食物,棲息地或伴侶而踏上旅途.但當這些計劃涉及數百甚至數千個體時,預訂和組織旅程就變得不容易了.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Epic flights, adventurous sea journeys and exhausting road trips all play a key part in the lives of many species. These empires travel in search of food, shelter or a mate. But booking and organizing travel is no easy feat when those plans involv...

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在馬達加斯加偏遠的伯倫蒂保育區,兩個環尾狐猴派別因正面臨旱季日益嚴峻的挑戰而拉起戰幔.這些魅力非凡的狐猴僅在馬達加斯加島上被發現,黑白相間的尾巴十分突出,牠們活在女權體制中,每個幫派都有嚴格的等級制度,並擁有各自嚴守的領土.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: As the dry season approaches, tensions rise on Lemur Island, both between rival gangs and within their own ranks. Get a view from the battlefield as the female leaders fiercely defend their turf, while their newborn infants cling to them for safety.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在馬達加斯加偏遠的貝倫地保育區,旱季正對當地的環尾狐猴造成巨大的損耗.隨著覓食的難度增加,對立幫派領導人姬絲圖和嘉緹之間的關係越發緊張.隨著食物和水源日益稀缺,入侵者亦出現在附近.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: As food and water become scarce, Crystal, the fierce leader of the Ruins gang, sets her sights on rival Katis territory and its neighboring fruit trees. Watch as Crystals move and a raid by outside invaders lead to dire consequences for one troop.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在長期乾旱過後,第一場雨的降臨大大地紓緩了馬達加斯加貝倫地保育區的環尾狐猴幫.森林裡的食物十分充足,對立幫派領導人姬絲圖和嘉緹率領族群離開領土大快朵頤.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The drought is finally over, but traversing the forest for food is still a gamble. See some leaders take the risk, leaving home territories undefended to feast on a cicada boom. When they return, trespassers are ready for a fight.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 狐?島上的幫派奮力保持族群的健康和領土的完整.隨著嬰兒們成長,牠們的階級架構開始出現裂縫,權力備受考驗.由學習食甚麼,交友,結盟到在族群中找到一席之地,狐?島上嬰兒的生活跟成年狐?一樣艱辛.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: As the babies grow, new power struggles break out in each troop. Watch as every member, from fierce Queen Crystal to low-ranking Erica, jockeys for position. Meanwhile, the babies start to understand how allies and enemies will shape their future.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​重溫棕熊的進化之旅,從主宰冰河時期的熊科祖先到今天的現代雜食動物.見證它們與鮭魚之間的共生關係,以及它們所繁榮的驚人互聯生態系統.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Revisit the evolutionary journey of brown bears, from ursid ancestors that dominated the ice ages to todays modern omnivores. Witness their symbiotic relationship with salmon and the surprisingly interconnected ecosystems they thrive in.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​跟隨黑犀牛的旅程,看看適應和保護如何影響這位古老自然巨人的進化.體驗這種裝甲草食動物的非凡聽力,嗅覺和其他生物優勢.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Follow the journey of the black rhino and see how adaptation and conservation have influenced the evolution of an ancient titan of nature. Experience this armoured herbivores extraordinary hearing, sense of smell, and other biological advantages.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​深入了解非洲最具標誌性但被誤解的巨型動物之一:河馬的生活.進入一場對抗賽的中心,看看一隻領土雄性河馬的咬合有多致命,然後見證它們在水下出生的奇蹟.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Look inside the life of one of Africas most iconic but misunderstood megafauna: the hippopotamus. Get in the middle of a sparring match and see just how deadly a territorial males bite can be, then witness the miracle of their underwater births.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​了解適應性如何幫助鱷魚,這種與恐龍一樣古老的生物,進化以面對現代世界.觀看蝴蝶如何以它們的眼淚為食,然後驚嘆於它們的共同育嬰所展現的母愛奉獻.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Understand how adaptability has helped the caiman, a beast as old as the dinosaurs, evolve to face the modern world. Watch butterflies feed on their tears, then marvel at the maternal devotion on display in their communal nurseries.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 窺探全球昆蟲數量銳減對地球可能造成的衝擊,揭露我們千百年來對這些微小伙伴的依賴,以及牠們在生態系統中所扮演的關鍵角色.了解人類與昆蟲之間的微妙關係如何面臨危機.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Look at what a global insect decline could do to our planet. Uncover our historical dependence on these tiny animals, the vital roles they play in our ecosystems, and the reasons why our fragile relationship to them is in danger worldwide.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 了解蜜蜂,蝴蝶與飛蛾如何讓田野和樹林充滿生機.想像如果這些勤勞的蟲蟲消失,世界會如何變樣.見證神祕的蝴蝶遷徙之旅,以及飛蛾如何巧妙地躲避飢餓的蝙蝠.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Learn how bees, butterflies, moths, and other pollinators keep our fields and forests fruitful, and weigh what life would be like if these busy bugs vanished. Witness a mysterious butterfly pilgrimage and a moths clever way of escaping hungry bats.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 迎戰專為殺戮而生的掠食性昆蟲,了解具有武術家身手的螳螂如何令人畏懼,然後跟隨大開殺戒的蜻蜓在半空中狩獵.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Go up against predatory insects that are tailor-made for killing. See why the terrifying praying mantis has the agility of a martial artist and an appetite for everything from flies to hummingbirds, then go hunting in mid-air with deadly dragonflies.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​重溫棕熊的進化之旅,從主宰冰河時期的熊科祖先到今天的現代雜食動物.見證它們與鮭魚之間的共生關係,以及它們所繁榮的驚人互聯生態系統.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Revisit the evolutionary journey of brown bears, from ursid ancestors that dominated the ice ages to todays modern omnivores. Witness their symbiotic relationship with salmon and the surprisingly interconnected ecosystems they thrive in.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​跟隨黑犀牛的旅程,看看適應和保護如何影響這位古老自然巨人的進化.體驗這種裝甲草食動物的非凡聽力,嗅覺和其他生物優勢.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Follow the journey of the black rhino and see how adaptation and conservation have influenced the evolution of an ancient titan of nature. Experience this armoured herbivores extraordinary hearing, sense of smell, and other biological advantages.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​深入了解非洲最具標誌性但被誤解的巨型動物之一:河馬的生活.進入一場對抗賽的中心,看看一隻領土雄性河馬的咬合有多致命,然後見證它們在水下出生的奇蹟.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Look inside the life of one of Africas most iconic but misunderstood megafauna: the hippopotamus. Get in the middle of a sparring match and see just how deadly a territorial males bite can be, then witness the miracle of their underwater births.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​了解適應性如何幫助鱷魚,這種與恐龍一樣古老的生物,進化以面對現代世界.觀看蝴蝶如何以它們的眼淚為食,然後驚嘆於它們的共同育嬰所展現的母愛奉獻.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Understand how adaptability has helped the caiman, a beast as old as the dinosaurs, evolve to face the modern world. Watch butterflies feed on their tears, then marvel at the maternal devotion on display in their communal nurseries.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 窺探全球昆蟲數量銳減對地球可能造成的衝擊,揭露我們千百年來對這些微小伙伴的依賴,以及牠們在生態系統中所扮演的關鍵角色.了解人類與昆蟲之間的微妙關係如何面臨危機.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Look at what a global insect decline could do to our planet. Uncover our historical dependence on these tiny animals, the vital roles they play in our ecosystems, and the reasons why our fragile relationship to them is in danger worldwide.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 了解蜜蜂,蝴蝶與飛蛾如何讓田野和樹林充滿生機.想像如果這些勤勞的蟲蟲消失,世界會如何變樣.見證神祕的蝴蝶遷徙之旅,以及飛蛾如何巧妙地躲避飢餓的蝙蝠.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Learn how bees, butterflies, moths, and other pollinators keep our fields and forests fruitful, and weigh what life would be like if these busy bugs vanished. Witness a mysterious butterfly pilgrimage and a moths clever way of escaping hungry bats.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 迎戰專為殺戮而生的掠食性昆蟲,了解具有武術家身手的螳螂如何令人畏懼,然後跟隨大開殺戒的蜻蜓在半空中狩獵.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Go up against predatory insects that are tailor-made for killing. See why the terrifying praying mantis has the agility of a martial artist and an appetite for everything from flies to hummingbirds, then go hunting in mid-air with deadly dragonflies.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 遠離這些獸王獵手身上的劍,刺和致命的頭飾.觀察大羚羊爭鬥時糾結互鎖的螺旋形長角,鸛發出嗒嗒聲的刀形喙,犀牛用巨大的角來嚇唬競爭對手,條紋馬林魚用尖刺刺向毫無防備的獵物.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Avoid the swords, spikes, and deadly hood ornaments on these alpha hunters. Observe elands locking corkscrew horns, storks rattling sabre-shaped beaks, rhinos scaring the competition with massive horns, and striped marlins spearing unsuspecting prey.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在南加勒比海深處,探索博內爾島國家海洋公園的保護水域,這裡是生機勃勃的珊瑚礁,瀕臨絕種的海龜和大片紅樹林和大量海洋生物的家.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Deep in the South Caribbean Sea, explore the protected waters of Bonaire National Marine Park, home to thriving reefs, endangered sea turtles, sprawling mangroves, and a plethora of marine life.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 跟隨四個不同物種的四個家族-足智多謀的海灘族,好戰的沙漠族,紀律嚴明的河族和愛好和平的山族,找出這些靈長類成為非洲最成功動物之一的原因.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Follow four families of four different species - the resourceful Beach Troop, the warlike Desert Troop, the disciplined River Troop, and the peaceful Mountain Band - to find out why these primates are among the most successful animals in Africa.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 白眉長臂猿是印度叢林的專家.生活在親密的家庭中,少猴花費數年時間學習生存的技能.為你介紹沙馬,牠尋找食物,避開掠食者,並掌握於林木間生活所需的雜技.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Hoolock Gibbons are specialists of the Jungle. Living in close knit families, youngsters spend years learning the skills to survive. Meet Samar as he forages for food, avoids predators, and masters the acrobatics required for a life in the trees.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 印度東北部的草原是地球上最肥沃的棲息地之一,該處生長茂盛的野草,讓罕見的印度犀牛賴以維生,並茁壯成長.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The grasslands of Northeast India are one of the most fertile habitats on earth. Hundreds of species of tall grass flourish here, allowing one of Indias most iconic creatures to thrive... the Greater One-horned Rhino.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 拉達克高原是一片極端之地,但西藏野驢是這片草原的王者.跟隨一匹影響一群雌性的種馬,她有機會繁殖下一代,但若然如此,她必須與那些想要牠皇冠的對手作戰!
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The Ladakh plateau is a land of extremes, but the Tibetan wild ass is the king of this grassland. Follow one stallion as he shadows a herd of females for his chance to sire the next generation, but in doing so, he must battle those wanting his crown!

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在灼熱和充滿熱帶風暴的土地上,印度南部平原的生活十分艱苦.但一頭帶著兩隻幼崽的雌性樹懶比比,正迎接她生活上的挑戰,她每刻都要對抗缺水缺糧和掠食者.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In a land of heat and tropical storms, life on the plains of southern India is tough. But Bibi, a female sloth bear with two cubs, is up for the challenge of her life as she fights against drought, food scarcity, and predators around every corner.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 地球上最具代表性的動物之一 - 孟加拉虎在印度的叢林中徘徊.在一天的過程中,我們追隨一位母親和三隻幼崽. 她必須為家人提供足夠的食物來維持生計.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: One of the most iconic animals on Earth stalks the jungles of India: the Bengal Tiger. Over the course of a single day, we follow the fortunes of one mother and her three young cubs. She must provide enough food for her family to stay alive.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 每個王國都需要一個傳位制度,生兒育女,是每個物種的生存之道.在某些社交圈,需要一整條村子來維繫家庭,但又有些只有單親父母能在野外的威脅中保護幼兒.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Every empire needs a succession plan. Making babies – and raising them – is crucial for every species to survive. In some social circles, it takes a village to raise a family. In others, a single parent is all that stands between the vulnerability...

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 從古至今,很多物種都被絕種危機所威脅.就如強極一時的恐龍帝國,亦在地球上消失殆盡.但另外一些則從滅絕邊緣生存下來,慢慢恢復甚至在自然界中建立王國.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Over the course of recorded time, many species have been threatened with extinction. Once-powerful animal empires – like the dinosaurs - have been completely wiped from the planet. But others once on the verge of disappearance have survived, bounc...

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 農場中的禽畜多是眾多歌曲和故事的主角,牠們在全球各地歡慶,但卻很少談起牠們在野外的兄弟姊妹物種.這些主要被稱為牲畜,負軛的野獸,甚至寵物,必須在其家養親屬的圍欄外自生自滅.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: As the popular characters of songs and stories, farm animals are celebrated all over the world. But few stories tell of their sister species who live in the wild. These animals known primarily as livestock, beasts of burden, or even pets must fend...

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 不速之客以量取勝,獲取領地,有些動物群被列為「害蟲」,但牠們若要生存,就是要找到不歡迎牠們的安身之所.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Uninvited guests. Using sheer numbers to claim a territory, some animal groups are considered pests. But their very survival may depend on finding a home where theyre not welcome.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 人多好辦事,放諸野外同樣適用.這就是眾多物種都選擇群居的原因.保護族群才能賴以生存.對於這些動物,保護代表隔離 - 從外界的威脅中找到庇護所.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Theres strength in numbers. Especially in the wild. For many species, its the very reason why individuals come together. Protecting the empire is imperative to survival. For these animals, protection means isolation – finding sanctuary from the ...

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​面對海洋中最具多樣性和威脅性的掠食者.了解幫助這種史前物種在多次大規模滅絕中生存下來的生物優勢,然後驚嘆於公牛鯊無情的狩獵技巧.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Confront the oceans most versatile and formidable predator. Learn about the biological advantages that helped this prehistoric species survive multiple mass extinctions, then get awed by the relentless hunting skills of bull sharks.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 從超遠距離的鯨歌,到大象的亞聲,再至墨魚皮膚上閃爍的訊息,動物們有著令人難以置信的調情,戰鬥,聊天和交合的方式,有著一整套動物語言等待我們解碼.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Join researchers as they study how animals communicate. Find out how wolves use their body language to unite the pack and maintain a sophisticated social structure, and see the astounding number of gestures chimps use to communicate.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 從超遠距離的鯨歌,到大象的亞聲,再至墨魚皮膚上閃爍的訊息,動物們有著令人難以置信的調情,戰鬥,聊天和交合的方式,有著一整套動物語言等待我們解碼.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Tune into the natural world and explore frequencies beyond human hearing, like the gentle hum of giraffes in the evening, or creatures who use song to claim territory on a seemingly silent coral reef.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 從超遠距離的鯨歌,到大象的亞聲,再至墨魚皮膚上閃爍的訊息,動物們有著令人難以置信的調情,戰鬥,聊天和交合的方式,有著一整套動物語言等待我們解碼.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Could undiscovered animal languages save some of our most endangered species? From subtle scents to colors that are invisible to the human eye, uncover the hidden ways creatures communicate, which scientists are only starting to understand.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 和大自然的食腐隊一起去拾荒.觀察袋獾與對手展開食物大戰;學習甲蟲如何在競爭中獲勝;了解野豬激烈的擇偶策略;再看看鬣狗的碎骨鋼牙如何撕裂任何食物.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Go scavenging with natures cleanup crew. See Tasmanian devils get into food fights with rivals; learn how dung beetles roll over the competition; view wild boars fierce mating strategies; and watch hyenas bone-crushing teeth demolish any meal.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在南加勒比海深處,探索博內爾島國家海洋公園的保護水域,這裡是生機勃勃的珊瑚礁,瀕臨絕種的海龜和大片紅樹林和大量海洋生物的家.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: This episode examines the importance of three marine habitat types in the Florida Keys including the animals within them and conservationists efforts to protect them.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 東部灰大袋鼠是最善於交際的袋鼠科動物之一,以稱之為暴徒的小社群聚居.暴徒就像袋鼠的社交網絡,由2至100隻袋鼠一起餵哺.成員可自出自入,視乎食物供應情況而定.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The Eastern Grey kangaroo is a sociable species, clustering together in small groups known as mobs. A mob is a social network focused on feeding, where members will come and go as they please, depending on the availability of food.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 養育袋鼠寶寶充滿挑戰性:掠食者,極端天氣和非常活潑的小袋鼠意味著袋鼠媽媽每天都要努力讓下一代存活.本集跟隨兩位袋鼠媽媽 - 羅倫和蒂莉,且看她們如何努力養育孩子.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Eastern Grey kangaroos are prolific breeders, but bringing up baby is fraught with challenges. Predators, climate extremes, and lively joeys mean kangaroo mothers face a daily struggle to keep their young alive.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 對於雄性袋鼠來說,努力繁衍代表著充滿風險和回報的生活.雖然女性生活在既定的家園內,並以和平的社群聚集,但男性的生活則十分危險.很多雄性袋鼠在鄉郊徘徊尋找伴侶.這讓他們接觸更多雌性,但一直移動代表他們面臨更多來自多變氣候,繁忙道路和可能遭農民射殺的危險.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Follow several different males as they roam the land, climb up the social ladder, and fight for their mating rights in Eastern Grey colony. For these bucks, the drive to perpetuate their species promises a life full of risk and reward.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 雅拉國家公園的森林是神祕懶熊的家.這種動物生性害羞,很少被看見及拍攝.加入野生動物影片製作團隊,跟著他們揭開前所未見的神祕懶熊生活和行為.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The forests of Yala National Park are home to the enigmatic sloth bear. Shy by nature, this animal is seldom seen and rarely filmed. Join a team of wildlife filmmakers as they reveal this mysterious bears life and behaviour as never seen before.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 大象中途之家 (Elephant Transit Home) 來了新成員:一隻生病的小象在自然保護區附近被拋棄,這是人類和大象爭奪空間下的又一個受害者.深入了解在普魯圖·費南多博士的領導下,如何以創新的方式努力結束這場衝突.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Theres a new arrival at the Elephant Transit Home: a sick elephant calf abandoned near a reserve, another victim in the battle for space between humans and elephants. Study the innovative efforts to end this conflict, led by Dr. Pruthu Fernando.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 蘭卡獼猴隱藏在斯里蘭卡的森林中.作為島上的土生動物,這群活潑的群居猴子在世上獨一無二.牠們是有史以來最長的靈長類動物研究項目的核心.胡夫間鐵達時博士致力瞭解牠們複雜的社會.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Hidden in the jungles of Sri Lanka is the toque macaque. Endemic to the island, these feisty group-living monkeys are found nowhere else on earth. And they are at the heart of the longest primate research project ever undertaken. Dr Wolfgang Dittu...

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 本集將為大家揭開夏威夷迷人海灘背後的科學秘密.為甚麼細沙會呈現不同色彩,包括白色,黃色,黑色,綠色和紅色?活火山如何改變海岸線?是否有其他力量在塑造這些令人驚嘆的海灘?一起來深入暸解!
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Get ready to understand the science behind Hawaiis stunning beaches. Why does sand appear white, yellow, black, green and red? How do active volcanoes change the coastline? Are other forces at play in shaping these incredible beaches?

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 弗雷澤島就在澳洲昆士蘭州旁,它是一個完全建基在沙上的複雜生態系統.即使在它的熱帶雨林,桉樹林或紅樹林中,一位弗雷澤島的遊客也總是站在生機勃勃的海灘上.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Its a UNESCO World Heritage Site, the largest sand island on earth, and home to wild dingoes, six-foot sand-worms, and eucalyptus woodlands. Find out how everything lives happily together in a complex ecosystem built entirely upon sand.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 加州的海灘是世上最美麗的海灘之一,但由於人類對大自然的影響,它們是否會失去平衡?太平洋海岸壯麗的動物群如何在海灘生命線上繼續生活?
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The beaches of California are some of the most beautiful in the world, but are they falling out of balance due to mankinds effects on nature? What does it take for the magnificent fauna of the Pacific Coast to keep living... on the living beach?

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 穿梭於綠意盎然的城市,獮猴族長馬特諾爾以鐵腕手段,一直統治擁有30名成員的街頭部族.另一邊廂,老領袖阿拉夫則管理更具野性的深山部族.年少氣盛的洛基該挑戰哪一位的王者寶座?
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Explore the lush treed cityscape where fluffy male Matnoor rules over the 30-member-strong Street Troop with an iron fist. Then meet Aarav, the old alpha who oversees the wilder Hill Troop. Which will up-and-comer Loci challenge for the crown?

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 跟隨街頭部族穿梭大街小巷,享受一次充滿垃圾食物的城市假期.鏡頭一轉,看看深山部族趁機入侵街頭部族的領地後,情勢如何急轉直下.目擊姐妹團如何組織綁架莎拉寶寶的陰謀,而新上任的領袖洛基則發現他的老對手已經重返城鎮.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Go on a junk-food-fuelled urban holiday with the Street Troop, then watch the Hill Troops invasion of their turf turn sour. Monitor the Sisterhoods plot to kidnap Saras baby before newly minted alpha Loci discovers his old rival is back in town.

epg.programme_title_tc: 魚鷹: 海洋迅猛禽 [英/普]
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 一對老魚鷹回到康州鹽沼的家中.牠們在整個夏天必須與敵人作戰,忍耐惡劣天氣,捕獵千百條魚,只為養育下一代.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Wade into a saltwater marsh along the Connecticut River to witness the heartwarming reunion of two ospreys whove been mates for a decade. Witness their highs and lows over a single summer as they raise their chicks and dodge a host of predators.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 巡视「海灣」家族郁郁蔥蔥的領土,在這裡女族長安娜向族人提供奢華的盛宴,但也面臨著內部的異議.打量她的對手米婭--頗具街頭智慧的「城裡人」家族領導者,她正在考慮改善生活方式,並向與世隔絕的「紅樹林」家族打探消息.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Stake out the Bay Familys lush territory, where matriarch Anna offers lavish feasts but faces internal dissent. Size up her rival Mia, the streetwise Townies leader whos eyeing a lifestyle upgrade, and check in with the isolated Mangrove Family.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 隨著海灣家族一起逆流而上,在這裡安娜幫忙撫養她的孫輩,然後回老家找出入侵她的地盤的傢伙們.親眼目睹紅樹林裡的洪水差點把一個嬰兒沖走,看著城裡人家族利用牠們的資源享受乾淨食物.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Swim upriver with the Bay Family, where Anna offers a hand raising her grandpups before heading home to find interlopers on her turf. Watch a flood in the mangroves nearly sweep away a baby, and see the Townies eat clean through their resources.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 準備好在濱海灣的鬥毆吧,在安娜和她的海濱家族遠在上游時,游牧人和城裡人家族佔領了她的領地.在這個海灣的合法主人突然返回之前,暫時享受一下這個豪華水道中平靜的水瀨生活吧.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Get ready to rumble in Marina Bay, where the Nomads and Townies are squatting while Anna and the Bay Family are away upriver. Soak up the peaceful otter life in this luxurious waterway before the surprise early return of its rightful owners.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 歡迎安娜的族群回到海濱灣, 那裡有兩個擅自闖入的水獭家族.當米婭嗅到安娜的氣味並將湯尼族群趕得遠遠的時候,牠感受到了壓力.然後,當遊牧族群對即將發生的衝突一無所知時,請抓緊時間.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Welcome Annas clan back to Marina Bay, where two otter families have been trespassing. Feel the heat when Mia catches Annas scent and hustles the Townies out of reach. Then hold tight as the Nomads remain blissfully unaware of the coming conflict.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 跟隨海灣族群的女族長,牠將遊牧族群永遠趕出了自己的領地,並發現了湯尼族群領袖米婭定居的令人驚訝的繁衍巢穴.隨後,牠們與紅樹林族群放鬆一下,與流浪狗嬉戲.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Follow the Bay Familys matriarch as she chases the Nomads out of her territory for good, and examine the surprising birthing den where the Townies leader, Mia, settles in. Then kick back with the Mangrove Family as they pal around with stray dogs.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 追隨安娜的步伐,到湯尼族群的巢穴去, 米婭和牠剛出生的幼崽便藏身於此.在族群搬到新的棲息地之前,看看小水獭們的第一堂游泳課,當紅樹林族群成為公園的主要景點時,將迎來一個水獭和平的時代.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Chase Anna to the Townies lair, where Mia and her newborn pups are hiding out. See the babies first swimming lessons before the clan moves to new digs, and welcome an era of otter peace as the Mangrove Family becomes a parks main attraction.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 近距離觀看大自然最壯麗的時裝秀.欣賞金絲猴華麗的金色鬃毛,只吃甲殼類動物的火烈鳥身上令人驚歎的粉紅色羽毛以及南非劍羚和獵豹身上含義豐富的斑紋.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Get a front-row seat to natures most spectacular fashion show. Admire the luxuriant blond manes of golden snub-nose monkeys, stunning pink flamingo feathers brought on by an all-crustacean diet, and the meaningful markings of gemsboks and cheetahs.

epg.programme_title_tc: 澳洲蛇類捕捉隊:死亡追捕 #5
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​與阿黛爾和米克展開意志的較量,他們試圖將一條蟒蛇引出排水管.靜候傑絲和丹試圖在一條鰭背蛇放出臭彈之前抓住它,然後與斯圖一起面對隱藏在大學牆壁中的危險蛇類.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Engage in a battle of wills with Adele and Mick as they try to coax a python out of a drainpipe. Stand by as Jess and Dan try to grab a keelback snake before it drops a stink bomb, then face a dangerous serpent hidden in a university wall with Stu.

epg.programme_title_tc: 澳洲蛇類捕捉隊:死亡追捕 #6
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​放鬆一下,觀看米克和阿黛爾在一個養老院中打斷一對交配的東部棕蛇.與斯圖和莉芙一起處理不需要的庫存,他們在倉庫中捕捉到一條綠樹蛇,然後與傑絲和丹一起悄悄接近一位兇險的訪客.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Kick back as Mick and Adele break up a pair of mating eastern brown snakes at a retirement home. Take care of unwanted inventory with Stu and Liv, who capture a green tree snake in a warehouse, then sneak up on a killer visitor with Jess and Dan.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 以澳洲最近發生災難性森林大火的後續,透過充滿希望,人為干預和復原力的故事,記錄野生動植物的長期恢復情況.本節目發放了一個十萬火急的訊息,不要太遲愛護大自然.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Examine fires pivotal role in shaping Australias natural world. Tour the devastation left by 2020s brutal bush-fire season, learn how climate change fuelled this watershed event, and chart the long-term recovery of the continents wildlife.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​跟隨黑犀牛的旅程,看看適應和保護如何影響這位古老自然巨人的進化.體驗這種裝甲草食動物的非凡聽力,嗅覺和其他生物優勢.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Follow the journey of the black rhino and see how adaptation and conservation have influenced the evolution of an ancient titan of nature. Experience this armoured herbivores extraordinary hearing, sense of smell, and other biological advantages.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 見證鬥士們如何在非洲大草原的旱季中爭奪水源和其他珍貴資源.親眼目擊獅子和大象為爭奪地盤的激烈爭鬥,螞蟻襲擊白蟻丘,以及蜜獾與毒蛇聯袂上演的危險探戈.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Witness clashes over precious resources when the dry season brings a band of gladiators to an African savannah watering hole. See a lion-elephant territory brawl, an ant raid on a termite mound, and a honey badgers risky dance with a deadly snake.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 拜訪澳洲最狡猾的鬥士和他們驚人的武器庫.從袋鼠的致命拳擊和紅背蜘蛛精密設計的陷阱,暸解他們如何運用這些必殺技擊退敵人,同時應對氣候變化的侵害.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Go up against Australias wiliest gladiators and their impressive arsenals. Learn if these weapons, such as the kangaroos deadly boxing moves and the redback spiders precision-engineered traps, can help them survive the ravages of climate change.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 壯觀,刺激和累人的海陸空之旅是許多物種生活中的關鍵.這些王國為尋找食物,棲息地或伴侶而踏上旅途.但當這些計劃涉及數百甚至數千個體時,預訂和組織旅程就變得不容易了.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Epic flights, adventurous sea journeys and exhausting road trips all play a key part in the lives of many species. These empires travel in search of food, shelter or a mate. But booking and organizing travel is no easy feat when those plans involv...

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 當街頭部族發現深山部族侵入他們的領地後,爭戰一觸即發.目擊馬特諾爾糟糕的育兒技巧,並見證具領袖野心的阿吉特如何展開行動.熱浪來襲,迫使大家在森林中共享資源,緩和衝突氣氛.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Stand back when a brawl erupts after the Street Troop finds the Hill Troop on their turf. Assess Matnoors poor parenting skills, see alpha wannabe Ajit make his move, then cool off as a heat wave pushes everyone to share the wealth in the forest.

epg.programme_title_tc: 澳洲蛇類捕捉隊:死亡追捕 #5
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​與阿黛爾和米克展開意志的較量,他們試圖將一條蟒蛇引出排水管.靜候傑絲和丹試圖在一條鰭背蛇放出臭彈之前抓住它,然後與斯圖一起面對隱藏在大學牆壁中的危險蛇類.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 當街頭部族發現深山部族侵入他們的領地後,爭戰一觸即發.目擊馬特諾爾糟糕的育兒技巧,並見證具領袖野心的阿吉特如何展開行動.熱浪來襲,迫使大家在森林中共享資源,緩和衝突氣氛.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Stand back when a brawl erupts after the Street Troop finds the Hill Troop on their turf. Assess Matnoors poor parenting skills, see alpha wannabe Ajit make his move, then cool off as a heat wave pushes everyone to share the wealth in the forest.

epg.programme_title_tc: 澳洲蛇類捕捉隊:死亡追捕 #5
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​與阿黛爾和米克展開意志的較量,他們試圖將一條蟒蛇引出排水管.靜候傑絲和丹試圖在一條鰭背蛇放出臭彈之前抓住它,然後與斯圖一起面對隱藏在大學牆壁中的危險蛇類.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Engage in a battle of wills with Adele and Mick as they try to coax a python out of a drainpipe. Stand by as Jess and Dan try to grab a keelback snake before it drops a stink bomb, then face a dangerous serpent hidden in a university wall with Stu.

epg.programme_title_tc: 澳洲蛇類捕捉隊:死亡追捕 #6
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​放鬆一下,觀看米克和阿黛爾在一個養老院中打斷一對交配的東部棕蛇.與斯圖和莉芙一起處理不需要的庫存,他們在倉庫中捕捉到一條綠樹蛇,然後與傑絲和丹一起悄悄接近一位兇險的訪客.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Kick back as Mick and Adele break up a pair of mating eastern brown snakes at a retirement home. Take care of unwanted inventory with Stu and Liv, who capture a green tree snake in a warehouse, then sneak up on a killer visitor with Jess and Dan.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 以澳洲最近發生災難性森林大火的後續,透過充滿希望,人為干預和復原力的故事,記錄野生動植物的長期恢復情況.本節目發放了一個十萬火急的訊息,不要太遲愛護大自然.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Examine fires pivotal role in shaping Australias natural world. Tour the devastation left by 2020s brutal bush-fire season, learn how climate change fuelled this watershed event, and chart the long-term recovery of the continents wildlife.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​跟隨黑犀牛的旅程,看看適應和保護如何影響這位古老自然巨人的進化.體驗這種裝甲草食動物的非凡聽力,嗅覺和其他生物優勢.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Follow the journey of the black rhino and see how adaptation and conservation have influenced the evolution of an ancient titan of nature. Experience this armoured herbivores extraordinary hearing, sense of smell, and other biological advantages.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 見證鬥士們如何在非洲大草原的旱季中爭奪水源和其他珍貴資源.親眼目擊獅子和大象為爭奪地盤的激烈爭鬥,螞蟻襲擊白蟻丘,以及蜜獾與毒蛇聯袂上演的危險探戈.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Witness clashes over precious resources when the dry season brings a band of gladiators to an African savannah watering hole. See a lion-elephant territory brawl, an ant raid on a termite mound, and a honey badgers risky dance with a deadly snake.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 拜訪澳洲最狡猾的鬥士和他們驚人的武器庫.從袋鼠的致命拳擊和紅背蜘蛛精密設計的陷阱,暸解他們如何運用這些必殺技擊退敵人,同時應對氣候變化的侵害.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Go up against Australias wiliest gladiators and their impressive arsenals. Learn if these weapons, such as the kangaroos deadly boxing moves and the redback spiders precision-engineered traps, can help them survive the ravages of climate change.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 隨著海灣家族一起逆流而上,在這裡安娜幫忙撫養她的孫輩,然後回老家找出入侵她的地盤的傢伙們.親眼目睹紅樹林裡的洪水差點把一個嬰兒沖走,看著城裡人家族利用牠們的資源享受乾淨食物.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Swim upriver with the Bay Family, where Anna offers a hand raising her grandpups before heading home to find interlopers on her turf. Watch a flood in the mangroves nearly sweep away a baby, and see the Townies eat clean through their resources.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 了解為什麼對於獸王來說,體型越大越好.去看大猩猩的摔跤比賽,遠離咄咄逼人的駝鹿角和避開長長的鵜鶘喙,牠們會猛擊在攻擊範圍內的任何敵人,最後來觀賞巨型鯊魚令人驚歎的立體嗅探器.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Learn why bigger is definitely better for these alphas. Go ringside for a gorilla wrestling match, stay away from pushy moose antlers, steer clear of long pelican bills that snap at any enemy within range, and marvel at a megasharks stereo sniffer.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​深入了解非洲最具標誌性但被誤解的巨型動物之一:河馬的生活.進入一場對抗賽的中心,看看一隻領土雄性河馬的咬合有多致命,然後見證它們在水下出生的奇蹟.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Look inside the life of one of Africas most iconic but misunderstood megafauna: the hippopotamus. Get in the middle of a sparring match and see just how deadly a territorial males bite can be, then witness the miracle of their underwater births.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 一旦天氣變冷變黑,昆蟲開始從草地和田地消失,牠們會慢慢消失直至全滅.所有動物都有其特殊的生存方式,像燕子和鶴這種候鳥會飛向南方,許多像鹿一樣的哺乳動物會得到厚厚的冬季皮毛或躲在溫暖的地方冬眠.但昆蟲都做了甚麼?為何牠們在春天就會回歸?
epg.episode_synopsis_en: As soon as the days get cold and dark insects begin to disappear from the meadows and fields. Their sum and hum slowly fades away and will finally be gone. All animals have their special ways to survive winter. Migrating birds like swallows and cr...

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 太恐怖了!這是謀殺!殘酷的死亡以及刺激的戰鬥,還有特殊的絕地救援.你在看到它之後就會知道最令人毛骨悚然的地方其實就是你附近的草叢.利用來自恐怖類型的型格設備,這部非凡的自然紀錄片將帶您跟隨一位著名英雄,牠有六條腿,紅色的翅膀和七個黑點,這趟旅程的目的地是一個看似正常但充滿怪物的草叢.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: It is horror! It is murder! Brutal death as well as exciting fights with an exceptional last-minute rescue. And after seeing it – you will know the creepiest spot is actually the meadow in your neighborhood. With stylistic devices from the horror ...

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在馬達加斯加偏遠的伯倫蒂保育區,兩個環尾狐猴派別因正面臨旱季日益嚴峻的挑戰而拉起戰幔.這些魅力非凡的狐猴僅在馬達加斯加島上被發現,黑白相間的尾巴十分突出,牠們活在女權體制中,每個幫派都有嚴格的等級制度,並擁有各自嚴守的領土.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: As the dry season approaches, tensions rise on Lemur Island, both between rival gangs and within their own ranks. Get a view from the battlefield as the female leaders fiercely defend their turf, while their newborn infants cling to them for safety.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 齊來認識小熊溫斯頓,這隻被遺棄的幼熊與茱蒂建立了深厚的羈絆,因為得到她全天候的照顧.感受茱蒂如何忍痛切斷彼此的情感連結,並教導這個可愛的小傢伙,如何在沒有人類的野外世界,成為獨當一面的黑熊.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Get to know Winston, a tiny abandoned cub who imprints on Judy as she nurses him 24-7. Feel the heartbreak as she severs their emotional attachment and teaches this sweet little fellow how to be a grown-up, independent bear in the non-human world.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 準備好在濱海灣的鬥毆吧,在安娜和她的海濱家族遠在上游時,游牧人和城裡人家族佔領了她的領地.在這個海灣的合法主人突然返回之前,暫時享受一下這個豪華水道中平靜的水瀨生活吧.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Get ready to rumble in Marina Bay, where the Nomads and Townies are squatting while Anna and the Bay Family are away upriver. Soak up the peaceful otter life in this luxurious waterway before the surprise early return of its rightful owners.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: As soon as the days get cold and dark insects begin to disappear from the meadows and fields. Their sum and hum slowly fades away and will finally be gone. All animals have their special ways to survive winter. Migrating birds like swallows and cr...

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 太恐怖了!這是謀殺!殘酷的死亡以及刺激的戰鬥,還有特殊的絕地救援.你在看到它之後就會知道最令人毛骨悚然的地方其實就是你附近的草叢.利用來自恐怖類型的型格設備,這部非凡的自然紀錄片將帶您跟隨一位著名英雄,牠有六條腿,紅色的翅膀和七個黑點,這趟旅程的目的地是一個看似正常但充滿怪物的草叢.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: It is horror! It is murder! Brutal death as well as exciting fights with an exceptional last-minute rescue. And after seeing it – you will know the creepiest spot is actually the meadow in your neighborhood. With stylistic devices from the horror ...

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在馬達加斯加偏遠的伯倫蒂保育區,兩個環尾狐猴派別因正面臨旱季日益嚴峻的挑戰而拉起戰幔.這些魅力非凡的狐猴僅在馬達加斯加島上被發現,黑白相間的尾巴十分突出,牠們活在女權體制中,每個幫派都有嚴格的等級制度,並擁有各自嚴守的領土.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: As the dry season approaches, tensions rise on Lemur Island, both between rival gangs and within their own ranks. Get a view from the battlefield as the female leaders fiercely defend their turf, while their newborn infants cling to them for safety.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 齊來認識小熊溫斯頓,這隻被遺棄的幼熊與茱蒂建立了深厚的羈絆,因為得到她全天候的照顧.感受茱蒂如何忍痛切斷彼此的情感連結,並教導這個可愛的小傢伙,如何在沒有人類的野外世界,成為獨當一面的黑熊.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Get to know Winston, a tiny abandoned cub who imprints on Judy as she nurses him 24-7. Feel the heartbreak as she severs their emotional attachment and teaches this sweet little fellow how to be a grown-up, independent bear in the non-human world.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 見證鬥士們如何在非洲大草原的旱季中爭奪水源和其他珍貴資源.親眼目擊獅子和大象為爭奪地盤的激烈爭鬥,螞蟻襲擊白蟻丘,以及蜜獾與毒蛇聯袂上演的危險探戈.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Witness clashes over precious resources when the dry season brings a band of gladiators to an African savannah watering hole. See a lion-elephant territory brawl, an ant raid on a termite mound, and a honey badgers risky dance with a deadly snake.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 拜訪澳洲最狡猾的鬥士和他們驚人的武器庫.從袋鼠的致命拳擊和紅背蜘蛛精密設計的陷阱,暸解他們如何運用這些必殺技擊退敵人,同時應對氣候變化的侵害.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Go up against Australias wiliest gladiators and their impressive arsenals. Learn if these weapons, such as the kangaroos deadly boxing moves and the redback spiders precision-engineered traps, can help them survive the ravages of climate change.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 準備好在濱海灣的鬥毆吧,在安娜和她的海濱家族遠在上游時,游牧人和城裡人家族佔領了她的領地.在這個海灣的合法主人突然返回之前,暫時享受一下這個豪華水道中平靜的水瀨生活吧.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Get ready to rumble in Marina Bay, where the Nomads and Townies are squatting while Anna and the Bay Family are away upriver. Soak up the peaceful otter life in this luxurious waterway before the surprise early return of its rightful owners.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 與那些用力量征服敵人的獸王一起變得更強.海獅為贏得配偶而使出渾身解數,非洲水牛使出致命一擊,加拿大鵝用翅膀的猛烈撞擊以及母獅用鐵爪統治草原的景象將讓你驚歎不已.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Power-up with alphas who use might to subdue enemies. Marvel when sea lions throw their weight around to win a mate, Cape buffalo deliver knockout punches, Canada geese hit hard with their wings, and lionesses rule the savannah with an iron paw.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 從超遠距離的鯨歌,到大象的亞聲,再至墨魚皮膚上閃爍的訊息,動物們有著令人難以置信的調情,戰鬥,聊天和交合的方式,有著一整套動物語言等待我們解碼.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Join researchers as they study how animals communicate. Find out how wolves use their body language to unite the pack and maintain a sophisticated social structure, and see the astounding number of gestures chimps use to communicate.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 隨著旱季開始,成千上萬的動物正前往相思環.每頭動物都必須在捕食順序中確立自己的位置,避免那些非常願意以粗心的動物作大餐的危險居民.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: As the dry season begins, thousands of animals are making their way to the Acacia Loop. Each must establish their place in the pecking order and avoid the dangerous residents who are all too willing to make a meal of the unwary.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 毛拉是麥茲家族中最年輕的小牛.隨著氣溫飆升,潟湖和水潭正在枯竭.逼使毛拉和牠的家人進行一次漫長而危險的旅程,前往唯一剩下的水源:盧安瓜河.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Mvula is the youngest calf in the Madzi family. Temperatures are soaring. Lagoons and waterholes are drying up. This forces Mvula and his family to undertake a long and dangerous journey to the only remaining source of water: the Luangwa River.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在馬達加斯加偏遠的貝倫地保育區,旱季正對當地的環尾狐猴造成巨大的損耗.隨著覓食的難度增加,對立幫派領導人姬絲圖和嘉緹之間的關係越發緊張.隨著食物和水源日益稀缺,入侵者亦出現在附近.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: As food and water become scarce, Crystal, the fierce leader of the Ruins gang, sets her sights on rival Katis territory and its neighboring fruit trees. Watch as Crystals move and a raid by outside invaders lead to dire consequences for one troop.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 歡迎姐妹檔西巴,西拉和索拉,這三隻挨餓的孤兒讓溫斯頓的世界天翻地覆,直到溫柔的索拉教會溫斯頓友誼的意義.然後關注新來的幼熊雅思敏和雅拉,牠們在經歷驚險的分離後重新相聚.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Welcome sisters Xiba, Xyla, and Xola, a trio of starving orphans who turn Winstons world upside down before gentle Xola teaches him a lesson about friendship. Then monitor new cubs Yasmine and Yara, who get reacquainted after a stressful separation.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 歡迎安娜的族群回到海濱灣, 那裡有兩個擅自闖入的水獭家族.當米婭嗅到安娜的氣味並將湯尼族群趕得遠遠的時候,牠感受到了壓力.然後,當遊牧族群對即將發生的衝突一無所知時,請抓緊時間.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Welcome Annas clan back to Marina Bay, where two otter families have been trespassing. Feel the heat when Mia catches Annas scent and hustles the Townies out of reach. Then hold tight as the Nomads remain blissfully unaware of the coming conflict.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 隨著旱季開始,成千上萬的動物正前往相思環.每頭動物都必須在捕食順序中確立自己的位置,避免那些非常願意以粗心的動物作大餐的危險居民.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: As the dry season begins, thousands of animals are making their way to the Acacia Loop. Each must establish their place in the pecking order and avoid the dangerous residents who are all too willing to make a meal of the unwary.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 毛拉是麥茲家族中最年輕的小牛.隨著氣溫飆升,潟湖和水潭正在枯竭.逼使毛拉和牠的家人進行一次漫長而危險的旅程,前往唯一剩下的水源:盧安瓜河.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Mvula is the youngest calf in the Madzi family. Temperatures are soaring. Lagoons and waterholes are drying up. This forces Mvula and his family to undertake a long and dangerous journey to the only remaining source of water: the Luangwa River.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 看看那些面容醜陋,只有牠們的媽媽才會喜愛的獸王.看看疣豬那粗糙的盔甲,巨型非洲牛蛙那超強的跳躍和咬合能力,野火雞那鋒利的喙和剃刀般的尖爪,還有尼羅河鱷魚那毀天滅地的強有力下顎.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Confront alphas with faces only a mother could love. Inspect warthogs lumpy armour, giant African bullfrogs outsized jumping and biting skills, wild turkeys sharp beaks and razorlike spurs, and Nile crocodiles crushingly powerful jaws.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 隨著旱季開始,成千上萬的動物正前往相思環.每頭動物都必須在捕食順序中確立自己的位置,避免那些非常願意以粗心的動物作大餐的危險居民.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: As the dry season begins, thousands of animals are making their way to the Acacia Loop. Each must establish their place in the pecking order and avoid the dangerous residents who are all too willing to make a meal of the unwary.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 毛拉是麥茲家族中最年輕的小牛.隨著氣溫飆升,潟湖和水潭正在枯竭.逼使毛拉和牠的家人進行一次漫長而危險的旅程,前往唯一剩下的水源:盧安瓜河.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Mvula is the youngest calf in the Madzi family. Temperatures are soaring. Lagoons and waterholes are drying up. This forces Mvula and his family to undertake a long and dangerous journey to the only remaining source of water: the Luangwa River.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 從超遠距離的鯨歌,到大象的亞聲,再至墨魚皮膚上閃爍的訊息,動物們有著令人難以置信的調情,戰鬥,聊天和交合的方式,有著一整套動物語言等待我們解碼.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Tune into the natural world and explore frequencies beyond human hearing, like the gentle hum of giraffes in the evening, or creatures who use song to claim territory on a seemingly silent coral reef.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 探望鴿子佩妮和她的救命恩人,看看不幸的難民如何在養蜂的過程中找到安慰,並拜會明星土拔鼠.與一位鯊魚舞王在水㡳共舞,並見證韋安娜對獵豹費絲所許下的終生承諾.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Visit Penny the pigeon and the human who saved her, get a buzz from a refugee who found comfort in beekeeping, and see celebrity groundhogs. Dive with a shark dancer and feel touched by the deep, lifelong commitment Riana has to Faith the cheetah.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 看看一隻水獺如何融入家中,成為大家庭的一份子;與鵝寶寶貢博一起觀賞河邊景色,並探望一隻不幸失明的刺蝟和他的人類知心友.見證一位泳手與野生灰海豹在水中共舞,並與猴子和藪貓一起度過歡樂時光.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Embrace an invasive nutria whos become part of the family, paddle around with Gumbo the goose, and visit a blind hedgehog and his human chum. Explore a swimmers bond with wild gray seals and hang out with Cosima the monkey and Jasper the serval.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在長期乾旱過後,第一場雨的降臨大大地紓緩了馬達加斯加貝倫地保育區的環尾狐猴幫.森林裡的食物十分充足,對立幫派領導人姬絲圖和嘉緹率領族群離開領土大快朵頤.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The drought is finally over, but traversing the forest for food is still a gamble. See some leaders take the risk, leaving home territories undefended to feast on a cicada boom. When they return, trespassers are ready for a fight.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 跟隨溫斯頓和姐妹花搬進新建的居所,並努力學習野外生存技能.目睹雅思敏和雅拉在幼兒園中的權力鬥爭,然後關注不安分的幼熊維克多;因為牠突然跛腳,野放的日子要一再延後.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Bone up on outdoor skills as Winston and the X girls move into their new fresh-air enclosure, and witness Yasmine and Yaras kindergarten power struggle. Then look over restless yearling Victor, whose sudden limp pushes back his release date.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 跟隨海灣族群的女族長,牠將遊牧族群永遠趕出了自己的領地,並發現了湯尼族群領袖米婭定居的令人驚訝的繁衍巢穴.隨後,牠們與紅樹林族群放鬆一下,與流浪狗嬉戲.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Follow the Bay Familys matriarch as she chases the Nomads out of her territory for good, and examine the surprising birthing den where the Townies leader, Mia, settles in. Then kick back with the Mangrove Family as they pal around with stray dogs.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: Sidle up to lone wolf alphas whod rather go solo. Take a glacial stroll alongside a Galápagos tortoise; dance with venomous European adders; watch a face-tearing battle between Lacerta lizards; and gasp at leopard seals amazing stealth attacks.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: Could undiscovered animal languages save some of our most endangered species? From subtle scents to colors that are invisible to the human eye, uncover the hidden ways creatures communicate, which scientists are only starting to understand.

epg.programme_title_tc: 澳洲蛇類捕捉隊:死亡追捕 #5
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​與阿黛爾和米克展開意志的較量,他們試圖將一條蟒蛇引出排水管.靜候傑絲和丹試圖在一條鰭背蛇放出臭彈之前抓住它,然後與斯圖一起面對隱藏在大學牆壁中的危險蛇類.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Engage in a battle of wills with Adele and Mick as they try to coax a python out of a drainpipe. Stand by as Jess and Dan try to grab a keelback snake before it drops a stink bomb, then face a dangerous serpent hidden in a university wall with Stu.

epg.programme_title_tc: 澳洲蛇類捕捉隊:死亡追捕 #6
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​放鬆一下,觀看米克和阿黛爾在一個養老院中打斷一對交配的東部棕蛇.與斯圖和莉芙一起處理不需要的庫存,他們在倉庫中捕捉到一條綠樹蛇,然後與傑絲和丹一起悄悄接近一位兇險的訪客.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Kick back as Mick and Adele break up a pair of mating eastern brown snakes at a retirement home. Take care of unwanted inventory with Stu and Liv, who capture a green tree snake in a warehouse, then sneak up on a killer visitor with Jess and Dan.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 以澳洲最近發生災難性森林大火的後續,透過充滿希望,人為干預和復原力的故事,記錄野生動植物的長期恢復情況.本節目發放了一個十萬火急的訊息,不要太遲愛護大自然.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Examine fires pivotal role in shaping Australias natural world. Tour the devastation left by 2020s brutal bush-fire season, learn how climate change fuelled this watershed event, and chart the long-term recovery of the continents wildlife.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 狐?島上的幫派奮力保持族群的健康和領土的完整.隨著嬰兒們成長,牠們的階級架構開始出現裂縫,權力備受考驗.由學習食甚麼,交友,結盟到在族群中找到一席之地,狐?島上嬰兒的生活跟成年狐?一樣艱辛.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: As the babies grow, new power struggles break out in each troop. Watch as every member, from fierce Queen Crystal to low-ranking Erica, jockeys for position. Meanwhile, the babies start to understand how allies and enemies will shape their future.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 與雅思敏和雅拉一起在雨中嬉戲和享受攀爬的樂趣,並跟隨溫斯頓在新水池中的暢泳.與羅傑和史蒂夫一起尋找掉落的無線電項圈,並見證兩群夏季幼熊的首次相遇.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Experience the joys of rain and climbing with Yasmine and Yara, and watch Winston take a dip in his new pool. Go hunting for dropped radio collars with Roger and Steve, then see what happens when the two groups of summer cubs come face-to-face.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 探望鴿子佩妮和她的救命恩人,看看不幸的難民如何在養蜂的過程中找到安慰,並拜會明星土拔鼠.與一位鯊魚舞王在水㡳共舞,並見證韋安娜對獵豹費絲所許下的終生承諾.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Visit Penny the pigeon and the human who saved her, get a buzz from a refugee who found comfort in beekeeping, and see celebrity groundhogs. Dive with a shark dancer and feel touched by the deep, lifelong commitment Riana has to Faith the cheetah.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 看看一隻水獺如何融入家中,成為大家庭的一份子;與鵝寶寶貢博一起觀賞河邊景色,並探望一隻不幸失明的刺蝟和他的人類知心友.見證一位泳手與野生灰海豹在水中共舞,並與猴子和藪貓一起度過歡樂時光.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Embrace an invasive nutria whos become part of the family, paddle around with Gumbo the goose, and visit a blind hedgehog and his human chum. Explore a swimmers bond with wild gray seals and hang out with Cosima the monkey and Jasper the serval.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 追隨安娜的步伐,到湯尼族群的巢穴去, 米婭和牠剛出生的幼崽便藏身於此.在族群搬到新的棲息地之前,看看小水獭們的第一堂游泳課,當紅樹林族群成為公園的主要景點時,將迎來一個水獭和平的時代.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Chase Anna to the Townies lair, where Mia and her newborn pups are hiding out. See the babies first swimming lessons before the clan moves to new digs, and welcome an era of otter peace as the Mangrove Family becomes a parks main attraction.

epg.programme_title_tc: 澳洲蛇類捕捉隊:死亡追捕 #5
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​與阿黛爾和米克展開意志的較量,他們試圖將一條蟒蛇引出排水管.靜候傑絲和丹試圖在一條鰭背蛇放出臭彈之前抓住它,然後與斯圖一起面對隱藏在大學牆壁中的危險蛇類.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Engage in a battle of wills with Adele and Mick as they try to coax a python out of a drainpipe. Stand by as Jess and Dan try to grab a keelback snake before it drops a stink bomb, then face a dangerous serpent hidden in a university wall with Stu.

epg.programme_title_tc: 澳洲蛇類捕捉隊:死亡追捕 #6
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​放鬆一下,觀看米克和阿黛爾在一個養老院中打斷一對交配的東部棕蛇.與斯圖和莉芙一起處理不需要的庫存,他們在倉庫中捕捉到一條綠樹蛇,然後與傑絲和丹一起悄悄接近一位兇險的訪客.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Kick back as Mick and Adele break up a pair of mating eastern brown snakes at a retirement home. Take care of unwanted inventory with Stu and Liv, who capture a green tree snake in a warehouse, then sneak up on a killer visitor with Jess and Dan.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 以澳洲最近發生災難性森林大火的後續,透過充滿希望,人為干預和復原力的故事,記錄野生動植物的長期恢復情況.本節目發放了一個十萬火急的訊息,不要太遲愛護大自然.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Examine fires pivotal role in shaping Australias natural world. Tour the devastation left by 2020s brutal bush-fire season, learn how climate change fuelled this watershed event, and chart the long-term recovery of the continents wildlife.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 狐?島上的幫派奮力保持族群的健康和領土的完整.隨著嬰兒們成長,牠們的階級架構開始出現裂縫,權力備受考驗.由學習食甚麼,交友,結盟到在族群中找到一席之地,狐?島上嬰兒的生活跟成年狐?一樣艱辛.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: As the babies grow, new power struggles break out in each troop. Watch as every member, from fierce Queen Crystal to low-ranking Erica, jockeys for position. Meanwhile, the babies start to understand how allies and enemies will shape their future.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: Embrace an invasive nutria whos become part of the family, paddle around with Gumbo the goose, and visit a blind hedgehog and his human chum. Explore a swimmers bond with wild gray seals and hang out with Cosima the monkey and Jasper the serval.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 從超遠距離的鯨歌,到大象的亞聲,再至墨魚皮膚上閃爍的訊息,動物們有著令人難以置信的調情,戰鬥,聊天和交合的方式,有著一整套動物語言等待我們解碼.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Could undiscovered animal languages save some of our most endangered species? From subtle scents to colors that are invisible to the human eye, uncover the hidden ways creatures communicate, which scientists are only starting to understand.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: Examine fires pivotal role in shaping Australias natural world. Tour the devastation left by 2020s brutal bush-fire season, learn how climate change fuelled this watershed event, and chart the long-term recovery of the continents wildlife.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 與地球上最健談的物種交流.見識一下喋喋不休的卷尾猴;忍受歐亞水獺令人毛骨悚然的尖叫.面對憤怒果蝠的大聲抱怨;以及探索虎鯨的人類級別的語音系統.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Connect with Earths most talkative species. Meet capuchin monkeys, who definitely dont take a vow of silence; endure Eurasian river otters chilling screams; face angry fruit bats loud complaints; and explore orcas human-scale speech systems.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 位於美國西岸的蒙特雷灣國家海洋保護區是美國最大的海洋保護區,那裡擁有525種魚類,還有一個巨大的海藻林.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: On the West Coast of the United States, the Monterey Bay National Marine Sanctuary is the largest marine sanctuary in the country - home to 525 species of fish, and a massive, underwater Kelp forest.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 馬達加斯加大狐猴indris是現存原猴類中體型最大的類群,他們每天在雨林中尋找食物和躲避捕食者.讓我們看看這些瀕臨滅絕的靈長類動物如何在迅速縮小的棲息地中克服一切困難生存下來.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: This is the story of a day in the life of an Indris Family following a mother, father, and their three offspring around their home in the rainforest of Mantadia National Park in Madagascar.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 當家庭分崩離析,一隻幼獅必須活下來; 兩隻青少年豹崽在被遺棄後必須自生自滅,一隻年輕的成年黑羚必須冒上生命和肢體的危險,因牠試圖保證第一次交配.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A young lion cub must survive as his family is torn apart; two adolescent leopard cubs must fend for themselves after they are abandoned, and a young adult blackbuck must risk life and limb as he tries to secure his first mating.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 華贊是一頭強大的雄性領袖,坐擁一個異常龐大的部隊.他在維持這個大集團方面做得很好,但未來的路並不明朗.還有更多的同伴需要糊口,但牠的叢林正在萎縮.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Rajan is the powerful alpha male who sits at the head of an unusually large troop. He has done well to sustain such a big group, but the future doesnt look so bright. There are more mouths to feed, and yet his jungle home is shrinking.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 豪華的廟宇花園坐落在古城焦特布爾的邊緣位置,是一大群長尾葉猴的家,牠們享受著寧靜的生活,卻有嚴格的等級制度.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Nestled on the edge of the ancient city of Jodhpur, the luxurious Temple Gardens are home to a huge troop of Hanuman Langurs, who enjoy a peaceful life of bounty. But the troop has a strict hierarchy.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在印度南部炎熱又潮濕的熱帶森林中,一位雌性眼鏡王蛇正在執行任務:在季候風到來前,她需要找到伴侶,食物並順利下蛋.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In the hot forest of Southern India, a female King Cobra is on a mission: to find a mate, find food, and lay eggs before the monsoon arrives.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在印度南部的森林中,夏季無情的酷熱給亞洲大象帶來了挑戰,他們每天都需要喝水.當水開始在周圍消失時,聰明的女族長安露娜決定帶領她的家人遷移到遙遠的水源.她能否成功為3個月大的孫子找到新水源?
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In southern India, the summer is a challenge for Asian elephants who must drink every day. As things dry up, Anura, the matriarch, leads her herd to a distant watering hole. But will she succeed in getting her 3-month-old grandson there in time?

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 壯觀,刺激和累人的海陸空之旅是許多物種生活中的關鍵.這些王國為尋找食物,棲息地或伴侶而踏上旅途.但當這些計劃涉及數百甚至數千個體時,預訂和組織旅程就變得不容易了.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Epic flights, adventurous sea journeys and exhausting road trips all play a key part in the lives of many species. These empires travel in search of food, shelter or a mate. But booking and organizing travel is no easy feat when those plans involv...

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在馬達加斯加偏遠的伯倫蒂保育區,兩個環尾狐猴派別因正面臨旱季日益嚴峻的挑戰而拉起戰幔.這些魅力非凡的狐猴僅在馬達加斯加島上被發現,黑白相間的尾巴十分突出,牠們活在女權體制中,每個幫派都有嚴格的等級制度,並擁有各自嚴守的領土.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: As the dry season approaches, tensions rise on Lemur Island, both between rival gangs and within their own ranks. Get a view from the battlefield as the female leaders fiercely defend their turf, while their newborn infants cling to them for safety.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在馬達加斯加偏遠的貝倫地保育區,旱季正對當地的環尾狐猴造成巨大的損耗.隨著覓食的難度增加,對立幫派領導人姬絲圖和嘉緹之間的關係越發緊張.隨著食物和水源日益稀缺,入侵者亦出現在附近.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: As food and water become scarce, Crystal, the fierce leader of the Ruins gang, sets her sights on rival Katis territory and its neighboring fruit trees. Watch as Crystals move and a raid by outside invaders lead to dire consequences for one troop.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在長期乾旱過後,第一場雨的降臨大大地紓緩了馬達加斯加貝倫地保育區的環尾狐猴幫.森林裡的食物十分充足,對立幫派領導人姬絲圖和嘉緹率領族群離開領土大快朵頤.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The drought is finally over, but traversing the forest for food is still a gamble. See some leaders take the risk, leaving home territories undefended to feast on a cicada boom. When they return, trespassers are ready for a fight.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 狐?島上的幫派奮力保持族群的健康和領土的完整.隨著嬰兒們成長,牠們的階級架構開始出現裂縫,權力備受考驗.由學習食甚麼,交友,結盟到在族群中找到一席之地,狐?島上嬰兒的生活跟成年狐?一樣艱辛.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: As the babies grow, new power struggles break out in each troop. Watch as every member, from fierce Queen Crystal to low-ranking Erica, jockeys for position. Meanwhile, the babies start to understand how allies and enemies will shape their future.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​重溫棕熊的進化之旅,從主宰冰河時期的熊科祖先到今天的現代雜食動物.見證它們與鮭魚之間的共生關係,以及它們所繁榮的驚人互聯生態系統.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Revisit the evolutionary journey of brown bears, from ursid ancestors that dominated the ice ages to todays modern omnivores. Witness their symbiotic relationship with salmon and the surprisingly interconnected ecosystems they thrive in.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​跟隨黑犀牛的旅程,看看適應和保護如何影響這位古老自然巨人的進化.體驗這種裝甲草食動物的非凡聽力,嗅覺和其他生物優勢.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Follow the journey of the black rhino and see how adaptation and conservation have influenced the evolution of an ancient titan of nature. Experience this armoured herbivores extraordinary hearing, sense of smell, and other biological advantages.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​深入了解非洲最具標誌性但被誤解的巨型動物之一:河馬的生活.進入一場對抗賽的中心,看看一隻領土雄性河馬的咬合有多致命,然後見證它們在水下出生的奇蹟.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Look inside the life of one of Africas most iconic but misunderstood megafauna: the hippopotamus. Get in the middle of a sparring match and see just how deadly a territorial males bite can be, then witness the miracle of their underwater births.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​了解適應性如何幫助鱷魚,這種與恐龍一樣古老的生物,進化以面對現代世界.觀看蝴蝶如何以它們的眼淚為食,然後驚嘆於它們的共同育嬰所展現的母愛奉獻.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Understand how adaptability has helped the caiman, a beast as old as the dinosaurs, evolve to face the modern world. Watch butterflies feed on their tears, then marvel at the maternal devotion on display in their communal nurseries.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 窺探全球昆蟲數量銳減對地球可能造成的衝擊,揭露我們千百年來對這些微小伙伴的依賴,以及牠們在生態系統中所扮演的關鍵角色.了解人類與昆蟲之間的微妙關係如何面臨危機.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Look at what a global insect decline could do to our planet. Uncover our historical dependence on these tiny animals, the vital roles they play in our ecosystems, and the reasons why our fragile relationship to them is in danger worldwide.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 了解蜜蜂,蝴蝶與飛蛾如何讓田野和樹林充滿生機.想像如果這些勤勞的蟲蟲消失,世界會如何變樣.見證神祕的蝴蝶遷徙之旅,以及飛蛾如何巧妙地躲避飢餓的蝙蝠.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Learn how bees, butterflies, moths, and other pollinators keep our fields and forests fruitful, and weigh what life would be like if these busy bugs vanished. Witness a mysterious butterfly pilgrimage and a moths clever way of escaping hungry bats.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 迎戰專為殺戮而生的掠食性昆蟲,了解具有武術家身手的螳螂如何令人畏懼,然後跟隨大開殺戒的蜻蜓在半空中狩獵.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Go up against predatory insects that are tailor-made for killing. See why the terrifying praying mantis has the agility of a martial artist and an appetite for everything from flies to hummingbirds, then go hunting in mid-air with deadly dragonflies.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: Portugal’s coastal waters and the Azores archipelago boast rich ecosystems. Explore the diverse species living in these waters and discover their unique lives in this revealing episode.

epg.programme_title_en: Secrets Of The Great White Shark
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 鯊魚是怪物嗎?還是已經被妖魔化?這部紀錄片探討大白鯊本性背後的真相.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Reptiles, amphibians, insects and fish are found in every corner of our world - and for this special group of animals, life is regulated by the sun.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 廖崇明跟堂弟交流他30多年來製作海南雞飯的心得.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Adam Liaw catches up with a cousin from his fathers side of the family to learn how he has been making Hainanese chicken rice for over 30 years.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 廖崇明從當地穆斯林家庭學習製作正宗巴東牛肉.他到訪新加坡國家檔案館查找母親家族的資料,並繼續尋找新加坡國宴的靈感.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Adam learns to make authentic beef rendang from a local Muslim family. He visits the National Archives of Singapore to learn about his mothers family, and continues his search for inspiration for his Singapore banquet dinner.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 廖崇明到訪峇峇娘惹美食傳奇人物溫美玉的餐廳- 國家廚房.然後,他前往牛車水參觀澳洲人大衛偏特的餐廳- Burnt Ends.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Adam visits Peranakan food legend Violet Oons restaurant, National Kitchen. He then heads to Chinatown to visit Aussie Dave Pynts restaurant, Burnt Ends.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 廖崇明尋找新加坡最好的海鮮.他從濱海灣金沙酒店出發,那裡有許多名廚開設的餐廳.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Adam goes in search of the best seafood that Singapore has to offer. His journey begins inside the Marina Bay Sands resort complex where many celebrity chefs have opened eateries.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 廖崇明前往著名的牛頓熟食中心,繼續尋找海鮮靈感.他教授了如何安排一場獨一無二海鮮盛宴的大師班.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Adam Liaw continues his search for seafood inspiration by heading to the famous Newton Food Centre. He gives a masterclass on how to line up a seafood feast like no other.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 廖崇明從新加坡動物園的傳統早餐,包括咖央多士,溫泉蛋和咖啡開始,尋找新加坡最好的蔬菜菜式.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Adam Liaw goes in search of Singapores best vegetable dishes, kicking off with a traditional breakfast at Singapore Zoo, including kaya toast with half-cooked eggs and coffee.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 為了尋找最適合國宴的食材,廖崇明到訪色彩繽紛的芽籠蔬果市場以及米芝蓮星級餐廳.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In his quest to find the best ingredients for his banquet dinner, Adam Liaw visits a colourful fruit and veg market in Geylang and a Michelin-starred restaurant.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在貝裡斯,詹姆斯與奧利弗·菲力普斯與阿爾菲·伊諾奇相聚.他們探索拉馬奈的瑪雅遺址,走訪水洞,了解門諾會文化,巡禮聖佩德羅的街頭美食,飛越藍洞,並在霍爾香珊瑚礁潛水.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: James and Oliver Phelps join Alfie Enoch in Belize. They explore Mayan ruins at Lamanai, visit water caves, learn about Mennonite culture, tour San Pedros street food, fly over the Blue Hole, and dive in the Hol Chan coral reefs.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在新加坡,馬克·威廉士加入菲力普斯雙胞胎的行列,他們騎著側邊車穿越唐人街,體驗舞獅,並搭乘渡輪前往烏敏島劃劃皮艇穿梭紅樹林.在這趟刺激的旅程中,他們還深入探索了娘惹文化,歷史文物與在地美食.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Joined by Mark Williams in Singapore, the Phelps twins ride sidecars through Chinatown, try Lion Dancing, and ferry to Pulau Ubin to kayak the mangroves. They also explore Peranakan culture, artifacts, and local cuisine on this thrilling trip.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 與嘉賓柯瑞·米克利斯特一起,詹姆斯和奧利弗造訪了墨爾本.他們遊覽雅拉河,觀賞菲利普島的小企鵝,駕駛卡丁車,乘坐普芬比利蒸汽火車,在貝爾斯海灘體驗衝浪課程,還在一架二戰老式飛機上上演空中特技.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: With guest Corey Mylchreest, James and Oliver explore Melbourne. They cruise the Yarra River, see Phillip Islands penguins, race go-karts, ride Puffing Billy, take a surf lesson at Bell’s Beach, and perform stunts in a WWII plane.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在雞尾酒會期間,從峇峇娘惹的私房甜品到精緻的甜品吧,廖崇明發現了一些新加坡最好的甜品.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In between some cocktail-tasting pit stops, Adam Liaw discovers some of the finest desserts in Singapore, from homemade Peranakan sweet treats to a sophisticated dessert bar.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 廖崇明把過去幾週所學到的知識融匯貫通,為包括他母親在內的一些貴客提供令人印象深刻的五道菜晚宴.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Adam Liaw gathers what he has learned over the past few weeks to serve up an impressive five-course banquet dinner to some distinguished guests, including his mother.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 起司大師阿弗林・普裡斯汀的起司探險之旅從阿爾卑斯山國瑞士展開,這裡是格魯耶爾與經典孔洞艾門塔起司的故鄉.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Cheese Master Afrim Pristine begins his cheese expedition in the Alpine country of Switzerland, home of iconic classics like Gruyere and holey Swiss Emmental.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在法國,吃起司幾乎是一項全民嗜好.阿弗林走訪巴黎到諾曼第,探索全國各地悠久而豐富的起司製作歷史.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Eating cheese is a national pastime in France. Here, Afrim uncovers the rich histories of cheesemaking across the country from Paris to Normandy.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 阿弗林深入加拿大魁北克的濃厚起司傳統,當地家族乳酪坊的技藝世代相傳,延續至今.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Afrim takes in the cheesy traditions of la belle province, Quebec, where family fromageries』 traditions have been passed on through generations.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在貝裡斯,詹姆斯與奧利弗·菲力普斯與阿爾菲·伊諾奇相聚.他們探索拉馬奈的瑪雅遺址,走訪水洞,了解門諾會文化,巡禮聖佩德羅的街頭美食,飛越藍洞,並在霍爾香珊瑚礁潛水.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在犀牛孤兒院需要耐性與忠誠,因為他們要撫養那些因偷獵而失去母親的年輕犀牛.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: It takes patience and commitment for The Rhino Orphanage, as they nurture young rhinos whose mothers have been lost to poaching.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 兩頭最老的犀牛將重返大自然.三頭犀牛的失蹤引起鬨動,而年輕的犀牛則逐漸康復和變得快樂.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The two oldest rhinos are set to be released back into the wild. Three rhinos cause a stir as they go missing, while the younger rhinos make steady progress toward health and happiness.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 偷獵危機加劇,偷獵者將注意力轉向孤兒們.四周大的牙美拿失去母親後終於在犀牛孤兒院找到庇護.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The poaching crisis intensifies and poachers turn their attention to orphanages. After losing her mother, four-week-old Jamila finally finds sanctuary at The Rhino Orphanage.

epg.programme_title_en: Atlantic: A Year In The Wild #1
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 探索大西洋的荒野和野生動物.冬天帶來嚴苛的風暴,苦難和衝突,大多數動物都要為生存而戰.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Exploring the wilderness and wildlife of the Atlantic Ocean. Winter brings bitter storms, suffering and conflict, while most are battling to survive.

epg.programme_title_en: Atlantic: A Year In The Wild #2
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在冬天的尾巴,大西洋再度生機盎然.在深海水域過冬的魚群再度回歸.一對老鷹在完美捕魚點的高空築巢.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: As winter draws to a close, the Atlantic springs back to life. Fish that spent the winter out in the deeper water have returned. An eagle pair has set up home high above the perfect fishing spot.

epg.programme_title_en: Atlantic: A Year In The Wild #3
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 夏天代表食物充足,今年的幼崽們必須進食,長大並準備自立.對海鸚來說,當從懸崖頂的巢穴跳落大海時,實在是一次巨大的信仰之躍.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Summer means food is plentiful and this years youngsters must feed, grow and prepare to start life alone. For puffins its a massive leap of faith as they jump from their cliff-top nests into the ocean.

epg.programme_title_en: Atlantic: A Year In The Wild #4
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在大西洋最北端,秋季是大風,涼意和大雨的季節.野生動物於此時必須為過冬做足最後準備,或遷移到溫暖的地區.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In the Atlantics far north, autumn is the season of gales, cooling temperatures and driving rain. This is when the wildlife must make the final preparations for winter or migrate to warmer climes.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 葡萄牙沿海水域和亞速爾群島擁有豐富的生態系統.在本集探索生活在這些水域的多元化物種,並發掘牠們獨特的生活.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在引人入勝的本集,雷利分享他放生犀牛的夢想.茱迪心愛的麂羚是時候回歸大自然.例行的東非條紋羚捕捉行動發生意想不到的轉折.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In this engaging episode, Reilly shares his rhino release dream. It’s time for Judy’s beloved duiker to return to the wild. And, a routine nyala capture takes an unexpected turn.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在本集一個疣豬回收行動出了差錯.來認識韋札保育區的母系社會,一頭奇特大象的獨家故事.是時候告別韋札的家人.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In this episode, a warthog retrieval mission goes awry. Meet the matriarch of Imire, a wonderful elephant that has a unique story. It’s time to say farewell to the Imire family.

epg.programme_title_en: Atlantic: A Year In The Wild #3
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 夏天代表食物充足,今年的幼崽們必須進食,長大並準備自立.對海鸚來說,當從懸崖頂的巢穴跳落大海時,實在是一次巨大的信仰之躍.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Summer means food is plentiful and this years youngsters must feed, grow and prepare to start life alone. For puffins its a massive leap of faith as they jump from their cliff-top nests into the ocean.

epg.programme_title_en: Atlantic: A Year In The Wild #4
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在大西洋最北端,秋季是大風,涼意和大雨的季節.野生動物於此時必須為過冬做足最後準備,或遷移到溫暖的地區.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In the Atlantics far north, autumn is the season of gales, cooling temperatures and driving rain. This is when the wildlife must make the final preparations for winter or migrate to warmer climes.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 以當時報導山姆之子的方式呈現事件,讓你沉浸在這謀殺案的戲劇中.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Immerse yourself in the drama of the Son of Sam murders, presented the way the events were covered at the time.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: Witness the story of President Clintons impeachment, presented through archival footage of the day.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 見證美國南部和中西部如何在短短18小時內遭受148個龍捲風肆虐.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Witness how Americas South and Midwest were ravaged by 148 twisters in just 18 hours.

epg.programme_title_en: Leonardo DiCaprio: Road To The Revenant
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 《李奧納多狄卡皮歐:崛起之路》紀錄了他從崛起新星到影壇傳奇的歷程.在突破性角色,與史柯西斯的合作以及對環保倡議的推動下,他對卓越藝術的執著追求最終讓他榮獲奧斯卡影帝殊榮.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Leonardo DiCaprio: The Road to The Revenant traces his rise from breakout star to cinema icon. Driven by bold roles, Scorsese collaborations, and eco-advocacy, his relentless pursuit of artistic excellence culminates in an epic Oscar win.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 李奧納多·狄卡皮歐與湯姆·哈迪主演阿利安卓·崗札雷·伊納利圖執導的這部史詩級震撼巨作.故事根據真實事件改編,背景設定在美國未開墾的荒野,講述一段關於生存與背叛的故事.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Leonardo DiCaprio and Tom Hardy star in Alejandro González Iñárritus visceral, epic tale of survival and betrayal inspired by true events thats set in Americas uncharted wilderness.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 葡萄牙沿海水域和亞速爾群島擁有豐富的生態系統.在本集探索生活在這些水域的多元化物種,並發掘牠們獨特的生活.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Portugal’s coastal waters and the Azores archipelago boast rich ecosystems. Explore the diverse species living in these waters and discover their unique lives in this revealing episode.

epg.programme_title_en: Secrets Of The Great White Shark
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 鯊魚是怪物嗎?還是已經被妖魔化?這部紀錄片探討大白鯊本性背後的真相.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Reptiles, amphibians, insects and fish are found in every corner of our world - and for this special group of animals, life is regulated by the sun.

epg.programme_title_en: Atlantic: A Year In The Wild #1
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 探索大西洋的荒野和野生動物.冬天帶來嚴苛的風暴,苦難和衝突,大多數動物都要為生存而戰.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Exploring the wilderness and wildlife of the Atlantic Ocean. Winter brings bitter storms, suffering and conflict, while most are battling to survive.

epg.programme_title_en: Atlantic: A Year In The Wild #2
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在冬天的尾巴,大西洋再度生機盎然.在深海水域過冬的魚群再度回歸.一對老鷹在完美捕魚點的高空築巢.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: As winter draws to a close, the Atlantic springs back to life. Fish that spent the winter out in the deeper water have returned. An eagle pair has set up home high above the perfect fishing spot.

epg.programme_title_en: Atlantic: A Year In The Wild #3
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 夏天代表食物充足,今年的幼崽們必須進食,長大並準備自立.對海鸚來說,當從懸崖頂的巢穴跳落大海時,實在是一次巨大的信仰之躍.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: Reptiles, amphibians, insects and fish are found in every corner of our world - and for this special group of animals, life is regulated by the sun.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在巴塔哥尼亞瓦爾德斯半島的中心,鯨魚經常遭到一種體型嬌小卻意圖兇殘的掠食者襲擊--海鷗.牠們迫使鯨魚潛入深海,遠離賴以生存的氧氣與光線.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In the heart of the Valdees Peninsula, in Patagonia, whales are regularly hunted by a predator whose diminutive size hides its gruesome intentions: the seagull, forcing whales to dive deep into the depths, away from essential oxygen and light.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 《生存邊緣》檢視全球生物圈所面臨的存亡威脅,以及對地球和奧特亞羅瓦(紐西蘭)的未來代表著甚麼.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Edge of Existence examines existential threats to the worlds biosphere and what it means for the future of the planet, and Aotearoa.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 《生存邊緣》探索人類有史以來面臨的最大存亡風險之一的未來- 一個生化威脅.從病毒到人造流行病和合成生化武器,科技正加速人造威脅的風險.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Edge of Existence explores a future where bio-threats present one of the greatest existential risks that humanity has ever faced. From viruses to man-made pandemics and synthetic bio-weapons, technology is accelerating the risks of man-made threats.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 《生存邊緣》探索一個近未來,人工智慧統治著地球和我們.人工智慧將伴隨我們一生,並帶來人類史上所面臨的最大存亡風險.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Edge of Existence explores a near-future where artificial intelligence rules the planet, and us. AI will arrive in our life-times bringing with it the biggest existential risk humanity has ever faced.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 《生存邊緣》檢視全球生物圈所面臨的存亡威脅,以及對地球和奧特亞羅瓦(紐西蘭)的未來代表著甚麼.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: In the Atlantics far north, autumn is the season of gales, cooling temperatures and driving rain. This is when the wildlife must make the final preparations for winter or migrate to warmer climes.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 由牠們的齒與爪,到令人難以置信的隱身和狡猾,大自然最致命的掠食者進化出一系列令人震驚的狩獵技術.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: From their teeth, and claws, to incredible stealth and cunning, nature’s most lethal predators have evolved a staggering array of hunting techniques.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 我們在本集見證大自然最非凡的動物遷徙,並發現牠們為了生存而必須出走多遠.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In this episode we witness nature’s most extraordinary animal migrations, and discover the lengths they must go to, in order to survive.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在貝裡斯,詹姆斯與奧利弗·菲力普斯與阿爾菲·伊諾奇相聚.他們探索拉馬奈的瑪雅遺址,走訪水洞,了解門諾會文化,巡禮聖佩德羅的街頭美食,飛越藍洞,並在霍爾香珊瑚礁潛水.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: James and Oliver Phelps join Alfie Enoch in Belize. They explore Mayan ruins at Lamanai, visit water caves, learn about Mennonite culture, tour San Pedros street food, fly over the Blue Hole, and dive in the Hol Chan coral reefs.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在新加坡,馬克·威廉士加入菲力普斯雙胞胎的行列,他們騎著側邊車穿越唐人街,體驗舞獅,並搭乘渡輪前往烏敏島劃劃皮艇穿梭紅樹林.在這趟刺激的旅程中,他們還深入探索了娘惹文化,歷史文物與在地美食.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Joined by Mark Williams in Singapore, the Phelps twins ride sidecars through Chinatown, try Lion Dancing, and ferry to Pulau Ubin to kayak the mangroves. They also explore Peranakan culture, artifacts, and local cuisine on this thrilling trip.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 與嘉賓柯瑞·米克利斯特一起,詹姆斯和奧利弗造訪了墨爾本.他們遊覽雅拉河,觀賞菲利普島的小企鵝,駕駛卡丁車,乘坐普芬比利蒸汽火車,在貝爾斯海灘體驗衝浪課程,還在一架二戰老式飛機上上演空中特技.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: With guest Corey Mylchreest, James and Oliver explore Melbourne. They cruise the Yarra River, see Phillip Islands penguins, race go-karts, ride Puffing Billy, take a surf lesson at Bell’s Beach, and perform stunts in a WWII plane.

epg.programme_title_en: John Cena: Champion Of The Ring
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 莊先拿在繼巨石強森- 狄維莊遜後轉戰好萊塢之前,叱吒摔角界十多年.無論是演戲還是摔跤,他都遵守自己的座右銘:努力,忠誠,尊重.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: John Cena dominated wrestling for over a decade before transitioning to Hollywood, following Dwayne The Rock Johnson. Whether acting or wrestling, he lives by his mantra: Hustle, Loyalty, and Respect.

epg.programme_title_en: Arthur: A Life With The Royal Family
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 亞瑟在四十多年來拍攝主要王室成員的照片,不僅與他們建立了工作關係,並跟國王查爾斯三世和王后成了朋友.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: For over four decades, Arthur, has photographed key members of the royal family and has established a working relationship with the royals and a friendship with King Charles III and the Queen Consort, Camilla.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 摩根費裡曼是好萊塢最知名的演員之一,以其有力的聲線和溫文的舉止見稱.儘管他的特質廣為人知,但真實的他卻不是眾所周知.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Morgan Freeman is one of the most recognisable actors in Hollywood with his powerful voice and calming demeanour. Despite his recognisable traits, Morgan wasnt always well known...

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在犀牛孤兒院需要耐性與忠誠,因為他們要撫養那些因偷獵而失去母親的年輕犀牛.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: It takes patience and commitment for The Rhino Orphanage, as they nurture young rhinos whose mothers have been lost to poaching.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 兩頭最老的犀牛將重返大自然.三頭犀牛的失蹤引起鬨動,而年輕的犀牛則逐漸康復和變得快樂.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The two oldest rhinos are set to be released back into the wild. Three rhinos cause a stir as they go missing, while the younger rhinos make steady progress toward health and happiness.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 偷獵危機加劇,偷獵者將注意力轉向孤兒們.四周大的牙美拿失去母親後終於在犀牛孤兒院找到庇護.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The poaching crisis intensifies and poachers turn their attention to orphanages. After losing her mother, four-week-old Jamila finally finds sanctuary at The Rhino Orphanage.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 領略納米比亞千公裡的狂野海岸!乾旱沙漠中生命頑強綻放,本片捕捉了萬物在極端環境下生存的壯麗奇景.一同見證超越極限的生命之美!
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Experience Namibia’s wild 1,000km coast! Where arid deserts meet stubborn life, this film captures a grandiose, fragile spectacle of nature thriving against all odds. Witness the impossible beauty!

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 從落基山脈到太平洋,英屬哥倫比亞是生物多樣性的瑰寶!在遼闊大地追隨灰熊的霸氣身影.這是一片莊嚴且神聖,亟需我們守護的原始荒野!
epg.episode_synopsis_en: From the Rockies to the Pacific, British Columbia is a jewel of biodiversity! Roam vast landscapes where the mighty grizzly bear reigns supreme. It’s a majestic, wild world waiting to be preserved!

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 生命自會找到出路!隨風漂流而來的物種,讓加勒比海成為全球生物多樣性熱點.深入探索這些迷人而脆弱的翡翠生態系,感受海島生機.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Life finds a way! Blown by winds and washed ashore, the Caribbean is now a mesmerizing hotspot of global biodiversity. Explore these fragile, emerald ecosystems and their incredible island resilience.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 《恐龍效應》是一部關於現今加拿大古生物學復興的紀錄片,恐龍能怎樣教導我們有關氣候變化的知識.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The Dinosaur Echo is a documentary about the renaissance of paleontology in Canada today and what dinosaurs can teach us about climate change.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 隨著電子遊戲崛起,科技巨頭索尼嘗試與任天堂合作.但在一次驚人的背叛後,索尼創立了後來成為世上最成功的遊戲主機.Playstation從此屹立不倒.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: With video-games on the rise, Sony, the tech superpower would attempt a collaboration with Nintendo. After a shocking betrayal, Sony founded what would become the world’s most successful chain of video game consoles. The Playstation was here to stay.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 一種由鋼和鈦製成的獨特巨型運輸工具,有著一個特殊用途:提煉數噸黃金.這款所謂的滅菌釜是同類之最.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A unique mega transport made of steel and titanium with a special purpose: to extract tons of gold. This so-called autoclave is the biggest of its kind.
