epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 奧克蘭動物園的靈長類小組準備迎接新生.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Auckland Zoo’s primate team prepare to welcome a new birth.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在犀牛孤兒院需要耐性與忠誠,因為他們要撫養那些因偷獵而失去母親的年輕犀牛.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: It takes patience and commitment for The Rhino Orphanage, as they nurture young rhinos whose mothers have been lost to poaching.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 兩頭最老的犀牛將重返大自然.三頭犀牛的失蹤引起鬨動,而年輕的犀牛則逐漸康復和變得快樂.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The two oldest rhinos are set to be released back into the wild. Three rhinos cause a stir as they go missing, while the younger rhinos make steady progress toward health and happiness.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 偷獵危機加劇,偷獵者將注意力轉向孤兒們.四周大的牙美拿失去母親後終於在犀牛孤兒院找到庇護.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The poaching crisis intensifies and poachers turn their attention to orphanages. After losing her mother, four-week-old Jamila finally finds sanctuary at The Rhino Orphanage.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 領略納米比亞千公裡的狂野海岸!乾旱沙漠中生命頑強綻放,本片捕捉了萬物在極端環境下生存的壯麗奇景.一同見證超越極限的生命之美!
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Experience Namibia’s wild 1,000km coast! Where arid deserts meet stubborn life, this film captures a grandiose, fragile spectacle of nature thriving against all odds. Witness the impossible beauty!

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 從落基山脈到太平洋,英屬哥倫比亞是生物多樣性的瑰寶!在遼闊大地追隨灰熊的霸氣身影.這是一片莊嚴且神聖,亟需我們守護的原始荒野!
epg.episode_synopsis_en: From the Rockies to the Pacific, British Columbia is a jewel of biodiversity! Roam vast landscapes where the mighty grizzly bear reigns supreme. It’s a majestic, wild world waiting to be preserved!

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 生命自會找到出路!隨風漂流而來的物種,讓加勒比海成為全球生物多樣性熱點.深入探索這些迷人而脆弱的翡翠生態系,感受海島生機.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Life finds a way! Blown by winds and washed ashore, the Caribbean is now a mesmerizing hotspot of global biodiversity. Explore these fragile, emerald ecosystems and their incredible island resilience.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 領略納米比亞千公裡的狂野海岸!乾旱沙漠中生命頑強綻放,本片捕捉了萬物在極端環境下生存的壯麗奇景.一同見證超越極限的生命之美!
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Experience Namibia’s wild 1,000km coast! Where arid deserts meet stubborn life, this film captures a grandiose, fragile spectacle of nature thriving against all odds. Witness the impossible beauty!

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 從落基山脈到太平洋,英屬哥倫比亞是生物多樣性的瑰寶!在遼闊大地追隨灰熊的霸氣身影.這是一片莊嚴且神聖,亟需我們守護的原始荒野!
epg.episode_synopsis_en: From the Rockies to the Pacific, British Columbia is a jewel of biodiversity! Roam vast landscapes where the mighty grizzly bear reigns supreme. It’s a majestic, wild world waiting to be preserved!

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 我們在本集見證大自然最非凡的動物遷徙,並發現牠們為了生存而必須出走多遠.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In this episode we witness nature’s most extraordinary animal migrations, and discover the lengths they must go to, in order to survive.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 動物嬰兒:為了嬰兒免受極端情況,飢餓掠食者和飢餓威脅,所有動物都必須為其物種的未來而戰.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Baby Animals: Protecting babies against extreme conditions, hungry predators, and the threat of starvation, all animals must fight for the future of their species.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 求偶是最強大的本能之一.從美麗的到奇怪的,本集探索動物王國裡最驚奇的交配儀式.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The instinct to secure a mate is one of the most powerful that there is. From the beautiful to the bizarre, this episode explores the most amazing mating rituals from right across the animal kingdom.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 阿弗林深入加拿大魁北克的濃厚起司傳統,當地家族乳酪坊的技藝世代相傳,延續至今.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Afrim takes in the cheesy traditions of la belle province, Quebec, where family fromageries』 traditions have been passed on through generations.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 阿弗林在自己的家鄉多倫多展開一場迷你環球起司之旅,這座城市是世界上最多元且充滿文化魅力的地方之一.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Afrim takes a mini cheese trip around the world in his own backyard, Toronto, one of the most diverse and cultural cities on the planet.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 阿弗林的起司尋味之旅來到希臘--菲達起司的發源地,起司文化可追溯至數千年前的古老傳統.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Afrim’s cheese quest continues in Greece, the motherland of Feta, and where cheese culture dates back thousands of years in ancient practices.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 摩根費裡曼是好萊塢最知名的演員之一,以其有力的聲線和溫文的舉止見稱.儘管他的特質廣為人知,但真實的他卻不是眾所周知.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Morgan Freeman is one of the most recognisable actors in Hollywood with his powerful voice and calming demeanour. Despite his recognisable traits, Morgan wasnt always well known...

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 威廉斯姐妹.從沒有一個姓氏能與網球運動同義.與傷病,爭議和一躍成名的壓力鬥爭,很少運動員能說她們能取得威廉斯一樣的成就.從白紙般的青少年到經驗豐富的老兵,無人能預測出姐妹倆的職業生涯,或者她們又能嗎?
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The Williams Sisters. Never before has a surname rang so synonymously with the sport of tennis. From inexperienced teenagers to seasoned vets nobody could have predicted the sisters』 careers, or could they?

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 專訪瑪丹娜第一任經理人卡繆巴龐,舞者卡爾頓威爾邦,艾薇塔工作室執行官羅倫萊等人.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Features interviews with Madonna’s first manager Camille Barbone, dancer Carlton Wilborn, Evita studio executive Lauren Lloyd, plus many more.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 來認識這些異常的微型動物,牠們利用嬌小的身軀在世上最致命的環境中克險求生.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Meet the extraordinary miniature animals, who use their small size to survive against all odds in the world’s most deadly environments.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 體型異常龐大的動物就需要異常的適應力.從巨大的鯨魚到森林怪物,這些就是自然巨人的史詩式生存故事.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Extraordinarily large animals need extraordinary adaptations. From mighty whales to forest monsters, these are the epic survival stories of nature’s giants.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 日入而作可帶來極端的挑戰,同時亦帶來巨大的機會.在這沒有光的世界,危險在每個角落蟄伏.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Living your life at night can present extreme challenges - and massive opportunities. In this world without light, danger lurks around every corner.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 當冬季來臨,氣溫驟降,食物亦變得稀缺.但有些動物已經進化出獨特的適應力,能夠在世上最冷,最貧瘠的環境中繁衍.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: When winter arrives, temperatures plummet and food becomes scarce. But some animals have evolved unique adaptations to flourish in the world’s most cold and barren landscapes.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 這些動物生活在極端環境中,卻創造出巧妙的工具和技術來為生存應對最嚴峻的挑戰.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: These animals live in the extremes but have created ingenious tools and techniques to cope with the harshest challenges to their continued survival.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 從出生起就充滿了風險和回報.動物為了成年必須不斷克服難以置信的障礙.牠們必須學習覓食,保護家園,吸引配偶,養兒育女,心心念念一件事──生存下去.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: From birth life is filled with risk - and reward. To reach adulthood, animals must constantly overcome incredible obstacles. They must learn to find food, secure a home, attract a mate, and raise the next generation with only one thing on their mind

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 這塊巨大的磁石將徹底改變世界和產能的未來.法國南部正建造目前世上最大的核融合反應堆.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: This giant magnet will revolutionize the world and energy production in the future. The worlds largest nuclear fusion reactor is currently under construction in southern France.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 隨著電子遊戲崛起,科技巨頭索尼嘗試與任天堂合作.但在一次驚人的背叛後,索尼創立了後來成為世上最成功的遊戲主機.Playstation從此屹立不倒.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: With video-games on the rise, Sony, the tech superpower would attempt a collaboration with Nintendo. After a shocking betrayal, Sony founded what would become the world’s most successful chain of video game consoles. The Playstation was here to stay.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 本集探索世上最毒的動物,揭示毒物和毒液如何讓牠們在生存鬥爭中獲得競爭優勢.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: This episode explores the world’s most toxic animals, revealing how poison and venom have given them the edge over the competition in their fight for survival.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 本集探索大自然中最頑強的動物如何適應地球上一些最惡劣環境中的極端條件.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: This episode explores how nature’s toughest animals have adapted to the extreme conditions in some of the planet’s most inhospitable environments.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 阿弗林的起司尋味之旅來到希臘--菲達起司的發源地,起司文化可追溯至數千年前的古老傳統.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Afrim’s cheese quest continues in Greece, the motherland of Feta, and where cheese culture dates back thousands of years in ancient practices.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 阿弗林的最後一站是風景如畫的加拿大卑詩省西岸,當地創新的起司文化由支持在地的精神所驅動.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Afrim’s final stop is beautiful British Columbia, Canada’s West coast, where an innovative cheese culture is driven by its 『support local』 mentality.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 廖崇明來到母親的家鄉北京,在中國這個古老國家開展烹飪,歷史和個人之旅.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Adam Liaw arrives in his mums home town of Beijing to begin a culinary, historical and personal journey through the ancient country of China.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 崇明參觀了山巒起伏的美麗省份- 安徽,這是中國八大菜系之一的故鄉.徽菜是誠懇的農家菜,採用時令山野食材烹調而成.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Adam visits the beautiful, mountainous province of Anhui, home to one of the eight great regional cuisines of China. Anhui cuisine is hearty, peasant food that uses seasonal, wild produce from the mountains.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 專訪瑪丹娜第一任經理人卡繆巴龐,舞者卡爾頓威爾邦,艾薇塔工作室執行官羅倫萊等人.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Features interviews with Madonna’s first manager Camille Barbone, dancer Carlton Wilborn, Evita studio executive Lauren Lloyd, plus many more.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 專訪與羅賓威廉斯在《暴雨驕陽》聯合主演的基爾漢臣,《外星驕客》編劇大衛米施,好友兼喜劇演員域克奧華頓等人.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Features interviews with Robin Williams』 Dead Poets Society co-star Gale Hansen, Mork  Mindy writer David Misch, friend and comedian Rick Overton, plus many more.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 李奧納多·狄卡皮歐與湯姆·哈迪主演阿利安卓·崗札雷·伊納利圖執導的這部史詩級震撼巨作.故事根據真實事件改編,背景設定在美國未開墾的荒野,講述一段關於生存與背叛的故事.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Leonardo DiCaprio and Tom Hardy star in Alejandro González Iñárritus visceral, epic tale of survival and betrayal inspired by true events thats set in Americas uncharted wilderness.

epg.programme_title_tc: 李奧納多狄卡皮歐:崛起之路
epg.programme_title_en: Leonardo DiCaprio: Road To The Revenant
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 《李奧納多狄卡皮歐:崛起之路》紀錄了他從崛起新星到影壇傳奇的歷程.在突破性角色,與史柯西斯的合作以及對環保倡議的推動下,他對卓越藝術的執著追求最終讓他榮獲奧斯卡影帝殊榮.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Leonardo DiCaprio: The Road to The Revenant traces his rise from breakout star to cinema icon. Driven by bold roles, Scorsese collaborations, and eco-advocacy, his relentless pursuit of artistic excellence culminates in an epic Oscar win.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 穆罕默德阿里是有史以來最偉大的拳擊手,至今仍是全球標誌.他的名字依舊令人尊敬.聽聽那些認識他的人,重溫他的傳奇戰鬥,並探索拳擊界最偉大象徵的一生.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Muhammad Ali, the greatest fighter ever, remains a global icon. His name still commands respect. Hear from those who knew him, relive his legendary fights, and explore the life of boxing’s greatest symbol.

epg.programme_title_tc: 凱特溫斯蕾:天生女主角
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 因《鐵達尼號》而聞名的奧斯卡得主琦溫斯莉因在好萊塢猛片和獨立電影中多變而激烈的演技而受讚譽,使她穩佔同代最優秀演員一席位.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Oscar-winner Kate Winslet, known for Titanic, is celebrated for her versatile, intense performances in both Hollywood blockbusters and indie films, cementing her as one of the finest actors of her generation.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 《史汀:自強不息》是一部引人入勝的紀錄片,深入探索這位音樂史上最具代表性人物之一的多面人生.影片以前所未有的視角,帶領觀眾走進一位音樂傳奇的內心世界,展現他的藝術如何持續啟發並挑戰世界.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: Features interviews with Jim Carrey’s The Mask director Chuck Russell, The Duck Factory co-star Teresa Ganzel, Man On The Moon executive producer Michael Hausman, plus many more.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 專訪雪兒《施活的遭遇》導演米高候斯曼,神尼及雪兒經理哈維克斯基,影評人柯克懇尼咳等.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Features interviews with Cher’s Silkwood producer Michael Hausman, Sonny  Cher manager Harvey Kresky, film critic Kirk Honeycutt, plus many more.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 從山度士街頭到成為巴西隊頭號射手,內馬爾20年的歷程值得載入史冊.內馬爾幾乎在每個大洲都踢過足球,他將永遠成為球壇的傳說.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: From the streets of Santos to becoming Brazils number one goal scorer, the 20-year journey of Neymar is one for the history books. Having played football on nearly every continent, Neymar will go down as a legend of the game, forever.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 傑拉德在長達20多年的輝煌職業生涯中體驗並成功晉身球壇巔峰,作為球員和教練捧起過獎盃,又代表過國家隊.但有高山就會伴隨低谷.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In an illustrious professional career that spans over 20 years, Gerrard has experienced and succeeded at the pinnacle of the sport, lifting trophies as a player and manager, and representing his country. But with the highs, came the lows.

epg.programme_title_tc: 大衛艾登堡:地球上的一段生命旅程
epg.programme_title_en: David Attenborough: A Life On Earth
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 大衛艾登堡爵士是一位傳奇的傳播者和教育家,在過去六十多年裡遊歷全球,用他那引人入勝的說故事技巧啟發數百萬人,並將自然世界帶入我們家中.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Sir David Attenborough, a legendary communicator and educator, has traveled the world for over six decades, inspiring millions with his captivating storytelling and bringing the natural world into our homes.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 穆罕默德阿里是有史以來最偉大的拳擊手,至今仍是全球標誌.他的名字依舊令人尊敬.聽聽那些認識他的人,重溫他的傳奇戰鬥,並探索拳擊界最偉大象徵的一生.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Muhammad Ali, the greatest fighter ever, remains a global icon. His name still commands respect. Hear from those who knew him, relive his legendary fights, and explore the life of boxing’s greatest symbol.

epg.programme_title_tc: 凱特溫斯蕾:天生女主角
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 因《鐵達尼號》而聞名的奧斯卡得主琦溫斯莉因在好萊塢猛片和獨立電影中多變而激烈的演技而受讚譽,使她穩佔同代最優秀演員一席位.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Oscar-winner Kate Winslet, known for Titanic, is celebrated for her versatile, intense performances in both Hollywood blockbusters and indie films, cementing her as one of the finest actors of her generation.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 《史汀:自強不息》是一部引人入勝的紀錄片,深入探索這位音樂史上最具代表性人物之一的多面人生.影片以前所未有的視角,帶領觀眾走進一位音樂傳奇的內心世界,展現他的藝術如何持續啟發並挑戰世界.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 領略納米比亞千公裡的狂野海岸!乾旱沙漠中生命頑強綻放,本片捕捉了萬物在極端環境下生存的壯麗奇景.一同見證超越極限的生命之美!
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Experience Namibia’s wild 1,000km coast! Where arid deserts meet stubborn life, this film captures a grandiose, fragile spectacle of nature thriving against all odds. Witness the impossible beauty!

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 從落基山脈到太平洋,英屬哥倫比亞是生物多樣性的瑰寶!在遼闊大地追隨灰熊的霸氣身影.這是一片莊嚴且神聖,亟需我們守護的原始荒野!
epg.episode_synopsis_en: From the Rockies to the Pacific, British Columbia is a jewel of biodiversity! Roam vast landscapes where the mighty grizzly bear reigns supreme. It’s a majestic, wild world waiting to be preserved!

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 生命自會找到出路!隨風漂流而來的物種,讓加勒比海成為全球生物多樣性熱點.深入探索這些迷人而脆弱的翡翠生態系,感受海島生機.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Life finds a way! Blown by winds and washed ashore, the Caribbean is now a mesmerizing hotspot of global biodiversity. Explore these fragile, emerald ecosystems and their incredible island resilience.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 廖崇明來到母親的家鄉北京,在中國這個古老國家開展烹飪,歷史和個人之旅.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Adam Liaw arrives in his mums home town of Beijing to begin a culinary, historical and personal journey through the ancient country of China.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 崇明參觀了山巒起伏的美麗省份- 安徽,這是中國八大菜系之一的故鄉.徽菜是誠懇的農家菜,採用時令山野食材烹調而成.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Adam visits the beautiful, mountainous province of Anhui, home to one of the eight great regional cuisines of China. Anhui cuisine is hearty, peasant food that uses seasonal, wild produce from the mountains.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 崇明繼續透過美食探索中國歷史的旅程,他到訪江蘇省和浙江省,它們也位列中國八大菜系之中,並以其豐盛和精緻而聞名.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Adams journey to explore Chinas history through its food continues, as he visits the provinces of Jiangsu and Zhejiang, both considered part of the 8 great regional cuisines of China and celebrated for their wealth and sophistication.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 廖崇明抵訪世上最大的城市之一上海,他在當地發現一個現代化,國際化,全球化的城市.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Adam Liaw arrives in one of the largest cities in the world Shanghai where he discovers a modern, cosmopolitan and global facing city.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 崇明在透過美食探索中國歷史的旅程中,來到山東-孔子的故鄉,也是中國最古老和最有影響力的烹飪傳統源地之一.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: On his journey discovering Chinas history through its food, Adam arrives in Shandong - birthplace of Confucius and one of the oldest and most influential culinary traditions in China.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 廖崇明抵達中國最迷人的省份之一-雲南. 充滿了來自東南亞和中亞的香料和芬芳,各地的中國人都愛上這裡的美食和文化.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Adam Liaw arrives in one of the most fascinating Chinese provinces - Yunnan. Infused with spice and fragrance from Southeast and Central Asia, people from all around China have fallen in love with this cuisine and culture.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 《恐龍效應》是一部關於現今加拿大古生物學復興的紀錄片,恐龍能怎樣教導我們有關氣候變化的知識.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The Dinosaur Echo is a documentary about the renaissance of paleontology in Canada today and what dinosaurs can teach us about climate change.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 隨著電子遊戲崛起,科技巨頭索尼嘗試與任天堂合作.但在一次驚人的背叛後,索尼創立了後來成為世上最成功的遊戲主機.Playstation從此屹立不倒.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: With video-games on the rise, Sony, the tech superpower would attempt a collaboration with Nintendo. After a shocking betrayal, Sony founded what would become the world’s most successful chain of video game consoles. The Playstation was here to stay.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 一種由鋼和鈦製成的獨特巨型運輸工具,有著一個特殊用途:提煉數噸黃金.這款所謂的滅菌釜是同類之最.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A unique mega transport made of steel and titanium with a special purpose: to extract tons of gold. This so-called autoclave is the biggest of its kind.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在貝裡斯,詹姆斯與奧利弗·菲力普斯與阿爾菲·伊諾奇相聚.他們探索拉馬奈的瑪雅遺址,走訪水洞,了解門諾會文化,巡禮聖佩德羅的街頭美食,飛越藍洞,並在霍爾香珊瑚礁潛水.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: James and Oliver Phelps join Alfie Enoch in Belize. They explore Mayan ruins at Lamanai, visit water caves, learn about Mennonite culture, tour San Pedros street food, fly over the Blue Hole, and dive in the Hol Chan coral reefs.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在新加坡,馬克·威廉士加入菲力普斯雙胞胎的行列,他們騎著側邊車穿越唐人街,體驗舞獅,並搭乘渡輪前往烏敏島劃劃皮艇穿梭紅樹林.在這趟刺激的旅程中,他們還深入探索了娘惹文化,歷史文物與在地美食.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Joined by Mark Williams in Singapore, the Phelps twins ride sidecars through Chinatown, try Lion Dancing, and ferry to Pulau Ubin to kayak the mangroves. They also explore Peranakan culture, artifacts, and local cuisine on this thrilling trip.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 與嘉賓柯瑞·米克利斯特一起,詹姆斯和奧利弗造訪了墨爾本.他們遊覽雅拉河,觀賞菲利普島的小企鵝,駕駛卡丁車,乘坐普芬比利蒸汽火車,在貝爾斯海灘體驗衝浪課程,還在一架二戰老式飛機上上演空中特技.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: With guest Corey Mylchreest, James and Oliver explore Melbourne. They cruise the Yarra River, see Phillip Islands penguins, race go-karts, ride Puffing Billy, take a surf lesson at Bell’s Beach, and perform stunts in a WWII plane.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在伊斯坦堡,詹姆斯和奧利弗於加拉達塔與娜塔莉·提娜會合.他們橫渡博斯普魯斯海峽,乘坐東方快車列車穿過雪山體驗雪地摩託車,並在市場品嚐土耳其美食,果油餅(Baklava)與異國香料.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In Istanbul, James and Oliver meet Natalie Tena at Galata Tower. They cross the Bosphorus, ride the Eastern Express train through snowy mountains for ski-dooing, and sample Turkish cuisine, baklava, and exotic spices at the market.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 雙胞胎兄弟在坦帕的伊博爾城遇見了阿爾菲·艾倫.他們在最古老的古巴餐廳用餐,與坦帕灣閃電隊打冰球,打棒球,享用在地海鮮與啤酒,並探訪這座城市最著名的鬧鬼飯店.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The Phelps twins meet Alfie Allen in Tampa’s Ybor City. They eat at the oldest Cuban restaurant, play ice hockey with the Tampa Bay Lightning, play baseball, enjoy local seafood and brews, and visit the citys most haunted hotels.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在智利聖地牙哥與熱妮西斯·羅德裡格茲會面後,詹姆斯和奧利弗參觀了青金石工作坊,體驗馬戲團,並學習了庫埃卡舞(Cueca).他們還遊覽了壯麗的葡萄園,品嚐頂級葡萄酒,並親手製作傳統恩潘納達餅(Empanadas).
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Joined by Genesis Rodriguez in Santiago, Chile, James and Oliver visit a Lapis Lazuli workshop, experience a circus, and learn the Cueca dance. They also tour stunning vineyards, sample fine wines, and cook traditional empanadas.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 專訪妮可基嫚的演技教練蘇珊伯臣,《不惜一切》監製莊拿汾塔別林,聲學導師瑪莉錫查乾等人.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Features interviews with Nicole Kidman’s acting coach Susan Batson, To Die For executive producer Jonathan Taplin, voice teacher Mary Setrakian, plus many more.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 專訪阿諾史瓦辛格《 蒸發密令》導演漆黑羅素,《霸王神劍》共同主演莎拉道格拉斯 ,《大力神在紐約》導演阿瑟艾倫賽道曼等人.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Features interviews with Arnold Schwarzenegger’s Eraser director Chuck Russell, Conan The Destroyer co-star Sarah Douglas, Hercules In New York director Arthur Allan Seidelman, plus many more.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 訪問茱莉亞蘿勃茲所演的《風月俏佳人》服裝設計師瑪莉蓮凡斯,《傲氣蓋天》製作人史蒂芬胡利,《好萊塢報道》的史葛芬伯格等人.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Features interviews with Julia Roberts』 Pretty Woman costume designer Marilyn Vance, Michael Collins producer Stephen Woolley, The Hollywood Reporter’s Scott Feinberg, plus many more.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 廖崇明在日本發現了一連串樂趣.在寒冷的北海道北島上,他品嚐了海膽,池沼公魚和精緻的芝士蛋糕.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Adam Liaw discovers a host of delights in Japan. On the wintry northern island of Hokkaido, he samples sea urchin, pond smelt and boutique cheesecake.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 當冬季來臨,氣溫驟降,食物亦變得稀缺.但有些動物已經進化出獨特的適應力,能夠在世上最冷,最貧瘠的環境中繁衍.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: When winter arrives, temperatures plummet and food becomes scarce. But some animals have evolved unique adaptations to flourish in the world’s most cold and barren landscapes.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 這些動物生活在極端環境中,卻創造出巧妙的工具和技術來為生存應對最嚴峻的挑戰.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: These animals live in the extremes but have created ingenious tools and techniques to cope with the harshest challenges to their continued survival.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 從出生起就充滿了風險和回報.動物為了成年必須不斷克服難以置信的障礙.牠們必須學習覓食,保護家園,吸引配偶,養兒育女,心心念念一件事──生存下去.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: From birth life is filled with risk - and reward. To reach adulthood, animals must constantly overcome incredible obstacles. They must learn to find food, secure a home, attract a mate, and raise the next generation with only one thing on their mind

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 崇明在透過美食探索中國歷史的旅程中,來到山東-孔子的故鄉,也是中國最古老和最有影響力的烹飪傳統源地之一.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: On his journey discovering Chinas history through its food, Adam arrives in Shandong - birthplace of Confucius and one of the oldest and most influential culinary traditions in China.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 廖崇明抵達中國最迷人的省份之一-雲南. 充滿了來自東南亞和中亞的香料和芬芳,各地的中國人都愛上這裡的美食和文化.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Adam Liaw arrives in one of the most fascinating Chinese provinces - Yunnan. Infused with spice and fragrance from Southeast and Central Asia, people from all around China have fallen in love with this cuisine and culture.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 廖崇明抵達炎熱的四川省和湖南省,而這次著名廚師兼作家,同時也是當地的專家導遊鄧扶霞也一併同行.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Adam Liaw arrives to the fiery provinces of Sichuan and Hunan and this time hes joined by celebrated chef and author Fuchsia Dunlop who is an expert on the region.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 廖崇明身在福建,當地是一個有著悠久移民歷史的地方,他們遷移所留下的持久痕跡,體現在其飲食和文化上.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Adam Liaw is in Fujian - a place with a long history of migration where the movement of people left an enduring mark that manifested in its food and culture.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 廖崇明前往粵菜之鄉-香港和廣東,探索傳到世界各地的地區美食.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Adam Liaw heads to the home of Cantonese cuisine - Hong Kong and Guangdong to discover the regional cuisine that spread to all corners of the world.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 廖崇明的最後一站是非常特別的海南島-一個氣候宜人的熱帶島嶼,也是崇明祖先的家鄉.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Adam Liaws last stop is the very special Hainan Island - a balmy, tropical island and Adams ancestral home.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 一種由鋼和鈦製成的獨特巨型運輸工具,有著一個特殊用途:提煉數噸黃金.這款所謂的滅菌釜是同類之最.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A unique mega transport made of steel and titanium with a special purpose: to extract tons of gold. This so-called autoclave is the biggest of its kind.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 這塊巨大的磁石將徹底改變世界和產能的未來.法國南部正建造目前世上最大的核融合反應堆.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: This giant magnet will revolutionize the world and energy production in the future. The worlds largest nuclear fusion reactor is currently under construction in southern France.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 隨著電子遊戲崛起,科技巨頭索尼嘗試與任天堂合作.但在一次驚人的背叛後,索尼創立了後來成為世上最成功的遊戲主機.Playstation從此屹立不倒.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: With video-games on the rise, Sony, the tech superpower would attempt a collaboration with Nintendo. After a shocking betrayal, Sony founded what would become the world’s most successful chain of video game consoles. The Playstation was here to stay.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 《生存邊緣》檢視全球生物圈所面臨的存亡威脅,以及對地球和奧特亞羅瓦(紐西蘭)的未來代表著甚麼.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Edge of Existence examines existential threats to the worlds biosphere and what it means for the future of the planet, and Aotearoa.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 《生存邊緣》探索人類有史以來面臨的最大存亡風險之一的未來- 一個生化威脅.從病毒到人造流行病和合成生化武器,科技正加速人造威脅的風險.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Edge of Existence explores a future where bio-threats present one of the greatest existential risks that humanity has ever faced. From viruses to man-made pandemics and synthetic bio-weapons, technology is accelerating the risks of man-made threats.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 《生存邊緣》探索一個近未來,人工智慧統治著地球和我們.人工智慧將伴隨我們一生,並帶來人類史上所面臨的最大存亡風險.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Edge of Existence explores a near-future where artificial intelligence rules the planet, and us. AI will arrive in our life-times bringing with it the biggest existential risk humanity has ever faced.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 李奧納多·狄卡皮歐與湯姆·哈迪主演阿利安卓·崗札雷·伊納利圖執導的這部史詩級震撼巨作.故事根據真實事件改編,背景設定在美國未開墾的荒野,講述一段關於生存與背叛的故事.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Leonardo DiCaprio and Tom Hardy star in Alejandro González Iñárritus visceral, epic tale of survival and betrayal inspired by true events thats set in Americas uncharted wilderness.

epg.programme_title_tc: 李奧納多狄卡皮歐:崛起之路
epg.programme_title_en: Leonardo DiCaprio: Road To The Revenant
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 《李奧納多狄卡皮歐:崛起之路》紀錄了他從崛起新星到影壇傳奇的歷程.在突破性角色,與史柯西斯的合作以及對環保倡議的推動下,他對卓越藝術的執著追求最終讓他榮獲奧斯卡影帝殊榮.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Leonardo DiCaprio: The Road to The Revenant traces his rise from breakout star to cinema icon. Driven by bold roles, Scorsese collaborations, and eco-advocacy, his relentless pursuit of artistic excellence culminates in an epic Oscar win.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 訪問惠妮休斯頓所演的《護花傾情》導演米克傑克遜,音樂家榮連西,《傳教士之妻》製作人艾略特雅培等人.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Features interviews with Whitney Houston’s The Bodyguard director Mick Jackson, musician Wayne Linsey, The Preacher’s Wife producer Elliot Abbott, plus many more.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 這部紀錄片系列展示五代噴射機.這些戰機能夠攜帶炸彈並飛近太空邊緣.第六代戰機從2020年開始服役,第11季至今已經覆蓋了大部分此後的空中兵器.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: This documentary series shows five generations of jet engines. These fighter jets are capable of carrying bombs and soar close to the edge of space. The sixth generation of fighter jets began in 2020, and the 11th season has covered most of the air a

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 這部紀錄片系列展示五代噴射機.這些戰機能夠攜帶炸彈並飛近太空邊緣.第六代戰機從2020年開始服役,第11季至今已經覆蓋了大部分此後的空中兵器.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 由牠們的齒與爪,到令人難以置信的隱身和狡猾,大自然最致命的掠食者進化出一系列令人震驚的狩獵技術.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: From their teeth, and claws, to incredible stealth and cunning, nature’s most lethal predators have evolved a staggering array of hunting techniques.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 我們在本集見證大自然最非凡的動物遷徙,並發現牠們為了生存而必須出走多遠.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In this episode we witness nature’s most extraordinary animal migrations, and discover the lengths they must go to, in order to survive.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 阿弗林在自己的家鄉多倫多展開一場迷你環球起司之旅,這座城市是世界上最多元且充滿文化魅力的地方之一.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Afrim takes a mini cheese trip around the world in his own backyard, Toronto, one of the most diverse and cultural cities on the planet.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 阿弗林的起司尋味之旅來到希臘--菲達起司的發源地,起司文化可追溯至數千年前的古老傳統.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Afrim’s cheese quest continues in Greece, the motherland of Feta, and where cheese culture dates back thousands of years in ancient practices.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 阿弗林的最後一站是風景如畫的加拿大卑詩省西岸,當地創新的起司文化由支持在地的精神所驅動.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Afrim’s final stop is beautiful British Columbia, Canada’s West coast, where an innovative cheese culture is driven by its 『support local』 mentality.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 廖崇明來到母親的家鄉北京,在中國這個古老國家開展烹飪,歷史和個人之旅.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Adam Liaw arrives in his mums home town of Beijing to begin a culinary, historical and personal journey through the ancient country of China.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 崇明參觀了山巒起伏的美麗省份- 安徽,這是中國八大菜系之一的故鄉.徽菜是誠懇的農家菜,採用時令山野食材烹調而成.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Adam visits the beautiful, mountainous province of Anhui, home to one of the eight great regional cuisines of China. Anhui cuisine is hearty, peasant food that uses seasonal, wild produce from the mountains.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在伊斯坦堡,詹姆斯和奧利弗於加拉達塔與娜塔莉·提娜會合.他們橫渡博斯普魯斯海峽,乘坐東方快車列車穿過雪山體驗雪地摩託車,並在市場品嚐土耳其美食,果油餅(Baklava)與異國香料.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In Istanbul, James and Oliver meet Natalie Tena at Galata Tower. They cross the Bosphorus, ride the Eastern Express train through snowy mountains for ski-dooing, and sample Turkish cuisine, baklava, and exotic spices at the market.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 雙胞胎兄弟在坦帕的伊博爾城遇見了阿爾菲·艾倫.他們在最古老的古巴餐廳用餐,與坦帕灣閃電隊打冰球,打棒球,享用在地海鮮與啤酒,並探訪這座城市最著名的鬧鬼飯店.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The Phelps twins meet Alfie Allen in Tampa’s Ybor City. They eat at the oldest Cuban restaurant, play ice hockey with the Tampa Bay Lightning, play baseball, enjoy local seafood and brews, and visit the citys most haunted hotels.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在智利聖地牙哥與熱妮西斯·羅德裡格茲會面後,詹姆斯和奧利弗參觀了青金石工作坊,體驗馬戲團,並學習了庫埃卡舞(Cueca).他們還遊覽了壯麗的葡萄園,品嚐頂級葡萄酒,並親手製作傳統恩潘納達餅(Empanadas).
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Joined by Genesis Rodriguez in Santiago, Chile, James and Oliver visit a Lapis Lazuli workshop, experience a circus, and learn the Cueca dance. They also tour stunning vineyards, sample fine wines, and cook traditional empanadas.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 崇明繼續透過美食探索中國歷史的旅程,他到訪江蘇省和浙江省,它們也位列中國八大菜系之中,並以其豐盛和精緻而聞名.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Adams journey to explore Chinas history through its food continues, as he visits the provinces of Jiangsu and Zhejiang, both considered part of the 8 great regional cuisines of China and celebrated for their wealth and sophistication.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 廖崇明抵訪世上最大的城市之一上海,他在當地發現一個現代化,國際化,全球化的城市.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Adam Liaw arrives in one of the largest cities in the world Shanghai where he discovers a modern, cosmopolitan and global facing city.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 崇明在透過美食探索中國歷史的旅程中,來到山東-孔子的故鄉,也是中國最古老和最有影響力的烹飪傳統源地之一.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 領略納米比亞千公裡的狂野海岸!乾旱沙漠中生命頑強綻放,本片捕捉了萬物在極端環境下生存的壯麗奇景.一同見證超越極限的生命之美!
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Experience Namibia’s wild 1,000km coast! Where arid deserts meet stubborn life, this film captures a grandiose, fragile spectacle of nature thriving against all odds. Witness the impossible beauty!

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 從落基山脈到太平洋,英屬哥倫比亞是生物多樣性的瑰寶!在遼闊大地追隨灰熊的霸氣身影.這是一片莊嚴且神聖,亟需我們守護的原始荒野!
epg.episode_synopsis_en: From the Rockies to the Pacific, British Columbia is a jewel of biodiversity! Roam vast landscapes where the mighty grizzly bear reigns supreme. It’s a majestic, wild world waiting to be preserved!

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 生命自會找到出路!隨風漂流而來的物種,讓加勒比海成為全球生物多樣性熱點.深入探索這些迷人而脆弱的翡翠生態系,感受海島生機.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Life finds a way! Blown by winds and washed ashore, the Caribbean is now a mesmerizing hotspot of global biodiversity. Explore these fragile, emerald ecosystems and their incredible island resilience.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 動物嬰兒:為了嬰兒免受極端情況,飢餓掠食者和飢餓威脅,所有動物都必須為其物種的未來而戰.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Baby Animals: Protecting babies against extreme conditions, hungry predators, and the threat of starvation, all animals must fight for the future of their species.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 求偶是最強大的本能之一.從美麗的到奇怪的,本集探索動物王國裡最驚奇的交配儀式.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: Dr. Matt gets to play nanny to a very tiny but very vocal abandoned baby badger, and meets Vicky, the lovesick cockatoo who's fallen in love with her owner, in the seventh of the series.  Up at the zoo Matt fills in the cracks in a tortoise's shell and then meets the latest additions to the aquarium 20 baby seahorses, much to the delight of keeper Jackie. epg.episode_synopsis_tc: Because of her love for cats, Claire carefully created a place called "There is a Cat at the Corner". While enjoying your meals and drinks, more than a dozen beautiful cats are strolling freely in the store, waiting to interact with you up close and enjoy a slow life with you. Claire also generously shares her “experiences in ruling over dozens of cats”, which is extremely precious. Novice cat lovers should come and have a look!

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: Genus Pterophyllum, commonly known as P. scalare, freshwater angelfish or just angelfish is a large tropical fish native to the Amazon River in South America.They have a laterally flattened body, making them suitableto live in the crevices of tree roots in rivers with smooth water flow, and feeds on aquatic insects. The water temperature should be maintained at 26℃, and should reach 27-28℃ when breeding. The fertilized eggs are then released and attached to water plants or rocks, and the couple will take care of them together. However, once the eggs are hatched, the bigger ones will eat the smaller ones, hence not suitable to be raised together with other small fishes.

Tragically, for one puppy it was already too late, but she manages to rescue another 37 including 8 expectant mothers. Herchy discovers a range of breeds including Shih-Tzu’s, West Highland Terriers and Cavashons, but with many pups still yet to be born, how will they all get on?

epg.episode_synopsis_tc:
Six dogs, six handlers, all competing in the world’s largest and most famous dog show: "Crufts".

But they are not the pedigree pooches who compete to be labelled "Best in Show". These are the loveable family pets competing to win the "Scruffts" title.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: Genus Pterophyllum, commonly known as P. scalare, freshwater angelfish or just angelfish is a large tropical fish native to the Amazon River in South America.They have a laterally flattened body, making them suitableto live in the crevices of tree roots in rivers with smooth water flow, and feeds on aquatic insects. The water temperature should be maintained at 26℃, and should reach 27-28℃ when breeding. The fertilized eggs are then released and attached to water plants or rocks, and the couple will take care of them together. However, once the eggs are hatched, the bigger ones will eat the smaller ones, hence not suitable to be raised together with other small fishes.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: Discover China is a documentary series shot in conjunction with the Chinese Ministry of Culture and China Central Television, including footage of never before seen locations and recreations of historical events. It was shot by BBC film crews over a four year period. At the foot of Tai Mountain sits an enigma, a temple that bears a striking resemblance to an Imperial palace. epg.episode_synopsis_tc: Born in different countries yet resembling each other so much, two women walked the path of life that was surprisingly similar. A baby girl was born in a small rural village of Jura in France. Her name is Colette. Another baby was born on the outskirt of Seoul, Korea. She is Sung-mi. Colette and Sung-mi wanted to live normal lives like any other women, but they couldn't because of visions and voices from deities which they have experienced since they were very young. They thought this was their divine punishments. After meeting each other at the 2014 International Shamanism Festival in France, Colette and Sung-mi realized that their special abilities could be something meaningful: they are gifts given from God to comfort and soothe the pain of other people. Finally, Colette and Sung-mi accepted their fates as shamans and began their spiritual journey.

From the Saudi who loves singing and fried chicken to the 26-year-­old British convert who is worried about his new wife, this remarkable film embeds with an unlikely bunch of ‘martyrdom seekers’. As each waits for their turn to go on a final mission, known by jihadists as ‘Dugma’, this film lays bare the faith and doubt at the core of men who give their life for their cause.
Winner, Golden Nymph Award for Best Documentary - Festival du Television Monte Carlo 2017

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: Born in different countries yet resembling each other so much, two women walked the path of life that was surprisingly similar. A baby girl was born in a small rural village of Jura in France. Her name is Colette. Another baby was born on the outskirt of Seoul, Korea. She is Sung-mi. Colette and Sung-mi wanted to live normal lives like any other women, but they couldn't because of visions and voices from deities which they have experienced since they were very young. They thought this was their divine punishments. After meeting each other at the 2014 International Shamanism Festival in France, Colette and Sung-mi realized that their special abilities could be something meaningful: they are gifts given from God to comfort and soothe the pain of other people. Finally, Colette and Sung-mi accepted their fates as shamans and began their spiritual journey.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: It's a term that's come to the fore in recent years, as the urgency of the climate crisis becomes increasingly apparent. For the corporations responsible for a vast proportion of global emissions, just what lies behind the promises of climate action?

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: From no paid sick leave, to a reliance on tips in order to make a living, the COVID-19 pandemic has revealed the many fault lines in the American restaurant industry that affect both workers and consumers. As millions of restaurant workers were laid off in the face of the pandemic, Waging Change provides a behind the scenes look at what needs to change so that restaurant workers can receive a living wage once restaurants re-open. Featuring Saru Jayaraman, Lily Tomlin, Jane Fonda and Rep. Alexandria Ocasio Cortez, the film reveals two American workers’ struggles hidden in plain sight-- the effort to end the federal tipped minimum wage of $2.13 for restaurant servers and bartenders and the #MeToo movement's efforts to end sexual harassment.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: In 1953, Edmund Hillary and Tenzing Norgay were the first to summit Mount Everest. That same year, the jetboat was invented. With this new invention, Hillary strove to also become the first to tackle the Himalayas' greatest river: the Ganges. It was a perilous journey from ocean to sky, achieved while also battling grief, following the death of Hillary's wife and youngest daughter. A story of surmounting the insurmountable - both physically and mentally.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: Could the best kind of belief possibly be, no belief at all? Host Tevya decides to check out atheism. As the program begins he finds himself in a graveyard, where he is visited by an important insight ... "being dead sucks!" Later in the program, he meets the president of Canada's Freethought Association, which stirs up a little controversy with it's provocative ad slogan "There's probably no God. So stop worrying and enjoy life". Finally, he finds himself immersed in God.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: In Spring 2014, armed pro-Russian rebels stormed the city of Donetsk in eastern Ukraine. After seizing control of the city, the separatists held a referendum - labelled illegal by the US and EU - and independence from Kiev was declared. This brave documentary explores the origins and evolution of the Donetsk People's Republic, diving into hopeful beginnings and eventual descent into enduring conflict.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: ‘Fury Dance’ is a story about a Korean protest dancer, Sam-hun Lee. He fought for the democratization of South Korea in the ‘80’s through dance, while giving up his own dream to become a ballerino. The film takes the viewer through prominent events in South Korean history, as Sam-hun dances to soothe the souls of victims who were killed by the Korean national violence during the past 30 years. During the 1980 Gwangju Massacre however, Sam-hun developed a panic disorder. So he crosses through the Eurasian rail with difficulty when invited to attend a festival to dance in France. Through his journey, he attempts to overcome his claustrophobic fears in France, revisits his lost dream of becoming a ballerino in Russia, and dances for the Holocaust victims in Poland. Documented for 15 years, this film is dedicated to those who lost their noble lives while fighting for freedom against the unjust political power.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: In Spring 2014, armed pro-Russian rebels stormed the city of Donetsk in eastern Ukraine. After seizing control of the city, the separatists held a referendum - labelled illegal by the US and EU - and independence from Kiev was declared. This brave documentary explores the origins and evolution of the Donetsk People's Republic, diving into hopeful beginnings and eventual descent into enduring conflict.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: ‘Fury Dance’ is a story about a Korean protest dancer, Sam-hun Lee. He fought for the democratization of South Korea in the ‘80’s through dance, while giving up his own dream to become a ballerino. The film takes the viewer through prominent events in South Korean history, as Sam-hun dances to soothe the souls of victims who were killed by the Korean national violence during the past 30 years. During the 1980 Gwangju Massacre however, Sam-hun developed a panic disorder. So he crosses through the Eurasian rail with difficulty when invited to attend a festival to dance in France. Through his journey, he attempts to overcome his claustrophobic fears in France, revisits his lost dream of becoming a ballerino in Russia, and dances for the Holocaust victims in Poland. Documented for 15 years, this film is dedicated to those who lost their noble lives while fighting for freedom against the unjust political power.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: On a hot August evening in the Lebanese capital of Beirut, a catastrophic explosion ripped through the city. It looked like a scene from a disaster movie, but it was real. As the shocking event unfolded, people around the city captured the moment, and its aftermath, on their phones. These videos soon went viral. This documentary tells the stories of many of those who filmed the blast as well as survivors whose experiences in the moment were dramatically captured onscreen. From a bride posing for her wedding photos when the explosion erupted, to divers at sea struck by the blast wave, to the young doctor tending to a woman in labour as the windows exploded inwards, each has an extraordinary story of survival.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: The White Island Volcano eruption in December 2019 claimed the lives of 23 people. Despite extraordinary stories of heroism in the rescue effort, could more have been done to prevent this awful loss of life? Terrified members of a boat trip to the New Zealand island watched on as a tower of smoke plumed from the mouth of the Volcano. It was not until they reached land that they realised the true horror of the situation. “Their skin just dripped off them like wax”, recounts a trained first-aider. epg.episode_synopsis_tc: Discover China is a documentary series shot in conjunction with the Chinese Ministry of Culture and China Central Television, including footage of never before seen locations and recreations of historical events. It was shot by BBC film crews over a four year period. At the foot of Tai Mountain sits an enigma, a temple that bears a striking resemblance to an Imperial palace. It was built by a brazen emperor, who ignored his country's desparation, and built this lavish shrine to bolster his status as the sole ruler.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: Host Tevya goes deep into the woods to explore the spiritual ways of North America's first Aboriginal people- the people of the First Nations. While he has seen headdresses, Pow-Wows, sweat lodges and teepees on television, Tevya knows nothing about what First Nations people really believe or what their rituals are. After meeting two indigenous teenagers, Tevya experiences this religion firsthand.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: They are faceless. They are nameless. They are feared and hated. And they make no apologies. Antifa is notorious for their radical and often divisive tactics - but what’s it really like to be a member of this anti-fascist movement? In the weeks surrounding the 2021 Inauguration, a group of Antifa members allowed one filmmaker full and unprecedented access, as they worked to forge the type of society they want to live in

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: When Dian was six she narrowly escaped a tsunami of boiling mud that completely submerged 16 villages under a moonscape of grit, leaving 60,000 people displaced. Lapindo, an Indonesian drilling company, had unleashed a violent, unstoppable flow from the earth's depths, estimated to continue for another decade. Shot over six years, GRIT witnesses Dian's transformation in to a politically active teen, as she and her mother take on the perpetrators.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: Investigative journalist Anthony Baxter travels between the US Presidential race and the Scottish countryside to chronicle the troubling confrontation between Donald Trump and a feisty 92-year-old widow, Molly Forbes, as she refuses to make way for his golf course. This shocking insight to a David and goliath battle is a remarkable document of the disconnect between political rhetoric and the lives of ordinary people.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: The far-right political movement known as QAnon has taken off around the world, mobilising a committed band of believers dedicated to fighting what they claim is an ‘online war’ against corrupt, child abusing elites. In the United States, the Federal Bureau of Investigation (FBI) has declared QAnon a potential domestic terrorism threat. For one family, QAnon has caused division so severe that they had to report their relative - Tim Stewart, a QAnon conspiracy theorist - to Australia's national security hotline. In a concerning twist, it emerged that Stewart has had a longstanding friendship with Australian Prime Minister Scott Morrison - leading to speculation about QAnon and Australia's highest ranks of political power. A look at the alarming movement which has caused ripples through the world, through the eyes of one family.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc:
An intimate portrait of four very different suicide bombers working for Al Nusra in Syria. From the Saudi who loves singing and fried chicken to the 26-year-­old British convert who is worried about his new wife, this remarkable film embeds with an unlikely bunch of ‘martyrdom seekers’. As each waits for their turn to go on a final mission, known by jihadists as ‘Dugma’, this film lays bare the faith and doubt at the core of men who give their life for their cause.
Winner, Golden Nymph Award for Best Documentary - Festival du Television Monte Carlo 2017

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: Born in different countries yet resembling each other so much, two women walked the path of life that was surprisingly similar. A baby girl was born in a small rural village of Jura in France. Her name is Colette. Another baby was born on the outskirt of Seoul, Korea. She is Sung-mi. Colette and Sung-mi wanted to live normal lives like any other women, but they couldn't because of visions and voices from deities which they have experienced since they were very young. They thought this was their divine punishments. After meeting each other at the 2014 International Shamanism Festival in France, Colette and Sung-mi realized that their special abilities could be something meaningful: they are gifts given from God to comfort and soothe the pain of other people. Finally, Colette and Sung-mi accepted their fates as shamans and began their spiritual journey.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: Eddie snatches the most vulnerable player from their grasp. All but Jaz thinks he’s dead. It’s worse. A re-introduction to the monster in his past. Our heroes frantic search for him leads to other levels.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 渣士最終設法利用她進化的感知能力來找出他們失蹤的玩家.我們的團隊來到建築物的最底層,發現了至今為止最致命的威脅.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Jaz finally manages to utilise her evolving skills of perception to locate their missing player. Our team descends to the lowest levels of the building only to find their deadliest threat yet.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 渣士等人逃亡時,陷入了她自己的地獄感應,一切反映在建築物的邪惡之中.出口終於近在眼前,看來可能已經完成教程關卡,但遊戲遠未結束.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: As they run, Jaz slips into her own sense of hell which is mirrored in the vile contents of the building. With the exit finally in front of them, it seems the tutorial may be complete, but the game is far from over.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: Silver and his men hunt for Flint on Skeleton Island.  Madi is made an offer.  Rogers struggles to hear Eleanor.  Billy casts his lot.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: Flint makes one last push to topple England.  Silver seals his fate.  Rackham confronts Rogers.  Nassau is changed forever.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: In *Waterworld*, Kevin Costner stars as a lone maverick in a flooded future Earth, protecting a mother and daughter from a tribe of ruthless nomads. Dennis Hopper delivers a memorable villainous performance in this thrilling adventure.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 退休殺手法蘭克,人稱「沉默者」.想跟他的新女友和她女兒過上正常的生活,但黑手黨老大要他為年幼的女兒的死報仇,他身不由己地重出江湖.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Retired hitman, Frank, known as The Silencer wants to lead a normal life with his new girlfriend and her daughter but is unwillingly brought back into the game when a mafia mob boss wants him to avenge the death of his young daughter

epg.episode_synopsis_en: TC asks Magnum to take on a case to help acquit the father of one of his young football players who is accused of murder.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 年邁的商業巨頭亨利·布朗(本·維林飾)委託馬格南尋找他失散多年的愛人,他說她最近聯繫過他--唯一的問題是她已經去世30年了.同時,裡克和TC遇到了一位難以適應平民生活的退伍老兵.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: An aging tycoon, Henry Brown (Ben Vereen), asks Magnum to find his lost love who he says just recently contacted him - the only problem is she died 30 years ago. Also, Rick and TC meet a fellow vet who is having a hard time adjusting to civilian l...

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 麥林接手了一個小女孩丟失貓咪的案件,在此過程中,他偶然發現了另一隻貓被謀殺的主人,而這位主人恰好是一名聯邦調查局特工.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Magnum takes the case of a little girls missing cat and, in the process, stumbles upon another cats murdered owner who happens to be an FBI agent.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: During the Christmas season, Elliot and Mr. Robot make their return; Darlene deals with real trouble; Tyrell is bored; Dom becomes paranoid.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: Elliot and Darlene reconnect. Price gives Elliot some background info and plays his hand. Dom completes the interview, but her lack of confidence raises suspicion with Janice. Some unexpected threats become known to Elliot and Mr. Robot.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: Shibisu小隊前來與FUG成員Jue Viole Grace對峙.為了不讓昔日隊友發現自己是第25任Bam,Viole挺身而出,與Shibisu小隊展開激戰.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Team Shibisu arrives to confront FUG member Jue Viole Grace. In order to prevent his former teammates from discovering that he is the 25th Bam, Viole takes on Team Shibisu.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 獲得登船證的參賽者們在阿基米德號上稍作休息.坤在船上與拉克重逢.他們決心從FUG手中奪回維奧萊(巴姆),「旗幟」工坊之戰終於打響!
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The participants that acquired boarding passes enjoy a moments rest aboard the Archimedes. Khun is reunited with Rak on the floating ship. With their determination to take back Viole (Bam) from FUG, the Flag Workshop Battle finally begins!

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 塞斯拼命掙扎,試圖擺脫迪亞巴爾的控制.與此同時,格林在一場衝突中身負重傷.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Seth hangs on for dear life as he attempts to escape the Diabals grasp. Meanwhile, Grimm is badly wounded in an altercation.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 塞思僥倖逃出城堡,但身負重傷.梅莉察覺到賽斯有危險,便和醫生,奧科霍一起出發尋找他.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Seth narrowly escapes the castle, but is badly wounded. Melie senses that Seth is in trouble and heads out with Doc and Ocoho to search for him.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 奧科霍和梅莉因在上一場戰鬥中違抗命令而受到指責,但莫德雷德告訴女王這一切都是布朗戈爾領主的失誤,從而救了她們.同時,塞斯繼續訓練,以便學會控制自己的力量.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Ocoho and Melie are blamed for disobeying orders in the previous battle, but Mordred saves them by telling the queen that it was all Lord Brangoires mistake. Seth, meanwhile, continues training so that he can learn to control his power.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 黃石火山大爆發是一場不間斷的驚險之旅-故事講述兩個人齊心協力製止威脅人類其中一個最嚴重的自然災害.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Super Eruption is a non-stop thrill ride - the story of two people who come together to put a stop to one of the greatest natural disasters to ever threaten humanity.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 一名火爆的鰥夫與新鄰居建立起改變他生活的不可思議友誼.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A grumpy widower forms an unlikely friendship with his new neighbors that turns his world around.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在全世界見證蘇聯將首位女性送上月球之後,尼克森總統要求美國做出解釋.太空人辦公室主任迪克·斯雷頓的任務是組建並訓練一批女性太空人,以扳回一城.莫莉·科布,帕蒂·多伊爾,艾倫·韋弗利,丹妮爾·普爾和特蕾西·史蒂文斯(戈爾多·史蒂文斯的妻子)接受了嚴格的訓練,期間她們之間既有結盟,也有衝突.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: After the world watches as the Russians land the first woman on the moon, Nixon demands an answer. Deke Slayton, head of the Astronauts Office, is tasked with assembling and training a group of women to even the score. Molly Cobb, Patty Doyle, Ell...

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 克裡斯和女友羅斯在她家的莊園共度週末.起初,熱情的歡迎似乎讓他們對跨種族關係感到尷尬--直到令人不安的真相浮出水面.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Chris joins his girlfriend Rose for a weekend at her familys estate. At first, their warm welcome seems like awkwardness about their interracial relationship-until disturbing truths emerge.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 派屈克・貝特曼是一名在華爾街,於父親公司任職的年輕人,卻毫無理由地殺人.隨著日子一天天過去,他對世界的仇恨愈發強烈.這部極度黑暗的黑色喜劇改編自布雷特・伊斯頓・艾利斯的同名小說.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Patrick Bateman, a young man working on Wall Street at his fathers company kills for no reason at all. With each day, his hatred for the world becomes more and more intense. This incredibly dark comedy is based on the book by Bret Easton Ellis.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在經歷了一系列短程航行後,曾經權傾一時的弗林特船長遭遇了船員叛變.約翰·西爾弗加入了弗林特的海盜船,並向船長隱瞞了一件價值連城的物品.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: After a run of short hauls, the once powerful Captain Flint faces mutiny by his own crew. John Silver joins Flints pirate ship, hiding something of great value from his captain.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 弗林特揭露了船員中的一名竊賊.拉克姆不顧範恩的反對,執意追查一筆贓物.西爾弗和麥斯躲在妓院裡.埃莉諾面臨一個艱難的抉擇.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Flint unmasks a thief on his crew. Rackham chases a score over Vanes objection. Silver hides with Max in the brothel. Eleanor faces an impossible choice.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 弗林特和蓋茲尋找夥伴一起獵殺烏爾卡·德利馬.西爾弗幫助比利解決士氣低落的問題.範恩的通情達理給埃莉諾留下了深刻的印象.蓋茲升職了.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Flint and Gates seek a partner to hunt the Urca dLima. Silver helps Billy with a morale problem. Vane impresses Eleanor by being reasonable. Gates gets a promotion.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 海象號船員的冒險以災難告終.西爾弗警告弗林特提防比利.拉克姆和邦妮努力重拾生計.埃莉諾尋求父親的幫助.範恩的過去再次浮現.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The Walrus crews venture ends in disaster. Silver warns Flint about Billy. Rackham and Bonny try to regain their livelihood. Eleanor seeks her fathers help. Vanes past pays a visit.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 1863年,阿姆斯特丹瓦隆回到紐約市的五點區,尋求對殺害他父親的屠夫比爾的報復.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In 1863, Amsterdam Vallon returns to the Five Points area of New York City seeking revenge against Bill the Butcher, his fathers killer.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 一名罹患淋巴瘤的男子僱用馬格南尋找他疏遠已久的,骨髓配型成功的兄弟,而他的兄弟也同樣需要馬格南的幫助.此外,麥林的案件也喚起了海豹部隊隊員們一段不堪回首的往事:一次失敗的任務讓他們痛苦不堪.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A man dying of lymphoma hires Magnum to find his estranged, bone-marrow-compatible brother who turns out to need Magnums help as well. Also, Magnums case brings back haunted memories for the guys of a past SEAL team mission that went sideways.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 16 歲的綁架受害者阿曼達(萊麗卡·奧卡諾飾)逃脫綁匪後,她的父母僱用了曾經作為戰俘經歷過類似創傷的麥林,來尋找綁架她的人.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: After a 16-year-old kidnap victim, Amanda (Lyrica Okano), escapes her captors, her parents hire Magnum, who experienced similar trauma as a POW, to find who took her.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: Elliots newest hack helps him share his emotions. Whiterose puts the pieces in motion. Elliot and Darlene have a disagreement and Vera plans his next move. In flashbacks, some key moments in Whiteroses life are revealed.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 遊戲一開始,王楠,王子和阿克拉普託就被迫與被維爾迪的能力逼瘋的米森戰鬥.他們無法與米森溝通,該如何阻止她的暴走?
epg.episode_synopsis_en: As soon as the game begins, Wangnan, Prince, and Akraptor are forced to fight against Miseng, who has been driven mad by Verdis ability. Unable to communicate with Miseng, how will they stop her rampage?

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 奧科霍和梅莉因在上一場戰鬥中違抗命令而受到指責,但莫德雷德告訴女王這一切都是布朗戈爾領主的失誤,從而救了她們.同時,塞斯繼續訓練,以便學會控制自己的力量.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 塞斯繼續接受米爾和吉爾的嚴格訓練,以期控制自己的力量.同時,面對即將到來的復仇女神威脅,騎士巫師們被迫接受德·吉利斯領主的援助,展開緊急行動.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Seth continues his rigorous training with Myr and Jill so that he can control his powers. Meanwhile, the Knight-Sorcerers are forced to accept the aid of Lord de Guilis during an emergency operation on an approaching Nemesis threat.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 塞斯仍然無法控制他那肆虐的力量.他試圖壓制它,卻反而越來越接近被它徹底吞噬.但當他回想起迄今為止建立的所有羈絆和關係時,塞斯覺醒了!
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Seth is still unable to control his rampaging power. He tries to suppress it, but only ends up closer to being completely engulfed by it. But by thinking about all the bonds and relationships hes forged up to this point, Seth experiences an awake...

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在白雪公主之前,兩位女王的對決在狩獵者:凜冬之戰中揭開序幕.獵神艾瑞克與邪惡勢力展開鬥爭,拯救王國免於拉維娜的黑暗統治,愛情,背叛和戰爭由此展開.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Before Snow White, two queens clash in The Huntsman: Winters War. Love, betrayal, and war unfold as Huntsman Eric battles evil to save a kingdom from Ravennas dark reign.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 派屈克・貝特曼是一名在華爾街,於父親公司任職的年輕人,卻毫無理由地殺人.隨著日子一天天過去,他對世界的仇恨愈發強烈.這部極度黑暗的黑色喜劇改編自布雷特・伊斯頓・艾利斯的同名小說.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Patrick Bateman, a young man working on Wall Street at his fathers company kills for no reason at all. With each day, his hatred for the world becomes more and more intense. This incredibly dark comedy is based on the book by Bret Easton Ellis.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 一次訓練事故後,關於女性是否應該被允許成為太空人的全國性辯論爆發.迪克·斯雷頓為該計劃辯護,並在未經美國宇航局官員許可的情況下公開宣布了首批女宇航員名單.為了讓第一位登上月球的美國女性讓路,戈爾多史蒂文斯被從阿波羅15號任務中除名.月球衛星影像顯示可能存在水,這對於計劃中的美國月球基地至關重要...
epg.episode_synopsis_en: There is a national debate about whether women should be allowed to become astronauts after a training accident. Deke Slayton defends the program and publicly announces the first class of female astronauts, without permission from NASA officials. ...

epg.episode_synopsis_en: Jared and Simon find their first field guide page and make unexpected friendships in the process. Mallory struggles to find her footing in Henson while Helen deals with her visiting mother.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: Flint and the Walrus crew play a deadly chess match on the open sea. Richard forces Eleanors hand. Rackham makes a career change. Bonny confesses to Max.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: The costs of chasing the Andromache continue to mount. Eleanor needs Silvers help. Billy wants Gates to confront Flint. Bonny takes a stand.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 弗林特告訴蓋茲真相.蘭德爾讓西爾弗陷入困境.埃莉諾遭遇不幸.麥克斯出手相助拉克姆.範恩迎來了他人生中最艱難的一戰.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Flint tells Gates the truth. Randall puts Silver in a bind. Eleanor suffers a loss. Max comes to Rackhams aid. Vane enters the fight of his life.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 尋找烏爾卡的行動開始了.埃莉諾的命運徹底改變.邦妮和拉克姆的罪開始反噬他們.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The hunt for the Urca is on. Everything changes for Eleanor. Bonny and Rackhams sins come back to haunt them.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: In Miami Vice, undercover detectives played by Jamie Foxx and Colin Farrell navigate danger, crime, and seduction in a gritty, stylish update of the iconic TV series. Also stars Gong Li.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 16 歲的綁架受害者阿曼達(萊麗卡·奧卡諾飾)逃脫綁匪後,她的父母僱用了曾經作為戰俘經歷過類似創傷的麥林,來尋找綁架她的人.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: After a 16-year-old kidnap victim, Amanda (Lyrica Okano), escapes her captors, her parents hire Magnum, who experienced similar trauma as a POW, to find who took her.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 麥林必須幫助瑞克暗戀的東尼(客串明星傑米琳恩西格勒飾),因為她組織了一場非法撲克牌局來償還黑幫債務,結果被蒙面槍手搶劫了.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Magnum must help Ricks crush, Toni (guest star Jamie-Lynn Sigler), after her illegal poker game, organized to pay back a mob debt, is robbed by masked gunmen.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: As the town bustles in preparation for the upcoming ordination ceremony, Ocoho leaves quietly, avoiding being seen. Lord Brangoire grows suspicious of her behavior and attacks her. Melie stops him, but is shocked by Ocohos actions!

epg.episode_synopsis_en: Dragunov and Liselotte meet with Doussant of the Merchant Barons, who proposes an alliance that could help the Inquisition that would mean the neutralization of Fantasia. Meanwhile, Ocoho seeks the truth about who is using her curse to make the Sp...

epg.episode_synopsis_en: Retired hitman, Frank, known as The Silencer wants to lead a normal life with his new girlfriend and her daughter but is unwillingly brought back into the game when a mafia mob boss wants him to avenge the death of his young daughter

epg.episode_synopsis_en: In *Waterworld*, Kevin Costner stars as a lone maverick in a flooded future Earth, protecting a mother and daughter from a tribe of ruthless nomads. Dennis Hopper delivers a memorable villainous performance in this thrilling adventure.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: Magnum and Higgins are shocked when one of her former MI6 teammates shows up with a fresh gunshot wound and news that the assassin who killed Higgins true love, has surfaced on Oahu.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 謝拉和西門抓到先布達,但對能否信任幻形怪這問題上無法達成共識.布莉鼓勵瑪洛莉在史敗打域克莊園舉辦一場派對,認識鎮上的其他孩子.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Jared and Simon capture Thimbletack but cant agree on whether they can trust the boggart. Bree encourages Mallory to throw a party at the Spiderwick Estate to meet other kids in town.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 西門逃往紐約去尋求父親的指導,並帶來卡拉亞庇作道德支援.謝拉和先布達要聯手搶先穆加華夫找到龍之書.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 阿納克和蘭的比賽採用了特殊規則,他們進行一對一的較量.兩位選手使出渾身解數,激烈交鋒,賭徒們也興奮不已,戰鬥終於接近尾聲!同時,在工作室裡誕生的貝塔出現在維奧萊面前...
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Special rules are applied to Anaak and Rans match, and they face off against each other one-on-one. As both combatants fight fiercely with all their strength, the gamblers become excited, and the battle finally nears its end! Meanwhile, Beta, who...

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 個人賽的勝者--瘋狗隊和FUG隊--將在工坊之戰中一決高下,而敗者則晉級訓練賽.隨著各自戰鬥的開始,坤和王楠開始召喚他們的隊友.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The results of the individual tournament pit the two winning teams, Team Mad Dog and Team FUG, against each other in the Workshop Battle, while the losing teams advance to the training tournament. As their respective battles begin, Khun and Wangna...

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 德拉古諾夫和莉澤洛特會見了商賈男爵杜桑,杜桑提議結盟,此舉或許能幫助宗教裁判所,並最終瓦解幻想王國.與此同時,奧科霍正在調查究竟是誰利用她的詛咒讓幽靈復仇女神現身.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Dragunov and Liselotte meet with Doussant of the Merchant Barons, who proposes an alliance that could help the Inquisition that would mean the neutralization of Fantasia. Meanwhile, Ocoho seeks the truth about who is using her curse to make the Sp...

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 宗教裁判所的入侵開始了.布狄卡進行了頑強的抵抗,但她的騎士們無法突破宗教裁判所新機器產生的幻想真空.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The Inquisition invasion begins. Boudica puts up an impressive defense, but her knights are unable to break through the Fantasia Vacuum generated by the Inquisitions new machine.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 宗教裁判所開始重創騎士團,這主要歸功於他們新發展的幻想消除裝置.塞斯戰勝了皮奧頓,但在前往參戰支援奧科霍的途中被德拉古諾夫攔截.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The Inquisition starts wrecking the knights, largely thanks to their new fantasia nullification device. Seth wins over Piodon, then gets intercepted by Dragunov on his way to join the battle and help Ocoho.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 前中情局分析員賴利康納揭露中情局的不當行為,並逃往哥倫比亞兩年,被她的老搭檔帶回來執行最後一項任務,以洗擦汙名.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Two years after exposing CIA wrongdoing and fleeing to Colombia, ex-CIA analyst Riley Connor is brought back in by her old partner for one last assignment in order to clear her name.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 羅素克洛在雷德利史考特的史詩巨製羅賓漢中飾演羅賓漢--在這段傳奇中,他奮起對抗腐敗,點燃反叛之火,讓一位卑微的亡命之徒化身為永恆的自由象徵.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Russell Crowe stars as Robin Hood in Ridley Scotts epic reimagining-fighting corruption and sparking a rebellion that turns a humble outlaw into a timeless symbol of freedom.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在反恐戰場中,傑米福克斯率領一支菁英FBI小組前往沙烏地阿拉伯追捕一名恐怖分子--這是一場文化與正義的緊張交鋒.該片由彼得柏格執導,麥可曼監製.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Jamie Foxx leads an elite FBI team to hunt a terrorist in Saudi Arabia in The Kingdom-a tense clash of cultures and justice, directed by Peter Berg and produced by Michael Mann.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在水世界中,凱文・科斯納飾演被洪水淹沒的未來地球上一名獨行俠,保護一對母女免受殘暴遊牧族的追殺.丹尼斯・霍珀塑造出令人難忘的反派角色,為這部刺激冒險片增添亮點.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In *Waterworld*, Kevin Costner stars as a lone maverick in a flooded future Earth, protecting a mother and daughter from a tribe of ruthless nomads. Dennis Hopper delivers a memorable villainous performance in this thrilling adventure.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 退休殺手法蘭克,人稱「沉默者」.想跟他的新女友和她女兒過上正常的生活,但黑手黨老大要他為年幼的女兒的死報仇,他身不由己地重出江湖.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Retired hitman, Frank, known as The Silencer wants to lead a normal life with his new girlfriend and her daughter but is unwillingly brought back into the game when a mafia mob boss wants him to avenge the death of his young daughter

Creating a brand-new interactive ATM that combined with puzzle solving and daily life! Guests can win money by taking three rounds of intellectual challenges from the ATM, turn wisdom into money!
Futuristic program scenes with video game clearing concept, where challengers engage in the intellectual competition to switch on the ATM. Those who won goes to the ultimate challenge. Host Hu Gua, co-host Sandra and the elite challengers will stay together, built up a whole new competition between technology and wisdom!

epg.episode_synopsis_en: Established in Year 2004, Creation TV has produced a lot of quality programs and delivers the message of happy-life Joy with God to families via our television broadcast. Programs are edited and produced as the tools for evangelists and life education.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 有人說,人生是一場戲,在人生的過程中,尋找有時、碰壁有時、迷失有時、覺醒有時,說真的,這些起承轉合比真正的電影情節更精彩,每一個「你」,都是天父特別設計的人生劇本主角。 今天,我們的世界充滿了末世風情,醉生夢死、迷失自我了結生命的悲劇每天上演,創世電視藉100個見證故事挽救生命,100位來自世界各地..

epg.programme_title_tc: 如果還有明天4 能回家真好
epg.programme_title_en: My Day After Tomorrow IV - So Good To Be Home
epg.episode_synopsis_tc:
每一個人,都需要一個溫暖、安全,可以得到庇護的家。可是,能回家的路不是必然,可以與摯愛天家相聚也並非絕對,突如起來的天災,毫無先兆的頑疾,極速致命的意外,誤入歧途的決定,足以令一個家毀於一旦。
第四輯《如果還有明天》搜羅多個見證故事,有50年代經典歌曲《情人的眼淚》原唱者潘秀瓊、《陰陽路》編劇、狗仔..

epg.programme_title_tc: 聖地流動教室-以色列破謎之旅
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 通曉中西方歷史、文學、藝術、民間傳說的學者吳宗文牧師,以及主持梁藝齡,透過鏡頭帶著電視觀眾,去到聖地各站遊歷,呈現出新舊約的《聖經》典故、歷史文獻的記載、相關的猶太傳說和傳統習俗,而更重要是從耶穌和初期信徒的記載,帶出人生的重要特質,助你成就非凡人生。

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: What does healthy” really mean in 2025? In this episode of Don’t Hold Back, host Nozibele Qamngana-Mayaba sits down with fitness coach Kopano Mokhele, who deliberately gained 25 kilos and is now losing it again so that he can understand what his clients go through. epg.episode_synopsis_tc: While the Berlin Wall became the symbol of the Cold War, another border was just as deadly: the Baltic Sea. For nearly 30 years, thousands of East Germans risked everything to flee the GDR across the water. Almost 6,000 people attempted the dangerous journey to West Germany or Denmark. At least 140 died trying — more than at the Berlin Wall.

epg.programme_title_tc: 香港早晨[粵] 及 環球新聞檔案[粵]
epg.programme_title_en: Good Morning Hong Kong[Can] and International News File[Can]

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 遨遊全世界最受歡迎且充滿美態與魅力的旅遊勝地，欣賞美妙的天然奇景、引人入勝的古蹟、精湛的手工藝和迷人的景色。帶觀眾踏上難忘的旅程，融入夢想旅遊目的地的傳統與歷史裡。
阿拉伯的傳統手工刺繡—塔利，由多條線, 不斷重複地編織，用以裝飾阿聯酋的傳統服裝，讓阿拉伯人在重要場合上穿上。塔利是塑造阿聯酋女性身分認同並傳承多元口述文化的種子。
一群小販靠著一些不常見的食物和簡樸的小吃維持生計，他們是如何吸引後代加入他們的行列？當他們將自己的飲食文化推廣到海外時，又會發生什麼事？

epg.programme_title_tc: 胡說八道真情假期[粵] 及 潮流生活誌之格倫菲爾護齒大滿足[粵]
epg.programme_title_en: The Sisterhood Traveling Gang[Can] and Pop Lifestyle Guide (Ad Mag)[Can]
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 六人轉赴沙漠區域，在澳洲北領地延續閨蜜之旅。她們還在酒店房內舉行非一般選美會，大玩才藝表演；貪玩的胡杏兒縱然腹大便便，仍盡情扭動身體「擺甫」。氣氛一片歡樂，黃智雯、李施嬅為何突然感觸落淚？置身沙漠享用晚餐別具滋味，還於夕陽下呷着香檳欣賞「神石」，感受「愛的呼喚」。燈泡草原充滿浪漫情調，眾女卻禁不住要打斷寧靜！「跑得之人」胡定欣、姚子羚和胡蓓蔚停下腳步，學玩雙輪車親近巨石，期間竟有人向巨石祈求姻緣？
Ben上集經歷洗碗之苦後，決定要找好友來塔門Camping分擔一下。Ben邀黃翠如前來，還「附送」連詩雅，怎料柏豪所請的是張寶兒！Ben與寶兒拍住拖去魚排餵魚，電燈膽翠如大讚Ben型格，「某人女友」寶兒竟笑稱不覺得……把漁獲帶返營地後，分男、女子組煮食，有人不停令食物「墮地」，兩男不禁擔心她們家中的廚房，詩雅還指紅色的魚就是紅衫魚？翠如訴說結婚後的意義，Ben隨即接續話題，莫非有「特別」暗示？

角色扮演(Cosplay)是指透過服飾、道具、化妝搭配等，扮演動漫或遊戲角色的行為，谷主泳嘉透露十多歲時也曾接觸。角色扮演文化起初只被視為商業推銷手段，直至九十年代，某部機甲動漫風靡全球，箇中角色被爭相扮演，才令大眾對這文化改觀。汛文曾參觀在港舉行的動漫展，形容猶如置身新的世界。為盡力「神還原」角色，許多Coser會親自製作衣飾，並鑽研妝容。據說有愛好者為了完美做出角色的招牌動作，不惜苦練翻筋斗。

epg.programme_title_tc: 滙豐Premier Elite呈獻：《滙豐Premier Elite財富滙談》[粵]
epg.programme_title_en: HSBC Premier Elite Presents:HSBC Premier Elite Wealth Studio[Can]
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 金融市場瞬息萬變，加上科技發展日新月異，如何影響投資市場？《滙豐Premier Elite財富滙談》，雲集不同行業專家，剖析市場趨勢，講解金融、投資及理財等話題，務求做到深入淺出，聚焦分析不同議題，為大家捕捉市場先機。

藍隊潘靜文、侯雋熙、金永衡邀周志康助陣，望延續玩遊戲強勢；紅隊張馳豪、林智樂、李茵彤獲周吉佩力撐求突破！攻方永衡為搶咪達陣，跳舞時脫外套遮擋守方吉吉，反而出醜。接力健身兼唱歌，某男被指實力似女生？馳豪、雋熙比拼邊做引體上升邊獻聲。要還原原唱即興發揮位，再透過唱歌吹乒乓波落杯，可會難倒兩隊？揭拼圖估歌名，竟變MVP大戰豬隊友！吉吉拍馳豪、志康搭永衡，上演結他彈唱擂台，緊接全員上陣以張學友名曲鬥改編。
今時今日問10個人有什麼願望，9個人會答:身體健康！這些日子，疫症肆虐，人人都要增強抵抗力，才能與病毒共存；拉闊點看，人類平均壽命延長了，不好好保養自己等老了體弱多病的話，苦了自己也苦了家人，怎過意得去！

epg.programme_title_tc: 雙祥見[粵] 及 語你同行三十載[粵]
epg.programme_title_en: More Than Mall[Can] and SCOLAR 30 years on: A Language Education Journey[Can]
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 兩位祥哥大展廚藝，炮製豆腐火腩飯，完美示範什麼叫男人的浪漫！同時更大談拍攝時的恐怖經歷！MEN’S TALK環節則展現男性柔弱一面，分享男人最痛最辛酸的一刻。
《地球大神秘》在過去兩輯，為大家從世界各地大神秘事物之中尋找出路，從而應對未知的將來，並於即將播放的新一輯節目當中，藉揭開終極神秘Secret X更了解地球奧秘。所謂「前事不忘、後事之師」，我們在新一輯節目播放之前，先播放過往兩輯節目的精選片段，透過重溫部分重點大神秘，讓我們從中得到嶄新啟發，為即將進入更深入的尋秘之旅打下更堅實的基礎。
勝仁向阿渡和阿驅解釋現時情況，並送走二人去和炎上達決戰。炎上彈吸收人類世界的炎上之力後變成炎上太陽，御富良院為阻止炎上達而犧牲。兩人看過御富良院留下的影片後，重新振作創造出神龍王丸。
這回「WORKOUT 2GETHER」有健身教練帶來「協調及核心訓練」，要做到喘氣才算有效果。先做平板支撐姿勢，然後單腳踏前，再將手向上打開。接着翻身面向天，手腳撐地並抬起臀部，雙手輪流輕碰對側腳腕；還有較常見的波比跳和仰臥起坐動作。休息過後，轉攻「爆發力訓練」。二人一組，一人站在後方，藉拉扯橡筋帶為拍檔施加阻力，前方的人則盡力向前跑和跳，展現爆發力。「拆夥」後，再以單人深蹲跳與拋接球作結。
森林裡神秘怪事頻生。巨大陷阱出現，栗子消失，昆蟲失蹤，橡實從天而降！要交由大偵探Peet和朋友Baba和Molly組成的查查林部隊調查。牠們未必是最能幹的偵探隊，但往往能夠迎刃而解，揭開大自然奧秘。
森林裡神秘怪事頻生。巨大陷阱出現，栗子消失，昆蟲失蹤，橡實從天而降！要交由大偵探Peet和朋友Baba和Molly組成的查查林部隊調查。牠們未必是最能幹的偵探隊，但往往能夠迎刃而解，揭開大自然奧秘。
安妮將赴雷德蒙大學升學，既期待新生活，又對離開艾凡里感到不安。基爾伯特多番關心，令她更覺心亂。到埗後，安妮與庇斯娜逐漸適應校園，並結識率真開朗的菲莉帕，對京士波特開始產生歸屬感。

epg.programme_title_tc: 潮流生活誌之格倫菲爾護齒大滿足[粵]
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 香港，一個中西薈萃、新舊共融的國際都市，不論吃喝、玩樂、購物都多姿多采。節目中主持人會介紹最新的潮流資訊和生活熱話，為你發掘香港更精彩的一面，講究生活和追求時尚的你絕對不能錯過。
翡翠台每日下午六點半，報道本地、兩岸及國際重要新聞。

epg.programme_title_tc: 新聞透視[粵] 及 語你同行三十載[粵]
epg.programme_title_en: News Magazine[Can] and SCOLAR 30 years on: A Language Education Journey[Can]
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 《新聞透視》，每周專題報道多段香港以至國際的矚目新聞，聚焦港人最關心的民生話題，並邀請各界人士、學者、專家，一同深入探討箇中來龍去脈。
香港特區政府帶領各個部門及單位，適時推出不同的政策措施，為本港市民、到訪旅客、來自外地的投資者提供便捷服務。香港這麼好，當然要多說一些讓大家知道。《好嘢港多啲》以輕鬆有趣的拍攝手法，配合陳豪、高海寧、張振朗、劉佩玥、周嘉洛、羅子溢、馬國明、陳懿德、陳展鵬、劉穎鏇等一眾星級藝員，透過不同角色、形象，生動地表達香港的各樣美好和優勢。
《東張西望》星期一至日，緊貼追蹤社會大事、趣聞逸事，並報道娛樂圈最新動態、藝人消息，以及劇集宣傳和花絮。「今日突發」環節為大家追蹤即日熱門新聞；專題環節，深入探討大眾關心的時事、社會及民生問題，並訪問相關的專家。

epg.programme_title_tc: 香港系列之細間始終你好[粵]
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 玩具是孩童玩意？懷舊玩具舖老闆卻稱，大多熟客是三、四十歲年齡層男士，可能是想彌補兒時買不到玩具的遺憾。祥師兄進店，喜歡哪幾款？小小的舖頭放置多個玻璃瓶，裝載的既是涼果，也是顧客的寄託，老師、講者都是涼果舖的常客。曾想過結業退休的店主，為着客人的熱情，選擇繼續服務大眾。遇燃眉之急，有人會到當舖押物，原來過往年代，收音機、傳呼機都可典當？祥師兄獲邀深入當舖內部，了解其運作以及當舖為市民提供的「貼心」。
廉政公署首席調查主任陸志廉（古天樂 飾）與總調查主任程德明（鄭嘉穎 飾）共同調查走私貪污案，意外發現另一起涉及人口販賣的海關貪腐重大弊案...

epg.programme_title_tc: 伯樂音樂學院20週年呈獻：J Music[粵]
epg.programme_title_en: Baron's School of Music Presents:J Music[Can]
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 蕭正楠、曹永廉、馬國明(馬明)近月以「三生有幸」為主題舉行巡迴演唱會，三位小生到臨《J Music》帶來同名歌曲。阿蕭、阿廉以歌手身分出道，為何會加上馬明一同巡唱兼出歌？他們還會演繹劉德華的作品<17歲>和<笨小孩>。Honey Punch其中四位成員苦練舞藝多時，終於迎來首爾街頭公開唱跳<無糖賓治>的機會；表演之前，同行的主持柯雨霏先帶她們置裝。另外，許文軒以聲音倒數本星期「勁歌金榜」排名。
報道本地、兩岸、國際重要新聞以及體育消息，讓你洞悉各地大事及體壇動向。

epg.programme_title_tc: 香港賽馬會特約：J Sport[粵] 及 潮流生活誌之格倫菲爾護齒大滿足[粵]
epg.programme_title_en: Hong Kong Jockey Club Presents:J Sport[Can] and Pop Lifestyle Guide (Ad Mag)[Can]
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 攀爬單車手李漢堯多次稱霸本港賽事，他細談該運動的吸引之處，以及所用單車與常見款式的分別。藝員陳力行兼任運動攝影師，雙重身分相互影響；他還分享參與知名健身賽拍攝工作的感受。秋季帆船賽順利舉行，也宣告賽季正式開鑼；另有活動邀特殊學童體驗帆船。男、女子棍網球港隊將征戰亞太區錦標賽，備戰情況如何？東方籃球隊獲新外援加盟，對新球季有何目標？此外，搜羅田徑周年大賽、女子十五人欖球賽戰報，及香港聯賽盃足球精華。
時間倉卒，警方仍未查到瓦干布的位置，但成功癱瘓伺服器，把羅智勇匯入瓦干布的資金攔截下來；家寶和嘉軒一起喝酒後發生了一夜情，兩人強裝鎮定；羅智勇躲了起來，S小隊決定監視他在香港的情婦，希望能找出他。
《東張西望》星期一至日，緊貼追蹤社會大事、趣聞逸事，並報道娛樂圈最新動態、藝人消息，以及劇集宣傳和花絮。「今日突發」環節為大家追蹤即日熱門新聞；專題環節，深入探討大眾關心的時事、社會及民生問題，並訪問相關的專家。
Ben上集經歷洗碗之苦後，決定要找好友來塔門Camping分擔一下。Ben邀黃翠如前來，還「附送」連詩雅，怎料柏豪所請的是張寶兒！Ben與寶兒拍住拖去魚排餵魚，電燈膽翠如大讚Ben型格，「某人女友」寶兒竟笑稱不覺得……把漁獲帶返營地後，分男、女子組煮食，有人不停令食物「墮地」，兩男不禁擔心她們家中的廚房，詩雅還指紅色的魚就是紅衫魚？翠如訴說結婚後的意義，Ben隨即接續話題，莫非有「特別」暗示？

六人轉赴沙漠區域，在澳洲北領地延續閨蜜之旅。她們還在酒店房內舉行非一般選美會，大玩才藝表演；貪玩的胡杏兒縱然腹大便便，仍盡情扭動身體「擺甫」。氣氛一片歡樂，黃智雯、李施嬅為何突然感觸落淚？置身沙漠享用晚餐別具滋味，還於夕陽下呷着香檳欣賞「神石」，感受「愛的呼喚」。燈泡草原充滿浪漫情調，眾女卻禁不住要打斷寧靜！「跑得之人」胡定欣、姚子羚和胡蓓蔚停下腳步，學玩雙輪車親近巨石，期間竟有人向巨石祈求姻緣？
今時今日問10個人有什麼願望，9個人會答:身體健康！這些日子，疫症肆虐，人人都要增強抵抗力，才能與病毒共存；拉闊點看，人類平均壽命延長了，不好好保養自己等老了體弱多病的話，苦了自己也苦了家人，怎過意得去！
兩位祥哥大展廚藝，炮製豆腐火腩飯，完美示範什麼叫男人的浪漫！同時更大談拍攝時的恐怖經歷！MEN’S TALK環節則展現男性柔弱一面，分享男人最痛最辛酸的一刻。
阿拉伯的傳統手工刺繡—塔利，由多條線, 不斷重複地編織，用以裝飾阿聯酋的傳統服裝，讓阿拉伯人在重要場合上穿上。塔利是塑造阿聯酋女性身分認同並傳承多元口述文化的種子。
一群小販靠著一些不常見的食物和簡樸的小吃維持生計，他們是如何吸引後代加入他們的行列？當他們將自己的飲食文化推廣到海外時，又會發生什麼事？
遨遊全世界最受歡迎且充滿美態與魅力的旅遊勝地，欣賞美妙的天然奇景、引人入勝的古蹟、精湛的手工藝和迷人的景色。帶觀眾踏上難忘的旅程，融入夢想旅遊目的地的傳統與歷史裡。
明朝三大特務機構錦衣衛、東廠、西廠為皇上監察官民和學者，但其手法擾亂朝綱，而且人手架構重疊，明武宗決定精簡人手，另組史上最強特務組織！另外，歷史第一綠帽男武大郎為老婆潘金蓮伸冤，為姦夫西門慶洗脫罪名！
中國有妲己和褒姒兩大妖姬，她們令到一國之君不務正業，對於妖女的稱呼，二人有何話說？黎芷珊訪問二人的妖女必殺技！「大鑊密探凌凌一」發現項羽火燒阿房宮一事內有冤情，項羽能否洗脫千古火燒皇宮的「爛仔」之名？

首集請來「降魔」搭檔馬國明、黃智雯，對戰「閨蜜」黃翠如和唐詩詠。日本一間髮型屋，顧客只需完成指定事宜，即可獲免費剪髮服務。「明智隊」先拔頭籌，偏偏擲出Do姐圖案，反被扣分！台灣啤酒博物館內的蒙娜麗莎畫像，以甚麼物件組成？梁芷珮介紹的桑拿用品形狀獨特，兩隊競猜其用途。馬明以功能卡搶走對手的正確答案，即被冠上狐狸之名！日本「大人包巾減壓法」又源自甚麼體驗？兌換獎金環節，翠如能否憑豐富旅遊經驗力挽狂瀾？

epg.programme_title_en: Emotion And Taste Of Hong Kong[Can]
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 從車仔檔到上舖，「肥姐小食店」負責人「肥姐」一直堅持良心經營的信念，食店因而得到街坊支持，並獲下一代延續下去。阿詩經營的西餐廳，因敵不過加租壓力，被迫結業，幸得家人體諒，阿詩定下「十年計劃」，完成心願。單親媽媽Gigi曾任職財務策劃師，為修補與子女的關係，從零開始經營車仔麵店，在師傅、業主和街坊支持下，跨過開業時的難關。薛家燕與達人「肥姐」及兩位「夢想者」阿詩、Gigi交流餐廳經營之道。

女採集藝術家採集由大自然「調配」而成的青草茶，從雜草看出每片土地不同的種物形態。她亦為每塊土地繪畫一幅曼陀羅，將雜草藉着畫作呈現出來。木作藝術家用木頭隨心創作，發掘木頭更多的可能性，且聽他介紹藍染系列作品的特色。一棵被颱風吹倒的樹木亦可成為素材，藝術家分享木工創作的吸引力。仿生植物飾品藝術家女拍檔透過觀察植物獲取靈感，創作皮革小配件。二人尤其喜歡形態萬千的蕨類植物，藉以激起大家於逆境中成長的勇氣。
隨著愛麗絲出道與陽光閃亮馬戲團到來，星夢頻道樂園的日光馬戲團區變得熱鬧非常，更成為第四屆星夢公主杯的場地。當愛麗絲正打算開始做演唱會時，馬戲團的好友傻嚕嚕竟然奪走她的星夢電子蛋，轉身而去……

epg.programme_title_en: Pleasant Goat and Big Big Wolf - Mighty Goat Squad 2[Can/Man]

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 星期日，爸爸被噪音導致無法好好休息。因此，大雄想找個寧靜的地方給爸爸渡過這一天。霸道的胖虎總是獨佔自己想要的東西。剛巧多啦A夢有法寶可令物品變成幾份，大雄於是想到用此法寶來應對胖虎的獨佔欲。

epg.programme_title_tc: LET'S CAMP! 露營少女[粵/日]
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 小葵初次踏小姑送的公路單車，一時興起遠行去找小明，卻因為爆胎而無法回家。小凜會合櫻與撫子，三人吃過硬布丁後，一起上山去看笈形燒。回家路上，櫻提議下年再去賞花，撫子開心應允。

epg.programme_title_tc: 盲盒鐵路遊[粵] 及 無煙新進程[粵]
epg.programme_title_en: Blind Travel by Rail[Can] and Tobacco-Free Journey: The New Phase[Can]
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 上回揭示的盲盒目的地，明明需坐十小時高鐵才抵達，製作組卻突然通知主持下車？突發改往長城最東的山海關，親睹城牆的宏偉，然後吃個具「第一關」特色的渾鍋，它跟海鮮部隊鍋相若，卻食出酸菜魚的味道？阿那亞是文青聖地，連接沙灘的孤獨圖書館如何爆紅？三位主持更到北岸參與索道滑水，曾傷膝的德德為節目拼一次，先後流出驚慌和感動的眼淚！來到海邊酒吧談心，三人同為支持自己演藝圈工作的父母乾杯！感性時刻，突然要抽盲盒……
煎炸點心香脆可口，也是吸引「較年輕一輩」的飲茶食品選擇！盈盈為家英哥點齊「四大炸點」春卷、芋角、咸水角、炸雲吞，各有特色。而把炸雲吞提升至更高層次的「錦鹵雲吞」，又有甚麼故事？有新派餐廳亦為咸水角與芋角加添矜貴度，咸水角造成雪梨形狀，咬下去竟有煙燻感覺？昔日的點心車年代，有專為煎糕而設計的車款；此外，黃金糕的起源如何？楓馨另介紹一款「上湯煎粉果」，要做到外皮鬆脆、餡料煙韌兼備，絕不容易！

白滑腸粉加入不同餡料、調味料，味道多姿多彩，家英哥以此比喻人生！腸粉由街邊小食升呢酒樓美點，除了鮮蝦、上素等傳統餡料，新口味亦推陳出新。水煮牛肉衝擊味蕾，鮮蝦脆皮紅米、墨魚汁皮配和牛雞髀菇餡又有何特色？懷舊鹹、甜糕點各有捧場客，蘿蔔糕、芋頭糕可謂經典；桂花椰汁紅豆糕結合三重滋味；千層糕是鹹是甜，取決於吃者的心境？盈盈嚐味之餘，不忘帶來小米的營養資訊。置身古雅茶樓，享用芝麻糕、薑汁糕，別有一番情懷。

epg.programme_title_en: Workplace Newcomers - Season of Traditional Chinese Medicine[Can/Man]
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 《初入職場·中醫季》深度聚焦中醫文化，攜手中醫專業人才及中醫助力團一起，通過"潮養生活"與"中醫歷練"，開啟一場年輕態的中醫文化科普之旅。

參加沙漠觀光團，芷珮探索尖峰石陣，領略大自然奧秘。出海與海獅「玩水」後，沿着一望無際的沙漠，駕駛四輪電單車極速飛馳；又會從斜坡上「滑沙」，她卻笑言未玩先攰？遊覽出口龍蝦工場，順道享用海鮮大餐。費裡曼圖是着重藝術與保育的文青小鎮，芷珮到彩虹貨櫃裝置打卡，走訪啤酒廠與舊建築咖啡店，再深入特色市場買手信。由監獄保安宿舍改建的酒店，充滿懷舊格調！此外，芷珮尋找藍色小屋MV取景點，也會登上大橋頂玩高空滑索。
紅棗不但有助對抗皮膚乾燥，它與熱情果還是製作甜品的其中一對最佳拍檔。古嘉俊邀請笑容甜美、充滿陽光氣息的岑麗香到來，合力炮製一款創意無限的「紅棗熱情果朱古力撻」，為觀眾送上甜美溫暖感覺。

epg.programme_title_tc: 香港同胞慶祝中華人民共和國成立七十七周年文藝晚會[粵]
epg.programme_title_en: Variety Show In Celebration Of The 77th Anniversary Of The Founding Of The People's Republic of China[Can]
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 為慶祝中華人民共和國成立七十七周年，國慶文藝晚會以「香江放歌・山海同慶」為主題。節目引領大家重溫晚會的精彩表演內容，包括當代流行音樂、傳統粵劇、高難度雜技、奇幻魔術、動人舞蹈等。當晚星光熠熠，除了鄺美雲、陳潔靈、劉錫明、曾航生、海兒、許靖韻、戴祖儀、林智樂等一眾星級歌手獻聲之外，著名魔術師甄澤權亦會展現超凡魔力，祝賀國慶。不同演出單位傾力合作，打造一場藝術盛會，讓觀眾也可一同感受國慶節的歡樂氣氛。

汪明荃藉着一位生命鬥士的故事，勉勵大家不要低估自己的能力。故事中的女主角出生三個月便確診一種罕見遺傳病，身體機能會逐漸退化。女孩曾三度心跳停頓，但求生意志堅強。她十八歲時雖只剩下右手的拇指與食指有活動能力，仍憑努力成功考進大學。女生及後得悉一種新藥有助治療病症，但因藥費昂貴，不少患者都未能負擔。她遂利用兩隻手指找資料、打字，終完成了一份百多頁的免費用藥建議書交予當局，至今已令約三百位病人因此受惠。
香港特區政府帶領各個部門及單位，適時推出不同的政策措施，為本港市民、到訪旅客、來自外地的投資者提供便捷服務。香港這麼好，當然要多說一些讓大家知道。《好嘢港多啲》以輕鬆有趣的拍攝手法，配合陳豪、高海寧、張振朗、劉佩玥、周嘉洛、羅子溢、馬國明、陳懿德、陳展鵬、劉穎鏇等一眾星級藝員，透過不同角色、形象，生動地表達香港的各樣美好和優勢。
《財經透視》緊貼大市，回顧每周港股走勢外，並關注樓市狀況，透過業界人士專訪、市場分析等，深入淺出探討本港、國際財經金融熱門話題，更以專題形式報道不同行業發展面對的問題。
翡翠台每日下午六點半，報道本地、兩岸及國際重要新聞。

epg.programme_title_tc: 星期日檔案[粵] 及 無煙新進程[粵]
epg.programme_title_en: Sunday Report[Can] and Tobacco-Free Journey: The New Phase[Can]
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 《星期日檔案》，每周聚焦於熱門新聞人物，特寫報道；或以人性化角度，透過走訪社會不同階層，不同界別人士，深入探討大眾關切的政治、社會民生等議題。
《警聲百二秒 IV》引領觀眾「上天下海」、甚至「穿梭過去未來」，並繼續以輕鬆有趣的系列表達方式，讓市民接收豐富的警隊資訊，說好香港警察故事。
《東張西望》星期一至日，緊貼追蹤社會大事、趣聞逸事，並報道娛樂圈最新動態、藝人消息，以及劇集宣傳和花絮。「今日突發」環節為大家追蹤即日熱門新聞；專題環節，深入探討大眾關心的時事、社會及民生問題，並訪問相關的專家。

epg.programme_title_en: China Citic Bank International Motion$ Presents:Try It? Really? (Sr.2)[Can]
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 要早一個月預約的摘星台式餐廳，製作組竟安排到眾主持光顧？餐牌上梅乾扣肉旁標記「難吃」，儘管老闆娘極力勸阻，美儀姐堅持試試可會有伏。店內設有下單後不可加菜的規則，主持們偏要挑戰這條「紅線」，換來甚麼對待？振朗、坤哥為了讓美儀姐答應試食深受寶島年輕人喜愛的皮蛋拌麵，竟接連出言挑釁，怎料她嚐過後狠批只是噱頭？在廟前開設的海鮮大排檔，炭燒午仔魚、炸銀魚等都讓主持們讚不絕口，還忍不住走近廚房打探烹調竅竅門！

epg.programme_title_tc: Funki Finance 呈獻：女神配對計劃2[粵]
epg.programme_title_en: Funki Finance Presents:A Date with Goddess (Sr.2)[Can]
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 繼續「識食」之爭，三位求愛勇者意外地與珮文的口味好夾？可程「專一」大考驗，求愛男眼中只有妳！十人齊集五角枱歎主菜，再起揀位坐風波？藉「九宮格」遊戲訴說「獨特」愛情經歷，男士們自揭異國戀、拍散拖，女神未必啱聽！為爭奪單獨與女神共度甜品時光的機會，勇者們戰鬥力Up！珮文盲摸「骨相」揀人；沛珈愛聞「男人味」？Man爆男進擊嘉敏，教科書級送「暖」！處理「海鮮」冧可程，心意加分？「大隻」是若思擇偶條件之一？

繼續發掘澳門好去處。將辣魚包融入雞蛋仔中，鹹甜交織有驚喜。營業近百年的老字號雪糕店，雪糕三文治是多代人的甜蜜回憶。紅寶石蝦餃、紅蘿蔔造型酥餅等點心，融合創意、賣相和滋味。大學內的餐廳性價比高，馬介休球等葡式美食值得推介。MYNT集合，隨廣沛一同享用設專人席前烤肉的精緻葡國盛宴。為滿足廣沛買手信的願望，六位女成員分組DIY金桃酥與線香。壓軸挑戰飛索、小型笨豬跳，尖叫聲此起彼落；眾人還會體驗升空用餐。

2026是Gigi梁詠琪加入樂壇三十周年，這年工作看似特別多，原來只屬巧合？回顧最初十數年的演藝生涯，她似乎沒有時間好好休息，竟於一趟TVB拍攝之旅可「瞓晏覺」，自覺奢侈！Gigi出道之時，傳媒記者常將幾位女歌手拿來比較，陳慧琳、楊千嬅對初見Gigi有何印象？Gigi自言曾被「狗仔隊」嚇怕，當年偕同西班牙籍新婚丈夫返港，都要有所「避忌」？主持許文軒還特意回放她反串跳西班牙舞的片段，當事人竟忘記了！
張與辰帶暉哥到訪旺角的韓國餐廳，品嚐軟腍入味的安東燉雞，並向餐廳負責人偷師，學習炮製燉雞的秘訣。灣仔主打正宗拿坡里薄餅的餐廳，其奪得世界薄餅錦標賽冠軍的煙燻半軟芝士胡椒薄餅，以及神父薄餅均不容錯過。星廚莫燦霖推介芝士主題Omakase，細味阿拉斯加帝王蟹提拉米蘇、藍鰭吞拿魚配金文拔芝士手卷等佳餚。大角咀有餐廳推出100元椰子雞煲放題；另以正價惠顧一款小菜，即可以優惠價加購燒鵝等美食，性價比極高。
報道本地、兩岸、國際重要新聞以及體育消息，讓你洞悉各地大事及體壇動向。

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: Leo希望杜文彬可以幫他製造DH2，但不得要領。一不做二不休之下綁架了杜以盈，卻被高子樂目擊；高子樂到醫院探望小魚，小魚卻已不認得他；子樂回憶起自己到飛虎隊的首天，得到小魚的鼓勵的事。
《東張西望》星期一至日，緊貼追蹤社會大事、趣聞逸事，並報道娛樂圈最新動態、藝人消息，以及劇集宣傳和花絮。「今日突發」環節為大家追蹤即日熱門新聞；專題環節，深入探討大眾關心的時事、社會及民生問題，並訪問相關的專家。

epg.programme_title_en: Emotion And Taste Of Hong Kong[Can]
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 從車仔檔到上舖，「肥姐小食店」負責人「肥姐」一直堅持良心經營的信念，食店因而得到街坊支持，並獲下一代延續下去。阿詩經營的西餐廳，因敵不過加租壓力，被迫結業，幸得家人體諒，阿詩定下「十年計劃」，完成心願。單親媽媽Gigi曾任職財務策劃師，為修補與子女的關係，從零開始經營車仔麵店，在師傅、業主和街坊支持下，跨過開業時的難關。薛家燕與達人「肥姐」及兩位「夢想者」阿詩、Gigi交流餐廳經營之道。

女採集藝術家採集由大自然「調配」而成的青草茶，從雜草看出每片土地不同的種物形態。她亦為每塊土地繪畫一幅曼陀羅，將雜草藉着畫作呈現出來。木作藝術家用木頭隨心創作，發掘木頭更多的可能性，且聽他介紹藍染系列作品的特色。一棵被颱風吹倒的樹木亦可成為素材，藝術家分享木工創作的吸引力。仿生植物飾品藝術家女拍檔透過觀察植物獲取靈感，創作皮革小配件。二人尤其喜歡形態萬千的蕨類植物，藉以激起大家於逆境中成長的勇氣。

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 亨請眾品嚐「白松露菌宴」，條件是出席者均要是夫婦或戀人。義和花欲將戀情曝光，三妗婆突到高家，更指責喜因要出席「露菌宴」而不陪她看大戲。三更強拉花與根回家，翌日更到藥房代根辭職，並要子女與高家斷絕關係。
少春拿出全副身家辦義舍賑濟災民。與孫遜不和的梁京冠舉薦玉樓去南方賑災。映雪偷看孫遜的奏疏，將內容洩露給賈逢源，被賈逢源利用，迫使孫遜舉薦自己做御史。少春知小雅對琅琊王氏嫡子王均心生愛慕，費心撮合二人。

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 甚麼菜蔬連同芝士剁碎後香炸，做出得意小食不怕小朋友偏食？運用香芋冬瓜煲出的湯水，芋香味冬瓜口感夠玩味！肥媽加入椰漿炒素菜，製造泰式風味素菜。肥媽到觀眾家中煮菜，讓觀眾學懂令餸菜變精采的變通之法！

SCOLAR 30 years on: A Language Education Journey[Can]
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 「深耕三十載 ，語你譜新篇」，教育局、語文教育及研究常務委員會(語常會)三十年來，致力協助在香港推動兩文三語。節目由星級藝員梁凱晴(Carina)、焦浩軒、語常會學生語文大使Anisah Hussain擔綱演出，述說當局如何透過政策藍圖、撥款、教學支援、多元化活動等各方面，讓本港市民，尤其是中小學生提升語文水平，進一步掌握兩文三語的運用。

嘉賓莊紹嘉當年不幸遭狗隻襲擊，導致左眼永久受損。作為過來人，他呼籲狗主務必看管好自家毛孩，並細說自己如何走出創傷陰霾。紹嘉縱成視障人士，仍積極投身公益服務，他坦言希望將愛心傳承下一代。藝人羅敏莊一家三口移居泰國近五年，享受「Chill」慢生活節奏。夫妻感情要保鮮，敏莊大讚老公陳國邦每天做甜蜜舉動，令她心動。敏莊還大方透露二人有協議，若有朝感情生變會坦然面對。「睇餸食飯」，陳國賓示範「人參腐皮卷」。

劉天蘭從藝人轉型為著名形象顧問，堪稱才女。天蘭不論跟殿堂級歌手或是新演員，同樣能做到合作無間。她本着一顆好奇心融入不同領域，皆因深信「眼界決定境界」。天蘭喜歡與女兒結伴出遊，同時卻要求女兒獨立自處，對育兒有何獨到心得？回歸健康生活「有心唔怕遲」！天蘭多年前決心戒煙，及後積極投入運動鍛練體魄、節制飲食，作為送給自己的生日禮物，努力成果亦伴隨而至。「菁峰生活」，梓峰帶大家感受訊號山公園的清幽舒適環境。
利亞找到林雪作為吃軟飯目標。林雪到電視台投考多項比賽，卻未能入選。尤田於超市舉行美食節，迫員工穿上厚厚的毛裘服飾。在野偶遇靜雯，認出她是中學同學，靜雯母親秋水來到，責靜雯男友郭寶沒好好保護靜雯。

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 小丸子在繪畫比賽獲獎，在全校集會上獲頒獎狀，卻在等候上台時人有三急，令她不知如何是好。小丸子一家人去吃法國菜，由於價錢超乎預期，爸爸身上帶不夠錢，幸好小丸子帶了紅包錢來以防萬一。

新環節「粵劇READY GO」，會以趣味方式讓小朋友體驗粵劇文化。正印花旦謝曉瑩帶來「馬鞭」道具，教廠內小朋友學習上馬、騎馬、勒馬、打馬等基本動作，再試演一幕《虎牢關前配戰馬》，小朋友都做到活學活用。大多小朋友都愛吃快餐店的薯條、漢堡包，家長卻擔心會影響健康，不妨以紙筆畫出一份套餐，或可同時滿足雙方。薯條要注意甚麼細節，才可畫得更有光澤？漢堡包的材料任由繪畫者選擇，喜愛的話更可不停加材料和層數呢！
大雄想用「報社遊戲套裝」效法小夫出版報紙，卻被小夫斷章取義式報導陷害而聲名狼藉。大雄擅自拿走後備百寶袋，亂用法寶找靜香和向明星討簽名，還把大堆垃圾塞進百寶袋，最後被多啦A夢追究。
緊貼市況，逢交易日下午5時50分報道當日本港和外圍股市行情，以及重點財經新聞。
